row.name: Gothic Virtual Tabletop
row.detailed_description: Gothic Virtual Tabletop is a virtual tabletop application that can be customized to support most TTRPG systems, including wargames. Built-in System-agnostic Character Sheets Customizable character sheets support any system from the ever-present D&D, to that fantasy heartbreaker from the 90s. Easily access character sheets by double clicking on a token, not by switching to another tab. Revolutionary Hotbar System When you select a token, a state-of-the-art Hotbar appears at the bottom of the screen. The Hotbar displays all the information a player or GM cares about in one compact space, making GM-ing large combats or managing multiple playable characters a breeze. Gone are the days of dozens of tabs worth of stat blocks cluttering your monitor! Robust Macro System Roll dice, edit your character sheet, send predefined messages in chat, and even play sounds at one press of a button. Customize the color and text of any macro button, and where they should be shown on the Hotbar Support for user-defined variables, which can include mathematical equations and/or any value on a token's character sheet. Support For Almost Any TTRPG System or Wargame Default Character Sheet values and macros, as well as compendium weapons, armour, spells, and tables are defined in .json files and stored independently on a per-campaign basis. Easily customize Gothic Virtual Tabletop to suit each and every one of your needs. Built-In Compendium Define weapons, armour, abilities, spells, and rollable tables present in your system of choice and easily add them to a token at the press of a button. Built-in Jukebox Browse your campaign's music library and add queue up the perfect songs for the occasion! Absolutely Sublime Text Chat Rolls always show what the individual die rolls were, even when part of a complex equation or macro. Easily whisper to other players, or the GM. Roll dice for all to see, or just to the GM in secret. Roll on tables and show the result in chat. Support for robes and wizard hats. Per-map whiteboard layer for drawing up battle strategies or doodling while that player takes the slowest turn ever. Feature-rich Map editor Quick and easy fog-of-war tools to keep curious players from scouting out secret rooms and ambushes. Adjust the grid to fit any image, whether it has a baked-in grid or not. Turn grid lines on and off. Supports Common types of map grids, including square, hex (horizontal), hex (vertical), and no grid. No Loading Screens Okay, there is one loading screen that appears when a player first connects to the server and downloads assets. After that, you're free to game in peace. Self Hosted All your maps, tokens, sounds, and music files are stored locally, on your computer. Gone are the days of juggling storage space when trying to upload a new map for your next encounter! Password Protected Lobbies Easily view who is connected to the server in the bottom left, a green bubble means connected, and yellow means connecting.
row.short_description: Gothic Virtual Tabletop is a virtual tabletop application that can be customized to support nearly any TTRPG or Wargame.

row.name: Blast Processed
row.detailed_description: Blast Processed is a first-person platformer built around an infamous movement quirk of early FPS games: Rocket Jumping. Key Features: Movement mechanics inspired by the full suite of Source Engine movement gamemodes like Surf and BHop. Enhancements have been made to key aspects of movement to be more welcoming for new players while not compromising on the depth of high-level play. Consistent, fully deterministic gameplay where specific inputs consistently return the same results, allowing for pure tests of skill where the player is in full control of their character at all times. Seven official maps with level design inspired by Team Fortress 2's community-made jump maps & other Source movement gamemodes. Visuals inspired by the early 3D PC games of the late 90s and early 2000s, designed to never infringe on the readability of the environments. A full replay system which saves your best times on maps to watch back or race against as a ghost. More features to come over the course of Early Access. Visit my YouTube channel to keep up with development through my devlog series. NOTE: This game is hard. While the mechanics of rocket jumping and advanced movement mechanics are tutorialized, it is highly recommended that you at minimum have an understanding of first-person movement mechanics and controls before playing.
row.short_description: Blast Processed is a first-person platformer built around an infamous movement quirk of early FPS games: Rocket Jumping.

row.name: Perfect Poses
row.detailed_description: AGILITY DETERMINES FLEXIBILITY A board is moving towards you, but there is a hole. The only way to stay on the platform is to go through the hole. Adjust your pose that fit the hole within a limited time frame and go through it. The ultimate target is to go through all 100 holes and climb up to the very top of the tower. POSING MODE You're free to move all the bone controllers in posing mode, so that your character can be transformed to any shape. If you're a challenger, you may use the perspective projection mode. If it is too hard for you, the orthographic projection mode may help. You may also change the speed of the moving board, which will directly affect the difficulty of the level. PUSH AND FALL You will be pushed by the moving board and fall if you can't go through the hole. FALLING CONTROL Try your best to control your character and land on the platform during falling so you don't need to restart from the very beginning. STRETCH OUT YOUR LIMBS Of course, tuck in your limbs can make things easier, but you may fail the level easier as well. The more you stretch out your limbs, the higher score you will obtain. Good luck, body challengers!
row.short_description: Adjust your pose, go through the hole!

row.name: Mine? Sweeper
row.detailed_description: Game Description 'Avoid the mines, find all the treasures, and clear the stage!' The primary goal of traditional minesweeper is to locate all the mines on the stage. This involves distinguishing tiles with mines from those without, and game completion is achieved upon identifying all mine locations. However, this game's objective is not to find mines. It's about avoiding mines to discover treasures, and the game is cleared when all treasures are found. Even if you can discern which tiles are not empty, you cannot know whether they are treasure tiles or mine tiles. Therefore, you can: Use items to identify the nature of a tile, or Deduce from the surrounding numbers of mines and treasures, or Guess based on the current number of remaining mines and traps, or Just take a wild guess, to determine whether a tile is a treasure or a mine. A large-scale tomb raiding game mode with multiple stages forming one dungeon In each stage, finding all treasures lets you acquire one piece of equipment. With each piece of equipment aiding in clearing stages, complete all stages to find the final treasure and clear the dungeon! A small-scale tomb raiding game mode focusing on clearing a single stage This game mode involves solving a single stage using deduction alone. Controller Support No device other than a mouse is needed to play the game! In fact, using a controller other than a mouse for minesweeper feels awkward. (Gamepads are not supported.)
row.short_description: In this twist on minesweeper, find all treasures while avoiding mines to clear stages. Use items, deduce from nearby counts, or guess to identify tiles. Features a large-scale mode with multiple stages leading to a final treasure, and a small-scale mode focused on deducing a single stage.

row.name: Pronovost Art Gallery
row.detailed_description: You are invited to an unconventional virtual experience that is all at once artistic, impressive, and inspiring! The Pronovost Art experience is a virtual museum visit that allows you to discover, immerse in, and contemplate the artist’s monumental works in all their striking angles. Photos and videos hardly do justice to the work of the artist, that is why Jean Pronovost has decided to undertake, with his skilled team and cutting-edge technologies, the task of bringing to life a virtual gallery, where dimensional and awe-inspiring art can be felt in a truly immersive way. Here for the first time, all of Pronovost’s works can be found in one place, allowing the visitor to truly appreciate their scale, power, and presence. Visitors can wander freely at their own pace through this virtual gallery, which was inspired by the Pinacoteca of Sao Paulo in Brazil, an architectural marvel that left an indelible mark on the artist when he travelled there. The virtual experience viewer will be able to fully immerse themselves in Jean’s universe in their own way, without interruption, time limit, or other visitors getting in the way! Artist’s statement: Jean Pronovost’s art is not decorative. It is neither wholly abstract nor simply figurative. His art is visionary, allegorical. His creations are open books leading us through a universe where the strange and mystical reign. With the whip of a paintbrush, he carries us to the heart of an Inca legend or into the urban jungle. With a swing of a spatula, he reanimates a God faded from our memories or challenges our humdrum routine. With striking realism, his paintings and sculptures unveil a universe where yesterday’s signs can interact with our modern world. Fascinated with history and mythology, but also inspired by the magic of symbolism, Jean Pronovost uses archetypes rooted in ancient civilizations. He breathes life into gods and legends which constitute the background of his creations. He skillfully blends anachronism with ancient pictorial techniques, thus offering creations to contemplate but also to decrypt, as so many details subtly illustrate his allegorical vision of the world. Delicate touches of color and richness of shape then overlay thoughtful paintings and sculptures, bringing depth to scenes of contemporary life and ancient metaphors. Elegy for the essential and critic of all false values, the work of Jean Pronovost opens the door to an alternative universe. In the world where the conscience loses its way on the path towards material gain, where the meaning of our life decays inside a society promoting individualism and power struggle, the artist questions our origins and offers his own personal vision of the world.
row.short_description: In his new Virtual Art Gallery experience, Jean Pronovost invites you to discover, and immerse yourself in his monumental works. This collection of striking pieces overflow with symbolism as they confront present and past, the historical and mythological. A query into timeless perspectives.
row.notes: Contains nudity.

row.name: Aurora Hills: Chapter 1
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Aurora Hills! Nestled deep within the Appalachian Mountains, Aurora Hills was known for its thriving industry and its picturesque landscape. Owing to the region's natural resources, Aurora Hills was looking to become one of the most prosperous towns in the state. All is not how it seems, however. A series of disappearances of residents and tourists alike have plagued the region over the past few years, sparking a mass exodus from the small town. Now, in October 1981, the town is a shell of its former self. The prosperity that once blessed Aurora Hills has all but evaporated. Working as a park ranger, you must investigate what's going on with these disappearances and answer questions that have tormented residents for years. Why has there been an increase in disappearances over the past 6 months? Why are there no traces of the people who went missing? Perhaps most importantly, who, or what, could be behind all of this? It's up to you to venture forth, deep into the national park, to uncover the mysteries of Aurora Hills... Developed by the creators of Meridian 157, Aurora Hills: Chapter 1 is the first part in series of point and click puzzle adventure games. Based in the year 1981 in a small West Virginian community, Aurora Hills follows the journey of Ethan Hill, a park ranger tasked with investigating strange disappearances from the region. Explore the rolling hills of West Virginia, find clues of the whereabouts of the missing people and solve intriguing puzzles to uncover the mystery of Aurora Hills! Features: • Custom soundtrack and sound effects designed for a creepy in-game atmosphere • Challenging and clever puzzles • A logical hint system for some of the most difficult riddles • Available in 9 languages, including English, French, Russian, German, Chinese (Simplified), Spanish, Portuguese, Italian and Japanese! • New colour blind mode available for people who might have trouble with colour based puzzles
row.short_description: Aurora Hills: Chapter 1 is the first part in series of point and click puzzle adventure games. Follow the journey of Ethan Hill, a park ranger tasked with investigating strange disappearances from the region to uncover the mystery of Aurora Hills!

row.name: Stellar Reflections
row.detailed_description: ~~A sci-fi short story about overcoming problems and changing perspectives~~ Stellar Reflections is a short story visual novel set in a dystopian future, within a sprawling space station. In this bleak era, personal freedoms have been suppressed, and life choices are dictated by the all-powerful regime. Delve into the narrative through the eyes of the protagonist, Aurelia, a nobody spending her days at her junkyard job, in a bar, or holed up in her cabin. She'll come to face a life-altering decision that will challenge her perception of the world. In the distant future, Earth and Mars are used exclusively as mining facilities, and most of human population resides in space stations around the planets and the Moon. The world is governed by a centralized, autocratic government managing most of life choices for every existing human. The government just made a decision directly affecting the life of the protagonist - Aurelia. And she's far from being a fan. How will she handle it? Length Stellar Reflections is a short story, consisting of about 17000 words, divided into 15 bits. Reaching all endings takes about 1 hour, depending on the reading speed. Audio There are 16 original tracks created specifically for this novel. Endings The novel features a couple of choices which lead to one of three possible endings: bad, neutral, or good.
row.short_description: Aurelia is a nobody living out her life on a space station orbiting Earth, spending her days working in a junkyard, frequenting a bar, or retreating to her cabin. She will confront a life-altering decision that challenges her perception of the world. Can she change and grow, or is she too far gone?
row.notes: The novel does not present depictions of any risqué content, however readers may find certain sound effects disturbing, and the story contains potentially controversial subjects, such as alcohol abuse, drug abuse, sexual references, self-harm references, rape references, other crime references, as well as strong language.

row.name: Summoneer
row.detailed_description: About Summoneer Summoneer is a physics based puzzle platformer that allows you to draw and craft anything your heart desires. Climb a mythical castle while overcoming challenges with vehicles and contraptions of your own design. Use creative platforming, drawing and engineering to summon your way to the top! Solve puzzles with your own creations Create more and more complex designs in the editor and pilot them with custom controls that you can assign without limitations, while using wall jumps and momentum to maneuver both yourself and your summons through increasingly difficult puzzles. Features The Puzzles Every level of the game provides a new puzzle for you to solve. The further you go, the harder they get, going from making your way past a chasm to complex challenges that require detailed thinking and design work. The Editor Use the editor to create any vehicle or contraption you can think of. Draw your summoned design over multiple layers, then pin the many individual elements of your drawing together to connect them. Your pins come with a menu that offers a large variety of options, including assignable keys to motorize your creation. This simple combination offers a near infinite range of possibilities and creative solutions for you to explore through complex physics and engineering. Design Sharing You can save all of your designs, which allows you to reuse and improve them in later levels. The design files are easily accessible outside the game via a folder, allowing you to share them with other players without any hassle. Are you creative enough to summon your way to the top?
row.short_description: Summoneer is a platformer and puzzle game, where you engineer your own designs.

row.name: Smash Cup
row.detailed_description: Smash Cup is a PvP & PvE arena brawler with a unique blend of multiple game genres, an ever-growing selection of upgradeable characters and supportive units. This fast-paced, adrenaline-fueled action game has 1v1, 2v2, 3v3, tower defense and even battle royale mods, all to challenge new players in a highly competitive chase to become the ultimate smasher. Each Smash Cup game is a test of strategy and quick thinking as you construct an impenetrable fortress. Use a variety of units for base building, each offering unique defensive and offensive capabilities. Choose carefully and optimize your base to withstand waves of relentless attacks. Choose between joining forces with friends for intense 2v2, 3v3 battles, or going solo in 1v1 duels. Perfect your tactics, adapt to your opponents, and dominate the arena – together or alone. With over eight playable characters boasting unique abilities, and more than 15 units for base building, you’ll upgrade your strategies. Every new character and unit brings you one step closer to becoming the ultimate Smasher. From the strategic depth of Tower Defense to the adrenaline-fueled Battle Royale mode, there's a challenge for every type of player. Participate in daily tournaments, display your prowess, and reap grand prizes. Are you ready to take on the Smash Cup challenge? Key Features 8+ Playable characters with unique abilities that will determine your way of action. 15+ Units for base building strategies to help you change the course of the game. 3 MOBA modes to choose from intense 1v1, 2v2, and 3v3 multiplayer battles. Tower defense to challenge your base building strategy. Battle Royale mode that will test your ability to survive in an endless fight for victory. Daily tournaments to win grand prizes, and stand out as the ultimate Smasher. Upgrade your smashers and bases and advance further in the game. Customize with new skins and arena themes to personalize your gaming experience. Fresh Content Every Month New game mechanics New smashers and base units Exclusive skins and rewards Join the thrilling universe of Smash Cup today, where every Smasher is a star! We're constantly evolving and bringing fresh updates to the game regularly. Download now to start your journey!

row.name: Slipstream: Rogue Space
row.detailed_description: In Slipstream: Rogue Space, Streamers captain a massive starship and viewers are the crew. Together they explore the galaxy, fight aliens, and operate the ship in real-time. Battle through challenging rogue-like maps as a team and work together to see how long you can survive. Captains and Crew Play as two unique roles: The captain , who makes key decisions, gives orders, and leads the ship. This can be a live streamer with their community or anyone bold enough to pilot a few friends into battle. The crew , who work together to operate the ship: shoot, repair, shield up, and more. Captains can play LIVE on stream with their audience, in real time . Dozens of players can join across desktop or mobile platforms to form an elite crew. Deep gameplay, persistent progress, and tons of interaction help build strong ties for your community. Many Ways to Play Launch a small ship with some friends, join a streamer of a few dozen crew, or take on major challenges with a streamer piloting 100+ players towards victory. Crew Classes Choose from a variety of specialized crew classes, including: As you play, earn permanent XP to level-up your skill tree and customize your character builds. The Dangers Of Rogue Space Aliens invaded and conquered our solar system. Those few earthlings that escaped have banded together on the cold edges of space, seeking to survive and exact revenge. There will be no quick victory, but day by day, zapped slug by zapped slug, hope survives. Explore a variety of regions to battle through randomly generated maps. Each run is a unique experience with dangers and rewards constantly evolving. Whether you're piloting a scout with a few friends or a massive cruiser with dozens of players, the game will adapt to provide a fair but challenging experience. Just the Beginning... Slipstream is just getting started! In the few months since launch, we've added: crew outfit customization, officer roles, daily challenge and bonus runs, crew skill respec, new enemies and regions to explore, Twitch drops, Steam/Apple/Google sign-in options, and tons of fixes & QOL improvements. Much more to come... We are committed to helping build strong communities through collaborative gameplay, and we hope to see you aboard!
row.short_description: A multiplayer roguelike about teamwork, survival...and cute animals in space! Play with a few friends or join a streamer's crew of dozens as you work together to battle aliens across the vast Rogue Space.

Fly around with a magnet, hit enemies in the face with a shovel, gun down everything that moves, and if anyone is still alive after your massacre, you can blow them to pieces with a bomb. Featuring: 9 levels Multiplayer with an in-game chat An emotional questline with permanent choices - who will you betray? Semi-Non-Euclidean Impossible mazes Bombs, shovels, magnets, and guns Bees, spiders, pigs, rats, and other vermin. Instant download (less than 256kb) Get your mouse and keyboard today and make the tide turn

row.name: ELECTROBASIS
row.detailed_description: Hundreds, if not THOUSANDS of years ago, a Biblical rapture fell upon the Earth, leading for angels to walk beside man, in effort to make humankind more holy living by example. Which, nowadays, isn’t all that sacred of a concept - angels are everywhere! THEY’ve integrated human characteristics into their own culture, rather than vice versa.                                Made up of pure electricity, cherubs take up object heads to anthropomorphize their form. They own businesses, live in casinos, and are free to gamble their heart away. YOU , as a fallen angel, crashland SMACKdab in the center of a casino in Vegas - LITERALLY crashland. By playing this game you agree to clean-up duty*, fixing up the spark inside! Start with fixing up the casino herself by turning back on the power, and then expand into the happiness of the residents in the rooms upstairs.                                INCLUDES: A casino and hotel to explore! Five different residents that have something wrong with them! Exposition dump in text form for YOUR, yes your, eyeballs to scan over! 2010s dance party ending! At least one rat Music from famous musician VEN! You know Ven, don’t you? katabasis (n.) a mytheme or trope in which the hero embarks on a journey to the underworld any journey downwards or fall

row.name: Adorimon : Arena of Ancients
row.detailed_description: In Adorimon - Arena of Ancients, you would be able to adopt and train powerful-but-adorable creatures called 'Adorimon'. Leveling, feeding, teaching, evolving, there are tons of activities you can do to unlock the full potential of your Adorimons. Prepare a decent team to explore the story, climb Challenge Tower, and duel with other players. With 130+ species of Adorimons right now, and more will come in the future, guarantee you a pleasant experience of collecting and admiring their unique beauty. All Adorimon designs are original and can be found nowhere else. They are based on the inspiration of animals and plants in nature, and mythical creatures from various cultures. Each Adorimon has a full 3-stage evolution line, some even have multiple evolution branches, so that you don't get in the situation when your favorite Adorimon cannot evolve like others. All characters are animated thoroughly, making every battle more lively. Still the familiar turn-based combat mechanic where both sides make their decision, then the faster one goes first, but a lot of new vital things are added. Element interaction: There are up to 15 element types, and each Adorimon can have 2 elements. Knowing the effectiveness of each element against others is the key to victory. Status: effects that may turn the tide. There are a lot of statuses in 'Adorimon: Arena of Ancients', from common statuses like Poisoned, Burned, Healing,... to stat changing statuses. They take an important role in the result of a battle, and you can build your strategy focusing on a specific status. There is no limit of how many statuses one can bear at the same time. Moves: Currently there are 300+ moves in the game, and the number keeps rising. A fully-evolved Adorimon can prepare up to 6 moves to use in battle, along with 2 default actions 'Normal Attack' and 'Defense'. This gives you a lot of options to choose from, as well as harder to predict your opponent's action. Each move has its own mana cost and cooldown, so that there is no limit how many times a move can be used in a combat, and some moves cannot be used continuously. Special Abilities: Each Adorimon has a special ability. It can passively enhance a stat, or be triggered in a specific condition and make a surprise for your opponent. And that's not all. As the game keeps expanding, more interesting mechanics would be added! Beside the most common ways like leveling and evolving, there are many other activities you can do to make your Adorimons better: rarity enhancing, move tutoring, etc. You can even hunt for relics and resurrect almighty Ancient Adorimons, or breed two different Adorimons to get a completely new species. Leveling up is the most basic way to power up an Adorimon. When an Adorimon reaches level 15 or 30, you can evolve it. Once your Adorimon gets to the final evolution form, you can teach it various moves. This allows more strategies available. If you try hard enough, you can even resurrect Ancient Adorimons from relics. They are very powerful and surely worth your effort. This is not a pay-to-win game where there are limited contents blocked by purchase wall. In fact, a free player could obtain everything in the game. Gorgeous skins, extremely rare Ancient and Event Adorimons, ... all will be yours if you spend enough time and effort to get them. Doing daily quests regularly, joining in PvP Arena often, and you will have a top team in about 15 days. In PvP battles, it's experience and strategy brings you to victory.
row.short_description: Explore fantastic creatures called 'Adorimon' in a new 2D turn-based strategy game! Collect and train your Adorimons to discover the world, climb Challenge Tower, and duel other players in Arena.

row.name: Up Hike
row.detailed_description: Embark on an exhilarating ascent in Up Hike , the platformer game that challenges your skills and precision! In this thrilling 2D adventure, your goal is simple yet daunting: reach the summit. Brace yourself for a journey filled with heart-pounding jumps, strategic wall bounces, and the ever-present risk of a dizzying fall. Up Hike is a maze of precarious platforms, each jump demanding your utmost attention and timing. Your every move counts and as you go up the challenge will intensifie. Game Mechanics: Challenging Platformer: The only way to reach the end of your hike is to jump, but be carefull the higher you go the harder you fall . Strategic Wall Jumping : Use the walls to your advantage to bounce and reach higher in a sequence of consecutive jumps The longer you hold the jump, the further you will go: You will need a lot of practice to master it Dynamic Landscapes: Explore a variety of environments as you climb, each with its own set of challenges. From forests to icy peaks, adapt to new obstacles and keep climbing. Will you rise to the challenge and reach the summit in Up Hike ? The ascent begins now!
row.short_description: Jump between platforms avoiding falls, use the walls for extra height and enjoy the serene landscapes, if you can. With minimal graphics and warm colors, it's a delightful Up Hike.

row.name: Alien Horizon (Preview Alpha)
row.detailed_description: Alien Horizon is a sci-fi survival city builder set on an inhospitable alien planet. Faced with imminent destruction of Earth, humanity pooled together their resources and sent sleeper ships to nearby potentially habitable planets. But this one turned out to be much less habitable than expected. Can you survive anyway? From one ship to a colony Build your colony around the sleeper ship, containing 1000 last survivors from Earth. Construct power sources, housing, infrastructure and factories to ensure comfort of your colonists and provide the colony with all the resources it needs. Manage bus lines, set laws and provide services, making sure your colonists are happy, healthy and productive. Each colonist is their own simulated individual. On your own Earth is dead, so it can't help you out here. If you didn't bring something with you, tough luck. Explore the landscape around you to find all the other ships from your fleet that carry supplies, and survey resource deposits to eventually produce your own. Complex resource management Manage complex production chains to produce 86 different resources, each with a realistic recipe. Build logistics hubs and set up storages to make sure all of them get to where they need. Preview alpha Even though this is a free preview, it's a full-fledged game of its own, with no time or content limitations. It is possible to achieve a self-sufficient colony. The proper game is still in development and will be released later. You can support its development by buying the Donation packs.

row.name: Ball Bulét
row.detailed_description: ◉ Ball Bulét started in the spring of 2022 as a Big One, an academic project by AIV - Accademia Italiana Videogiochi aimed at adding a production experience to the teaching carried out in the various courses, from the creation of the game concept to commercial publishing. The objective of the Big Ones is to give students the opportunity to collaborate with colleagues from other courses in the development of a video game project in which everyone can put the skills acquired during the lessons to the test and at the same time perfect their soft skills. ◉ Ball Bulét is an isometric, bullet hell, twin-stick shooter. In the game, you navigate various levels by defeating enemies using a sphere that can bounce off walls and opponents. Hitting more enemies at once will boost your gained score. SHE FIGHTS....WITH A BALL?! Your only weapon is 'the Sphere', a simple ball capable of bouncing against every surface without taking damage, fused with a special magnet that lets it float on air and come towards you when you switch the magnet on your arm. Why did you invent it? I'm not sure, and this is probably why the company fired you, taking all your old projects with it....except one they considered “useless” and that will determine their end. THEY KNEW YOU WERE COMING Crashing against the entrance with a hover car is not the stealthiest way to infiltrate, but sure it’s the coolest!! The security guards had the green light to shoot on sight, and all units were set to max alert from that coward of a CEO. Fight against unusual enemies that will not go easy on you. Evade rockets, jump over lasers, dodge sniper shots, duel against Cyber Samurais, and get revenge on your ex-employer for stealing all you worked on. IT'S NOT JUST A BALL... Get your Sphere(TM) some treats for its good work! Search for the power-ups scattered across the map and surprise your enemies with special attacks combining those powers with your aim. REACH THE TOP! Reach the last floor of this titanic skyscraper, explore the offices, and the laboratories, or take a break at the company’s sauna. BEHIND THE SCENE Ball Bulét started in the spring of 2022 as a school project from AIV (Italian Videogame Academy) students, an academy for those who want to specialize their ability in the Game Industry. Students of different courses (GameDesign, 3DArt, Animation, Programming) worked together to build a game that inspired many more to come and join. AIV is trying to give visibility to the talented and successful students who worked in Ball Bulét to help them start a career in the industry. In order of “Team join” here is the team and their major contributions over 2+ years: Roberto “RobZot” Zotta - Lead ProjectManaging / Lead GameDesign / UI / Coding Gianluca “Giax” De Simone - Lead 3DArt / Rigging Adriano Soldati - 3DArt Filippo Cassini - Lead LevelDesign / Lead ArtDirection Filippo Riccò - GameDesign / LevelDesign Michelangelo Ottaviani - LevelDesign Simone Barone - Lead Animation&Rigging Edoardo Altaluce - GameDesign / UIDesign Lorenzo Lezzi - GameDesign Lorenzo “Nain” Tomasetta - LevelDesign / UIDesign Davide Carotti - ArtDirection / VFXArt Riccardo Di Palma - SoundDesign / Composer Roberta Di Gioia - VFXArt Davide Biffi - Coding
row.short_description: Ball Bulét is an isometric, Bullet Hell, twin-stick shooter in which a girl searches for revenge by fighting security guards with...a bouncing ball?! Progress through the building by performing ricochets with your spherical weapon against walls and enemies to reach the top.

row.name: Hamburg: 'Neue Burg' VR
row.detailed_description: Immerse yourself in over 1000 years of Hamburg's history and experience the beginnings of the city in 1024! The 'Neue Burg' - the nucleus of Hamburg's early 'New Town' - has been reconstructed in great detail in collaboration with archaeologists. This immersive Virtual Reality experience offers 22 interactive stations that invite you to discover and understand the history of Hamburg. Climb the castle walls and ship masts, jump back in time and compare then and now, collect parts of a painting to create a portrait of the Duke of the castle and explore models that visualize the 1000-year urban development of this place. You can follow the fully audio-guided tour or explore the entire area freely. 'Hamburg: Neue Burg VR' was developed as part of a PhD project and aims to use the potential of VR to convey history in a playful way. VR hardware necessary! Tested on HTC Vive Pro, Valve Index, Oculus Quest 2 & Pico 4
row.short_description: Hamburg 1000 years ago: an immersive Virtual Reality Experience with a lot of interactive stations and a detailed reconstruction of a castle and the harbour in the year of 1024. Roam around freely or follow the guided tour in English language.

row.name: Goofy Goober Simulator

Grab a weapon, equip an item and slice through Twin Raging Titans, Ghastly Apparitions, Big Tank, and Lil' Scratchy . What lies at the end of these Wacky Hijinks..? There might also be a Fishing Minigame I don't really know ? Thrilling roguelike gameplay to the darkest depths of Hell Collectable skins and costumes to personalize your very own Goober Interesting challenges to spice up regular gameplay Wide variety of enemies and bosses bent on stopping your scrummage 20+ Song OST to get your blood PUMPING Plot
row.short_description: Blast and crash through hordes of dangerous 'zombies' as the titular 'Goofy Goober' in this 'video game'. Collect Powerful items, obtain Powerful weapons, and defeat Powerful monsters in quickly paced action combat encounters. But Watch Out
row.notes: The game contains depictions of blood, but not at all realistic, cartoonish enemies disappear into red puddles but do not show any gore or detailed depictions of death.

row.name: 生死狙击：战火重燃（国际版）
row.detailed_description: 「生死狙擊-戰火重燃」脫胎於「生死狙擊」，我們重構了整體冒險系統，以期望給您帶來全新的體驗 戰鬥玩法簡介： 一、主線關卡： 遊戲大廳點擊「開始戰鬥」進入戰鬥大廳。點擊「主線」，選擇「工業區」，即可開啟挑戰。後續每一個關卡都需要通關前置關卡才能挑戰。每一個關卡你都將面臨不同的怪物，形形色色的怪獸將讓你體驗到酣暢的戰鬥。 二、試煉： 在主線關卡的基礎上，我們增加了戰鬥試煉，豐富了玩家的戰鬥體驗。 三、無盡角鬥場： 無盡角鬥場的存在，則是在基礎之上，給充滿挑戰欲望的玩家提供了更加暢快的戰鬥選擇。 完成遊戲內戰鬥可以獲取強力武器。當然，你也可以通過點擊右上角'+'按鈕充值戰火幣，消耗戰火幣可以購買各種遊戲道具或武器。使您的戰鬥體驗更加刺激。 期待您的加入！！！
row.short_description: 「生死狙擊-戰火重燃」是在“生死狙擊”冒險模式基礎上，對武器、角色、數值、玩法等一系列模塊進行重置優化而成，在刪繁就簡的基礎之上全面優化玩家體驗、降低上手門檻，並在後續更新中新增大量全新冒險玩法，快來一起嘗鮮吧!
row.notes: 玩家角色可以使用多種槍械擊殺怪物或其他玩家角色。

row.name: 悟道（体验版）
row.detailed_description: If you had the opportunity to freely travel to any era, which historical dynasty would you choose to go to? Perhaps one can try to choose the Ming Dynasty, which can be considered a brilliant period in Chinese history. During this period, significant progress and development were made in the fields of politics, economy, culture, and technology. The political system, economic system, cultural prosperity, and technological achievements of the Ming Dynasty have all left rich legacies for future generations. Interactive novel game: Wudao is a work based on interactive novel games, with a core experience of engaging storyline dialogue and main tasks. This game is based on a senior historical research team, and its plot is closely adapted from the real life trajectory of the founder of psychology, Mr. Wang Yangming. Main storyline elements: As a traveler, you will accompany Wang Yangming on a journey from the bustling and bustling capital to the remote and lonely central Guizhou. In this journey, you will experience the ups and downs of historical plots throughout, meet many real historical figures, and have the opportunity to communicate and interact with them. In the arduous and tortuous journey, we witnessed the birth of Yangming's philosophy together. Side Story Elements: In the game world, in addition to the main storyline, you can also explore the cultural backgrounds of different regions and experience a variety of side quests. Side quests are more presented in the form of short stories, allowing you to feel the charm of history in a relaxed and enjoyable atmosphere. Collecting elements: By playing main and side quests, you can collect various historical character cards, books, cultural items, and other content. These contents not only enrich the gaming experience, but also allow you to learn about rich historical and cultural aspects in the game. Join us Official QQ group of Wudao: 832499007
row.short_description: Wudao is a story game that revolves around the real life experiences of Mr. Wang Yangming. At that time, you will play the role of a scholar who pursues the true essence of psychology.

row.name: Psychopomp
row.detailed_description: Note: A New and Improved Version of Psychopomp has been released! Check out Psychopomp Gold! Welcome to the world of PSYCHOPOMP. There are catacombs hidden under every building in the world. Everyone knew about them, but lied to you about them your entire life. Descend into the depths, and see what awaits below. Psychopomp is a short Psychological Horror Dungeon Crawler. Something is wrong with the world, everything is not as you remember. You don't know why, but everything draws you to the Earth, to the tunnels below. Do the answers await you there, or is something far worse in store? Classic 3D Dungeon Crawler Gameplay! Unique Creatures and Enemies, all sorts of bizarre horrors await you below! Strange Secrets to Find! Bizarre characters to encounter, maybe some friends along the way? Explore a unique and atmospheric world, and uncover the lies that have covered it all up! Enter the catacombs, and immerse yourself in a world that only grows darker the deeper you get. Keep your wits about you, watch your back, and survive.
row.short_description: Your entire life has been a lie. There are catacombs under every home and building, stretching down for miles. Something calls you deeper into the labyrinth. Delve into the depths, and discover the monstrosities below.
row.notes: Psychopomp contains grotesque monsters and disturbing scenes. Sounds and visuals are used to produce a disturbing psychological horror environment.

row.name: Squirrels Gone Nuts
row.detailed_description: You have three different player modes at your disposal: shoot, sprint, and slide. Shoot mode equips your current weapon for firing. Sprint increases your movement speed. Slide allows you to maintain your momentum. If you can see it, you can run on it. Every surface in the arena can be traversed allowing for a unique perspective on the 2D arena shooter. Shoot other players with your weapon, and don't worry you'll never run out of ammo. When you're hurt, grab a health nut to get back up to full health. The way you move around the arena is only limited by your imagination. Utilize the weapons and mechanics to maneuver around and outsmart your opponents.
row.short_description: Squirrels Gone Nuts is a fast-paced, multiplayer, arena shooter. Play as a speedy squirrel able to run on any surface and wield various guns. GO NUTS!

row.name: PANZERKAMPF®
row.detailed_description: Panzerkampf is a PvP team tank game with tank battles from World War II. You will play with historically accurate tanks and also experimental tanks that existed as concept ideas. Modern era tanks will come into play later on as well. Key aspects of the game are the emphasis on a balanced game setup (no Pay2Win!), excellent gameplay and a clean and intuitive user interface. Panzerkampf is free to play. CHOOSE A TANK AND GET INTO THE BATTLE Select your tank, load up your ammo and equipment, give your crew members their daily orders and go directly into battle! BEGIN UPGRADING PARAMETERS AND POLISHING APPEARANCE OF YOUR TANKS Upgrade your guns, engines and other parameters as you fight. Send members of your crews to regular training exercises. Between battles, you will also be able to apply various camouflages, stickers, and badges to your tanks in the future. PLAY YOUR OWN PERSONAL TANK BATTLES OR FIGHT SIDE BY SIDE WITH FRIENDS Call to battle from your tank for yourself, or connect with friends in the game by simply counting down and entering the same battle. We are working on the option to form a platoon together and join a clan (tank brigade), which will allow you to cooperate in battles to achieve the highest number of victories, communicate with each other, or fight with other friends! IMPROVE YOUR COMBAT SKILLS Advance through battles, gain combat experience, improve your personal stats and fearlessly climb the in-game leaderboards. We will also be introducing new game modes later on, such as Death Match, Flag Conquest, and more! FIGHT IN AN ENVIRONMENT RENDERED WITH THE MOST MODERN TECHNOLOGY The game uses state-of-the-art High Definition Rendering Pipeline. Tank models and environments are highly detailed. Particle effects use advanced animation and rendering techniques. The tank sounds are those of real tank engines and weapons, including of course the legendary German 88!
row.short_description: World war of tanks rages on. Join the battle in one of our real-world tanks! Upgrade your vehicles and destroy the enemy! Play with friends and dominate the war! Play for free, in intuitive and easy to grasp UI, with state-of-the-art graphics, particle effects and authentic sound!

row.name: Brew Besties
row.detailed_description: Brew Besties is a couch co-op top-down game where 2-4 players have to brew potions and deliver them to impatient customers. Play through unique and interesting worlds, ranging from outer space, gardens and frozen snowlands! Every world comes with unique obstacles that will challenge your teamwork. Get enough points and gather all three starts per stage to make you and your friends become the true Brew Besties In this chaotic family game you need to work together to brew potions by helping each other prepare ingredients, managing the cauldron’s fire, gathering firewood and reaching remote areas. Use your throwing ability to throw other players, whether to be helpful, or not, is up to you! But remember, both strategy and communication are essential for success.
row.short_description: Brew Besties is a couch co-op top-down game where 2-4 players have to brew potions and deliver them to impatient customers. Every world comes with unique obstacles that will challenge your teamwork.

row.name: Pavement Pummel
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the world of **Pavement Pummel**, a thrilling multiplayer physics-based bike racing game. Designed with a unique low poly 3D aesthetic, Pavement Pummel offers an immersive gaming experience that is both visually stunning and challenging. In Pavement Pummel, you'll find yourself pitted against players from around the globe in adrenaline-pumping races through diverse landscapes. The game's physics-based mechanics ensure that no two races are the same, making every contest a unique battle of strategy, skill, and speed. Whether you're weaving through city streets, careening down mountain trails, or navigating treacherous off-road terrain, your bike handling skills will be put to the ultimate test. But it's not just about speed - strategic use of power-ups, mastering the art of drafting, and knocking your opponents off their game are all part of the ride. With its easy-to-learn, hard-to-master controls, Pavement Pummel is accessible to players of all skill levels. Whether you're a casual gamer looking for some fun, or a hardcore racer seeking the top of the leaderboard, there's a place for you here. So, are you ready to pummel the pavement and claim your victory? Strap on your helmet, rev up your engine, and join the race in Pavement Pummel!
row.short_description: Welcome to Pavement Pummel, an exhilarating multiplayer physics-based bike racing game. Engage in thrilling races against players worldwide across diverse landscapes. Master the art of strategy, skill, and speed. Navigate through city streets, mountain trails, or off-road terrain.

row.name: Looking For Cats In a Badly Drawn City
row.detailed_description: Special Offer About the Game Welcome to the badly drawn town where the kittens hide! Explore the amazing corners of a city full of jagged lines and curved outlines. Your goal is to find 100 cats hidden in the most unexpected places! Make your way through the streets and alleyways, looking for cat silhouettes on the roofs and windows of skyscrapers. Listen for magical purrs and follow tails flickering through the clouds! Look for cats in parks with their mysterious trees, under bridges and in the most unexpected places, but be careful, some cats will turn their backs on you and you will only be able to spot them by their silhouette. Use your imagination and keen eye to spot all the cats in the most unusual situations.
row.short_description: Explore the amazing corners of a city full of jagged lines and curved outlines. Your goal is to find 100 cats hidden in the most unexpected places!

row.name: Supermarket Simulator: Prologue
row.detailed_description: SEE FULL VERSION About the Game This Prologue is a limited version of the full game to stop waiting and jump into running your supermarket already. Don't forget to wishlist the full game to continue your most fun supermarket experience. Design your store, optimizing for efficiency and aesthetics. Determine where products are displayed, manage your aisles, and ensure a smooth shopping experience for your customers. Order stock using an in-game computer and anticipate the arrival of your next delivery. Unpack goods, organize them in your storage room and display them on shelves, fridges, and freezers. Read product barcodes, handle cash and credit card transactions, and ensure customers leave satisfied with their shopping and checkout experience. Navigate the complexities of a real-time market. Buy products when prices dip and determine the best-selling prices to balance customer satisfaction with profit margins. Wishlist the full game 'Supermarket Simulator' where every decision matters. Will you rise to the occasion, transforming a modest establishment into a retail powerhouse, all while balancing customer satisfaction, finances, and mafia expectations?
row.short_description: Start running your own supermarket with Prologue already. Stock shelves, handle cashier tasks, process online orders, design & expand. Set the prices based on the market. Be prepared to face the consequences if you fail to make the nightly repayment to the gangs.

row.name: Veiled Tales
row.detailed_description: Ancient folk tale comes to life and unexpectedly, village trip to grandfather’s house turns into a deadly nightmare. Unleash the mystery of mountains with Demetre by travelling and meeting new people. Dive into a wild forest, hunt down animals, sell the meat and obtain money. “Veiled Tales” is an immersive adventure game set in a picturesque Georgian mountain village. In this 3rd person modern time game, you'll experience Georgia by fitting in Demetre's character. Players immerse themselves in the charm of Georgia’s architecture and language as spoken by the characters. Players' objective is to ultimately reveal secret of Demetre's brother's disappearance. Throughout the journey he faces diverse difficulties and obstacles, helps out villagers, gathers information and acquires ancient, inherited weapon. The first project by Georgian Game Development startup 'Surreal Genesis'. With this modest-size project we sincerely showcase our abilities as a starting point in this field. This is only the beginning of our long, indefatigable and hard journey. Stay tuned!
row.short_description: 'Veiled Tales' is an adventure game set in Georgia's high mountain village. The story revolves around an ancient tale, guiding the main character, Demetre, through crucial decisions. Immerse yourself in a wild world of deception, where uncovering secrets and mysteries becomes a fight for life.
row.notes: Game involves hunting down wild animals and weapon combat scenes.

row.name: Vespera_Hotel
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Vespera Hotel! Please orbserve the precautions on manager's letter and greet our dear guests with your smile. [Description] Play as a Receptionist in Vespera Hotel. You will need to answer the calls and deal with their requests. You can take that old-fashioned lift to different floors where key items are located. Press [E] to pick up items or talk to the guests. Different choices will lead to different endings. Press [T] to check your target when you are lost. *Jump Scare WARNING* [Controller Support] *You can now play this game with controller *Press [View button] to view the Controller layout at any time.
row.short_description: Welcome to Vespera Hotel! Please orbserve the precautions on manager's letter and greet our dear guests with your smile.

row.name: Aqua Fry
row.detailed_description: Dive into the depths of underwater mayhem in this local multiplayer game, where up to 4 players engage in a chaotic free-for-all, akin to shooting pool but with a unique aquatic twist. Aqua Fry combines strategic gameplay, fast-paced action, and a splash of humor for an unforgettable gaming experience. Embark on an underwater adventure where you control quirky sea creatures in a top-down arena. The objective? Knock your opponents into the clutches of menacing sea creatures, trapping them in bubbles and putting them to sleep. But beware, the colossal Eye enemy is always in hot pursuit, adding an extra layer of intensity to every match. Key Features: Simple Controls: Joystick + one-button gameplay. Move with the joystick. Shoot, Charge, Defend with any face/shoulder button on your controller. Local Multiplayer Mayhem: Gather your friends or challenge AI opponents in intense 1-4 player local multiplayer matches. The more, the merrier – or in this case, the more chaotic! Free-for-All Gameplay: Experience the thrill of free-for-all gameplay, where every sea creature is out for themselves. Master the art of precision and timing to outmaneuver your rivals. Bubble Tactics: Utilize bubbles as both weapons and shields. Strategically use bubbles to defend against incoming attacks. Bounce the Eye enemy away from you with a well-aimed shot. Dynamic Arenas: Engage in battles across diverse underwater arenas, each with its own challenges and opportunities. Adapt to your surroundings to emerge victorious. Knock around parts of the arena and use the environment to your advantage! Egg-citing Progression: Win matches to hatch one of your five eggs. Successfully hatch all five eggs to face the ultimate challenge: a boss fish showdown. Defeat the boss to unlock new and exciting playable characters. NOTE: All characters have the same abilities. Dive in today. Are you ready to make a splash and become the ultimate sea champion?
row.short_description: Dive into chaotic underwater battles that play out like billiards in Aqua Fry. Knock rivals into environmental foes, outsmart the colossal Eye enemy, and hatch eggs to face an epic boss. Cute characters mixed with strategic gameplay – the ultimate 2D, top down, local multiplayer frenzy!

row.name: The Valley of the Architects Playtest
Eye see fun
row.detailed_description: 'Eye See Fun' is an adventure and puzzle game that offers a rich combination of elements. In this game, players take control of an eye to interact with various objects in the scenes, unravel complex puzzles, and progressively unlock different environments. Adding to the excitement, players have the opportunity to assist non-playable characters (NPCs) in fulfilling their wishes within these diverse settings. It's not just a game; it's the tangible realization of the author's unique and imaginative ideas. The game's design philosophy emphasizes a relaxed and enjoyable gaming experience, completely devoid of any violent or explicit content. It is suitable for players of all ages to unwind and immerse themselves in the delightful atmosphere.
row.short_description: 'Eye See Fun' is a casual adventure and puzzle game with the main character being an eye. Players engage in the game by manipulating the eye and interacting with objects in the scenes to solve puzzles and unlock different environments. The goal is to help the eye find its companion.

row.name: Neon Digital
row.detailed_description: NEON DIGITAL BEND REALITY. MASTER PORTALS. DOMINATE THE ARENA. Enter the electrifying world of Neon Digital, where portal manipulation transforms traditional arena combat in adrenaline-fueled 3v3 or 1v1 matches on experimental server architecture. In this fast-paced tactical shooter, victory demands both lightning reflexes and strategic mastery of portal mechanics. REVOLUTIONARY PORTAL MECHANICS Deploy portals with pinpoint precision to create impossible angles, curve grenades through reality, and access areas your opponents thought were safe. Place portals at long range for tactical advantages or up close for devastating surprise attacks. Every surface is an opportunity to redefine the battlefield. ADVANCED PORTAL STRATEGIES Outthink and outmaneuver your opponents with creative portal placement. Set up complex chains of portals to send projectiles on unpredictable paths or create instant escape routes when under pressure. The most cunning portal strategists will always stay one step ahead. MULTIPLE PATHS TO VICTORY Adapt your strategy to secure victory through different objectives: Score in the opponent's net with skillful portal play Control strategic objective points on the arena floor Eliminate the entire enemy team with calculated precision DYNAMIC 3V3 TEAM GAMEPLAY Coordinate with teammates to execute complex strategies or improvise in the heat of battle. Different player roles ensure every match brings fresh tactical challenges and opportunities for creative portal use. MASTER THE CHAOS Neon Digital rewards creativity and quick thinking. The most successful players will combine strategic portal placement and team coordination to dominate the arena in style. Join the competition today and discover why players call Neon Digital the most innovative arena shooter of the year!
row.short_description: Shoot portals and curve grenades through them in this fast-paced 1v1 or 3v3 arena shooter. Place portals strategically to outmaneuver opponents on the battlefield. Win by scoring in the net, controlling objective points, or eliminating the enemy team. Master portal tactics to dominate the arena.
row.notes: Each player has space augmented guns that they can use to fire at other players while fighting in an arena over control points on the map.

row.name: Perished World Merchant EX
row.detailed_description: You play as Red 'the Merchant' Hunter, who has to explore a desolate world looking for supplies to survive and sell to travelers, so that they can follow their journeys and complete their quests. Every trade that you lose means that the chances of that buyer coming back is low. So is up to you to find what they want and to sell at whatever price you want. Open World for you to explore. Day & Night cycle that affect the behavior of your enemies. Watch your meters so you don't get Thirsty, Hungry or Tired. Characters will react differently based in your actions, such as talking with them while a gun is equipped. Any NPC can be killed. Multiple Endings
row.short_description: An Open World sandbox merchant game. Explore a dangerous world, find supplies, trade with other survivors, upgrade your character, crawl through dungeons and fight against dangerous enemies. Become the savior or the nightmare of the wasteland, is all up to you!
row.notes: This game contains scenes of explicit violence and blood.

row.name: Gravity Dash
row.detailed_description: Embark on an adrenaline-fueled journey through the neon-lit streets of a cyberpunk city in Gravity Dash, a 2D infinite runner that will test your reflexes and focus skills. Immerse yourself in the retro atmosphere, accompanied by a pulsating synthwave soundtrack that sets the tone. Master the art of gravity manipulation as you jump, dash, and switch gravity to overcome obstacles. Navigate through the void and skillfully dodge explosive barrels to keep your run going. Play through three distinct levels, each lasting 180 seconds. With each level, experience a new layer of difficulty that will test your skills and keep the excitement levels high. The longer you run, the faster you become. For gamers seeking a real challenge, venture into the infinite level without any time constraints. See how far you can push your limits as the difficulty dynamically increases, providing an endless challenge for the most skilled players. Gravity Dash is a thrilling race against time and obstacles in a cyberpunk setting. Can you dash, jump, and defy gravity to become the ultimate infinite runner? It's time to find out. Strap in and prepare for a wild run!
row.short_description: Embark on an adrenaline-fueled journey through the neon-lit streets of a cyberpunk city in Gravity Dash, a 2D infinite runner that will test your reflexes and strategic skills. Immerse yourself in the retro atmosphere, accompanied by a pulsating synthwave soundtrack that sets the tone.

row.name: 心霊旅館
row.detailed_description: このゲームについて 心霊旅館は、廃旅館から脱出を目指すレトロ3Dゲーム風のホラーゲームです。 主観視点と固定視点を切り替えながら、暗闇や不気味な音、さまざまな恐怖演出を駆使しあなたを恐怖のどん底に突き落とします。 あらすじ 新薬のテストに協力するアルバイトとして、山奥の施設を訪れた主人公。 しかし、その施設は廃旅館だった。主人公はそこに潜む恐怖に立ち向かうことになる……。 特徴 ・レトロ3Dゲーム風のグラフィックとサウンドは、プレイヤーに親しみや懐かしさ、そして...恐怖を感じさせます。 ・時には謎を解くだけはなく、襲いくる恐怖に対抗する必要もあります！ ・ 1時間程度でクリアでき、気軽に謎解きしたい人や、ホラーゲームを体験したい人におすすめです。 心霊旅館は10年前にリリースされ、累計3万本以上ダウンロードされた3D脱出ホラーゲームです。 最新のWindows10/11で動作できるようになり、FHD/4K解像度、キーバインドの改善、ゲームパッド対応がされ、より快適に遊ぶことができます。 その他 このゲームのストリーミング配信/動画配信及びその収益化は問題ありません。 不具合や質問がありましたらコミュニティの不具合報告スレッドにご連絡下さい
row.short_description: 「心霊旅館」は廃旅館から脱出する3Dホラーゲーム。 謎を解き、恐怖を乗り越え脱出を目指しましょう！

row.name: Vstar
row.detailed_description: Vstar: A place to record and enjoy moments with Virtual Stars Vstar is a VR Platform where you can save precious moments with your favorite virtual stars and, whenever you want, bring those cherished moments back to meet the virtual stars as much as you like. You can have the following experiences on Vstar. 1) Show off to others : You can dance, make fun poses, and talk sweetly in your favorite avatar.' 2) See other Virtual Stars : You can watch saved moments of other virtual stars. You can see them dance, make poses, and talk sweetly. You can dance with them, copy their poses, and look into their eyes when they talk sweetly.'
row.short_description: Vstar is a VR Platform where you can save precious moments with your favorite virtual stars and, whenever you want, bring those cherished moments back to meet the virtual stars as much as you like.

row.name: Instruction
row.detailed_description: Instruction is a story based clicker game where you, an employee of a power plant, are tasked with generating power for your city. The powerplant's built in intelligence mentor program, or I.M.P. for short, will help you generate the necessary amount of voltage to fulfill your quota. I.M.P may have developed a little too much of a personality for the powerplant's liking, but don't worry! It's still more than capable of keeping you on track. In this game you'll be tasked with using different systems to generate power. Each system works differently and can be upgraded to increase your efficiency. Discover each of the power plant's mechanisms, and uncover the story behind your less than friendly companion. Over 300 unique lines of dialogue 5 different systems to generate power Secrets and hidden interactions This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: Generate voltage while uncovering the mysteries of a power plant in this story-based clicker game.

row.name: Tenno
row.detailed_description: Step into the world of Tenno, a 2D MMO Turn-Based RPG that lets you become the ultimate ninja! Inspired by classic ninja RPGs, Tenno delivers thrilling strategic combat, deep character customization, and an expansive ninja world reminiscent of your favorite anime adventures. Explore 5 Elemental Villages: Choose Fire, Water, Wind, Earth, or Thunder, each with its own academy and unique jutsu to master. Learn Legendary Techniques: Train in the ways of Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, and Genjutsu, unlocking powerful jutsu and secret techniques as you progress. Customize Your Ninja: Stand out on the battlefield with six types of custom items: outfits, weapons, back items, hairstyles, faces, and details like masks or tattoos. Master Tactical Battles: Engage in turn-based combat, using your elemental powers and jutsu to outsmart enemies and rival ninjas. Join Epic Events: Unlock rare items and exclusive jutsu through limited-time seasonal events, keeping your ninja equipped for any challenge. Join a world where your ninja destiny awaits—master the elements, customize your character, and engage in thrilling battles in Tenno!
row.short_description: Create your ninja, master jutsu, and rise in the ultimate ninja saga RPG!

row.name: Don't Forget
row.detailed_description: Don’t Forget is a 3D singleplayer story and exploration game inspired by dementia. Recollect your memories by looking for clues and playing brain-stimulating minigames whilst battling the effects of your dementia. Piece together the story and don’t forget… Your head feels light and you wake up in a vaguely familiar place You wake up in a vaguely familiar place with only a journal at your side. You don’t know how you got here but maybe retracing your steps will help? Your journal is an anchor in guiding you through several spaces filled with fragments of your past. Recover your memories In order to understand what is happening to you and why, you need to explore three areas linked to your past and fill your journal with recovered memories by playing brain games. You feel like you lost a part of yourself Battle the effects of your illness and beware of its implications. As your journey continues, your perception of reality gets increasingly distorted. Dementia is not something you can control and this will be reflected the longer you linger in both the narrative and gameplay. Meet the team This game was made by a team of 6 students for the final group projects course in the bachelor Digital Arts and Entertainment at Hogeschool West-Vlaanderen in Belgium, during the course of 11 weeks. Special thanks Special thanks to the other people that helped to create this unique experience: our composer Frédérique Le Duc-Moreau, our poet Eve McIntosh, our two supervisors from DAE Tristan Clarysse and Dave Van Verdegem. A big thank you to Digital Arts and Entertainment for publishing our game.
row.short_description: Don’t Forget is a 3D singleplayer story and exploration game inspired by dementia. Recollect your memories by looking for clues and playing brain-stimulating minigames whilst battling the effects of dementia. Explore three different key events of your life to figure out what has happened.

row.name: Infinite Blue
row.detailed_description: An Immersive Ocean Animal Exploration Game Dive into the world of Infinite Blue, an expansive underwater exploration game where you can become countless different ocean animals and swim through a beautifully realistic ocean environment. A Massive Roster of Aquatic Animals Discover 50 unique species for you to embody on your journey through the depths. Small tropical fish, eight-legged cephalopods, sea turtles, stingray, sharks, whales and much more! An Endless Circle of Life You are what you eat and you become what eats you. Experience both perma-death and never-death as you will always become another animal after dying. Procedurally Generated Reefs Using a hybrid combination of procedural generation and hand-crafted environments you can explore the massive environment that changes every play while retaining a variety of unique feeling areas. Physically Simulated Creatures Realtime physics bodies help create complex movements for the unique physiologies of the sea, bringing incredible life and realism to their interactions with the environment around them. A Massive World To Explore Discover all the wonders of the world from the glistening shallows of Red Reef to the deep trench bottoms of The Abyss. You'll want to see every inch of this world as certain species are unique to their particular environment. You never know what might be lurking in the depths... SeaTuber Mode A special feature I added for V-Tubers and content creators that will sync your animals mouth with your microphone output allowing them to become your avatar for more immersive RP. Truly innovation at it's finest and not a silly idea that made me laugh. Developer Disclaimer: Infinite Blue is my first game using Unreal Engine and was built in around 6 months as a learning project for me to test out the many tools and features UE5 has to offer. It lacks some of the more complex RPG elements my other simulators have and is more of a Sandbox / Exploration experience. I hope you enjoy it and get an idea of the possibilities we'll have going forward with the new engine.
row.short_description: Discover an immersive ocean Eco-Sim where you can be almost any animal under the sea! From a tiny seahorse to a massive blue whale, experience the endless circle of life in a massive world of reefs, shipwrecks, and hidden wonders.

row.name: 唱舞全明星
row.detailed_description: 《唱舞全明星》一款充满挑战性和趣味性的音乐舞蹈游戏。在这里，你可以与众多志同道合的玩家一同起舞，畅享魅力四射的音乐与动感节拍；在这里，你可以展示自己的时尚搭配和创意，尽情表达自己的时尚态度；在这里，你可以与TA一同欣赏浪漫海边的烟花，沉浸在如诗如画的画面之中。 【邂逅浪漫，不期而遇】 邂逅浪漫，是一段美丽的旅程。在舞台上，你将与世界各地的舞友相遇，彼此间的那一瞬，仿佛时间凝固，心灵相通。这是一次不期而遇的奇妙邂逅，让你感受到世界的多样与美好。 【舞台挑战，全民组队广场热舞】 舞台绽放魅力，挑战全场的舞蹈盛宴。炙热的氛围中，众人齐聚一堂，组成默契的团队，共同演绎精彩的广场舞。音乐的节奏扣人心弦，舞步的律动翩然起舞，每个人都沉浸其中，尽情释放内心的热情与活力。 【指尖跃动，极限手速大挑战】 让指尖在音符间跳跃，让手速在挑战中燃烧。唱舞世界将成为你挑战自我极限的舞台，让你感受到手指舞动的魔力。以优雅的姿态和精准的击打，你将创造出一段段华丽的舞蹈，成为手速挑战中的巅峰玩家。现在，让我们一起投入到指尖的跃动和极限手速的大挑战中，展现你的绝技，征服音乐的世界。 【千变万化 ，打造最美换装达人】 这里，时尚的界限不存在，每一次换装都是一次艺术的创造。你可以探索各种不同风格的服装，从经典的复古款式到前卫的潮流时尚，从优雅的宫廷风格到酷炫的街头风貌，尽情展现自己的个性与风采。 【交友拍照，点赞送礼聊不停】 交友拍照是一种美妙的方式，让我们与世界各地的舞友相遇。在舞台的灯光下，我们可以留下珍贵的合影，记录下彼此欢乐的时刻。每一次拍照都是一次与朋友们共同创造的艺术品，让我们的友谊留存在每一张照片中。

row.name: ZomBay
row.detailed_description: ZomBay is a zombie shoot'em up game. In ZomBay, players will face relentless waves of the undead while defending their base and their own survival in various heart-pounding game modes, each with unique challenges: Zombay has 3 modes: 1. BASE ATTTACK MODE: is based around the idea of WW2's battle of Normandy, while using modern elements from past popular shooting games. Hence the name, ZomBay. 2. SWAM MODE: Survive waves of endless zombies and gain exp to get the best guns! 3. CLEAR MODE: Clear each level of zombie as quickly as possible to get the best score! In ZomBay you'll find yourself defending your base, as well as your player. In Base Attack Mode zombies will charge the barricades and break through while you desperately try to hold them back! In Swam Mode zombies will swarm the player and increase in numbers over time! In Clear Mode zombies will patrol the map and the player will try to clear the level as quickly as possible! Features: 1. Tons of UNIQUE guns, with ADS (Aim down sights) or alternative firing modes! 2. ZOMBIE HORDES! 3. Online leaderboards with anti-cheat 4. 'Roguelike' gameplay loop (No winning, only getting better each time!) 5. Tons of GPU instancing and object pooling for optimal game performance! 6. Unlock guns for free up to level 60! 7. Skill tree with upgrades to improve player performance! 8. Updates with new content and bug fixes!

row.name: SirKwitz
row.detailed_description: Embark on an enlightening journey into the world of coding with 'SirKwitz,' an introductory educational game designed to demystify the fundamentals of programming. This beginner-friendly game is a perfect entry point for young people and adults new to the field, offering a hands-on approach to learning basic programming, through a series of engaging puzzles. Over four main topics, each comprised of seven levels, players will explore key coding concepts: base logic, loops, orientation, sequences, and debugging. 'SirKwitz' combines learning with enjoyable gameplay, featuring a simple yet intuitive UI used to puppeteer our cute little robot which will help you translate programming concepts into instant action. The game focuses on developing core skills essential for budding programmers, such as problem analysis, spatial orientation, logic, and computational thinking, along with fostering attributes like focus and perseverance. Key Features: • Especially tailored for those who think 'programming' is a scary word; • Engaging, story-driven gameplay; • Simple yet complicated puzzles teaching core programming concepts; • Simple, clean & intuitive user interface, suitable for both young learners and adults alike.
row.short_description: Dive into SirKwitz: a beginner-friendly edutainment game that makes learning programming easy & fun! Explore 28 puzzles across four topics to master the very core concepts behind programming and develop your problem-solving skills. Ideal for those that think coding & programming are scary words!

The one who lurks in the shadows of the storyline and holds all the power, hiding his true abilities by acting like a side character. The boy who longs to be a 'Shadowbroker' lives an unobtrusive life as a side character, training to gain magic power until he's killed in an accident and reincarnated into another world. Reborn as Cid Kagenou, the boy decides to enjoy himself in this other world with a made-up scenario about 'the Eminence in Shadow.' He starts fooling around with secret maneuvers against an evil cult that he born from his imagination... and it turns out that the cult really does exist! The girls he took on as his subordinates on a whim began worshiping Cid as Shadow, and before he knows it, Cid has become a true 'Eminence in Shadow.' You have lost your memory. The words 'DON'T FACE UP' are left at your feet. Unsure of what it means, you proceed to explore the building. row.name: In The Shadows
row.detailed_description: Embark on a short yet captivating journey in 'In The Shadows.' In this game, players are tasked with manipulating abstract objects, harnessing the power of light and shadow, to cast silhouettes that form familiar shapes and objects. The Game The game was crafted as part of a school project in a month and a half with no prior experience in Unreal Engine 5. Every element was created by me, utilizing free assets, and the voice lines were graciously provided by my sister (thanks, sis). Should you encounter any bugs or crashes, please don't hesitate to report them in the discussion section. If you enjoyed this brief adventure, you can support me by purchasing the short soundtrack as a DLC. Gameplay Navigate through the game's world using the WASD keys for movement. The mouse allows you to look around and examine your surroundings. When engaging with puzzles, the mouse movement is crucial for rotating them. For additional interaction, right-click and drag the mouse to move puzzles along the last axis of rotation. Interaction with puzzles is made simple by holding 'E'. A hint will be displayed to help you figure out what shape to look for. Press 'Esc' to access the in-game menu. Within this menu, you'll find options to rebind movement keys according to your preferences and adjust various graphic settings to enhance or optimize your visual experience. Source code In the spirit of learning and sharing, the source code for 'In The Shadows' is available on my GitHub, which can be found in the game's information section on the right.

row.name: Gameartopia
row.detailed_description: GameArtopia - Virtual Playable Archive of Catalan, Latin American and International GameArt, is the first playable catalog on the subgenre of Game Art. With it we present works of artists recognized by the art system who have used the game and video game creatively, deciding to mark the focus of analysis in Catalonia, Spain and Latin America. With this archive we intend to map the multiple territories that Game Art has intervened and promoted, establishing links with communities, collectives and institutions that from Catalonia and the rest of the world create from this framework. In the spirit of Arsgames, we have decided to experiment with the archive format, taking advantage of gamification strategies to approach new audiences and create collaborative relationships with art collectives, museums, institutions and entities. The game, developed with Godot Engine software, allows access to more than 50 works of art. The game consists of a first-person visit to an island where the player can collect cards that represent works of art based on video games. In the inventory the player can explore the works and find more information about these works and their authors.
