row.name: Gods Against Machines Prologue
row.detailed_description: Wishlist the full game About the Game Machines are taking over your world! Their buildings destroy forests, their factories pollute the earth and water. The air is filled with the hum of drones and ships. Your home is dying! Gods Against Machines is an action-packed roguelite shoot'em up (with RTS ideas mixed in) where every run is different thanks to a wide variety of spells and blessings, as well as procedurally generated maps. Here is what you will do in a typical mission of the campaign: Protect your world - Huge crystals rising from the ground are your source of mana. Protect them and (optionally, if your build includes such spells) build your base around them with spells that summon different types of buildings - mini volcanoes that bombard enemies from afar, or spirit dwellings that spawn powerful sprites to fight for you. Cast Epic Spells - Use your offensive spells to rain down destruction on your enemies - literally! Fire Rain, Thunderstorm, Meteor Storm - all powerful destructive abilities that unleash your wrath upon the machines. Control Corruption - Prevent machines from spreading corruption - either by destroying their terraformers or by cleaning the corruption yourself using various spells or minions. Do not let it get out of control or you will lose! Destroy the machines - destroy enemy buildings to deplete their resources - when they run out, you win! Boss Battles - When all of the machines' resources are used up, one of their commanders will appear - prepare for an epic final battle! Reap as many rewards as you can - the less corruption your world has suffered, the more rewards you will receive! Acquire new spells, add new abilities to existing spells, and use powerful Blessings to improve your build and find game-changing synergies! But that is not all! Not only do you have several gods to choose from, each with their own special spells and mechanics, but there is also Gaia, the Mother of Nature. She will help you throughout the campaign and has her own special powers - and you will be able to activate some of them in each run! In addition, the game's roguelite progression is based on Gaia's powers: Meta Progression - Each run allows you to upgrade the abilities of Gaia, who will help you throughout the campaign. The more you play, the more powerful Gaia becomes, and the easier it will be for you to progress! Go beyond the normal campaign into the Void Realm - the game's endless mode. How far can you go? Synergize your powers with Gaia - Pick the right Gaia powers to activate and get crazy synergies that are otherwise impossible. Experiment, upgrade, and replay the campaign to get the overpowered build you need to conquer even the Void Realm! In this free prologue, you can play as two different gods and progress up to level 12 in the campaign. Try out over 3 dozen different spells, more than 50 blessings, and activate one of 3 available (9 total) Gaia powers. There are also 5 Achievements you can earn by completing the available part of the campaign.
row.short_description: Your world is under attack by a ruthless race of machines, and you are its only hope. Cast epic spells, summon minions or buildings, and destroy the enemy before they conquer your home in this action roguelite shoot'em up game!

row.name: Color Hunt - Number Jigsaw Puzzle
row.detailed_description: Color Hunt is a fun and relaxing puzzle game. It’s more than just coloring- it's a randomly generated number block jigsaw game that'll take your brain to another level! Gorgeous Art, challenging number grid block matching, jigsaw puzzle strategies with shape fit mechanics. Experience one of the most original board games, earn rewards and unlock new levels, solve puzzles which get larger each level, freely choose from all available puzzle pieces in a smooth scrolling ribbon, build up art galleries, complete daily levels & hundreds of missions…. In this unique and soothing game, you exercise your number, color and shape-based pattern recognition while resting your analytical mind in a tactile and meditative experience. WITH COLOR HUNT YOU CAN ▶ PLAY the full Coloring Jigsaw Board game experience offline and on the go. ▶ CLICK to play and navigate between 100+ levels, categories, daily levels, and missions ▶ GET more levels, category packs, and art exhibit customers. ▶ BUILD UP art galleries and daily level streaks ▶ EARN extra money by completing daily level streaks and mission. ▶ SOLVE over a hundred randomly generated grid based levels that get harder as you go. WHY PLAY COLOR HUNT? ▶ RELIEVE your stress with smooth and tactile jigsaw coloring controls ▶ LEVELS which get harder every time and require skills and pattern recognition to be beaten. ▶ CUSTOMIZE galleries by building and improving art exhibits for each completed picture. ▶ CONSTRUCT GALLERIES and attract an audience. ▶ LEARN to recognize number, color and shape based patterns on a randomly generated grid ▶ ACHIEVE infinite daily streaks and completion on hundreds of missions!
row.short_description: Number Grid Coloring Puzzle Game! Color Hunt is a fun and relaxing puzzle game. It’s more than just coloring- it's a randomly generated number block jigsaw game that'll take your brain to another level!

row.name: DR3AMy
row.detailed_description: 'Players, please break the chains of Amy's nightmares with DR3AMy!' DR3AMy is a psychological horror visual novel, centered around a dreamy Sci-Fi atmosphere and sensational soundtrack. This game contains visual and auditory horror elements. It is not recommended for the elderly or those with a weak heart. Story Amy suffers from terrible nightmares every night. These horrifying nightmares, dragging Amy into the abysmal depths, have been so lethal that they disrupt her daily life. One day, Amy woke up in a futuristic space filled with things she could've never believed existed in this world. As she woke up, the androids Cotton and Kana with 'DREAM-CODE', appeared. DR3AMy said, ‘By spending enjoyable time with us, we can completely break the chains of your nightmare!’ 'Amy, we're androids for your emotional health! Congratulations on being selected as a test user. We'll cure all your nightmares!' 'Hold up. So if I fill up this Dreamgauge thing with happy energy, it'll stop the nightmares? All I gotta do is just chat about nice stuff with you? …And that's seriously all it takes to make the bad dreams go away?' Extremely Straightforward Gameplay “Breaking free from the shackles of nightmares is a piece of cake!” The moon gauge in the upper right corner is called the Dreamgauge. Amy's Dreamgauge is filled to the brim with chaotic, dark crimson energy. If you fill the Dreamgauge with at least 70% Happiness, the nightmare will disappear. Q. How can the Dreamgauge be filled with happy energy? ① Endure nightmares every night. ② In the afternoon, have pleasant conversations with the DR3AMy android. ③ Then, the DR3AMy android will blow happy energy into Amy's Dreamgauge. However, they cautioned that a sudden influx of happiness energy can potentially lead to side effects . Moreover, they added that Amy must endure nightmares every night until they disappear to a certain extent from the dream gauge. Although there were some suspicious details, Amy decided to trust DR3AMy. Not only is DR3AMy intelligent, but also it seems like they are pretty good androids with rich emotions, almost like a real living human. ――Amy thought she could surely become good friends with DR3AMy. Maybe, just maybe. Enjoy a Fantastic Dream Journey! An immersive, SF theme that makes you feel like you're dreaming among the Milky Way's surging tides. A thrilling story filled with suspense, plot twists, and sociological imagination. Expressive characters and emotional illustrations. Built on the smooth 3D rendered Dreamy House and high-quality video sources, enjoy a fantastic dream journey!
row.short_description: 'Players, please break the chains of Amy's nightmares with DR3AMy!' Break free from nightmares with the lovely DR3AMy android and Amy. This game contains visual and auditory horror elements. It is not recommended for the elderly or those with a weak heart.

Key Features Convert audio files to MP3 AAC format Extract audio from video files to MP3 AAC formats Support batch conversion Very easy to use
row.short_description: Free Audio Converter is an all-in-one audio converter and extractor, you can also convert files in batches. allowing you to both convert between different format audio files and extract audio from video files to mp3 aac formats.

row.name: Pet Shop Simulator: Prologue
row.detailed_description: The prologue is only part of the full game and is completely free. Every player will be able to play it and see what awaits them in the full version of the game. Main features is Prologue: - there are only rabbits and fish - some of the products in the store are blocked - some of the objects in the store are blocked - in Prologue it is possible to buy one store next door If something is available or unavailable in Prologue, it is marked in the game. Run a pet shop Your main task in Pet Shop Simulator: Prologue will be to run a pet shop. Your duties will include not only finding wonderful new homes for the animals, but also ensuring that they have a wonderful and prosperous life. Therefore, supplement your store with the right assortment so that when you give your pet back, provide it with the right accessories. Make your customers' dreams come true All sorts of customers will come to your pet shop. From the elderly to parents with children, or students. Each of them will have specific preferences regarding the pet they want to surround with their care and love. Your role will be to make their dreams come true and find them a perfect home. Make sure you have the right equipment for your pets Choosing the right pets for your clients is not all you need to spend time on. It is equally important to provide each pet with the appropriate food, equipment, and accessories that they will take with them. You have to make sure that you choose the right cage size for your pets, offer the best food, brushes for combing fur, and remember about toys and treats. Every detail will translate into the well-being of the pet and the knowledge of the new owner! Manage and take care of your pet shop As the owner of a pet shop, one of the challenges that await you in the game will be the proper management of the entire shop. Check the assortment of stores, make orders, import specialized equipment at the request of your customers. Proper management of your business will bring you many benefits, but also will allow you to find a perfect home for your pets. Develop your pet business Manage and develop your pet shop, expanding its space, possibilities and assortment. Take care of your customers and their opinion, buy new properties nearby and grow your business!
row.short_description: The Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full version of the game. Run your pet shop! Find new homes for pets, thus fulfilling the dreams of your customers. Take care of the needs of animals by selling the right items and get involved in matters related to the pets home life!

row.name: Deconstruction Simulator: Prologue
row.detailed_description: In the free Prologue you can expect: DESTRUCTION Save/load system Company personalization 3 exciting contracts to complete 5 tools of destruction 5 tools for dismantling Wrecking ball! Set of orders to fulfill Garage expansion DEMOLISH, RECOVER, SELL Find the contract of your dreams. Demolish and dismantle. Recover building materials and valuable items, then sell them for profit or recycle them. Every contract presents a new challenge and opportunities to earn money. BECOME THE KING OF DEMOLITION Take apart houses and furniture piece by piece, or destroy them with a hammer and wrecking ball. Advanced destruction physics allows you to precisely plan every demolition action or embrace chaos and watch as everything collapses beautifully - rundown shacks or luxurious villas. PLAY YOUR WAY Do you want to be a respected professional? Or perhaps a shady operator? You decide which contracts to take on and how to approach them. You can follow the precise instructions of your clients or demolish everything whatever you want. However, remember that every violation impacts not only your potential payout but also the valuable reputation of your company! UPGRADE YOUR EQUIPMENT AND BUY PROPERTIES Once you’ve earned a substantial amount of money, invest it in growing your business! Buy a bigger vehicle, expand your warehouse, and upgrade your tools. Decide where you want your deconstruction business to go. There are many exciting decisions to make. DOMINATE THE DEMOLITION BUSINESS Gain experience and build your reputation in the contract market. Achieve higher levels of demolition permits, unlocking access to increasingly complex and better-paying jobs. Dominate the demolition market!
row.short_description: Deconstruction Simulator: Prologue is the ultimate demolition simulator, offering you complete freedom of action and a wide array of contracts to complete. Get ready for spectacular destruction.

row.name: The Rubberhose Forest
row.detailed_description: Welcome to a bone-chilling horror experience set a world inspired by the iconic Steamboat Willie cartoon and Slender: the eight pages. You are a daring cargo collector, navigating through an eerie forest, collecting valuable cargo while desperately avoiding the nightmarish duo, Mickey and Minnie. Once beloved characters, Mickey and Minnie have transformed into strange entities, their hollow eyes and eerie smiles haunting your every move. Your objective is simple: Collect valuable cargo scattered throughout the forest and return them to the dock inside a timeframe, while trying to not get caught. Be aware! The game uses you microphone, so keep quiet and everything should be alright. The base game was made as a small project for fun in about a week, with further updates added afterwards to improve on the gameplay.
row.short_description: Welcome to a bone-chilling horror experience set a world inspired by the iconic Steamboat Willie cartoon and Slender: The eight pages. You are a daring cargo collector, navigating through an eerie forest, collecting valuable cargo while desperately avoiding the nightmarish duo, Mickey and Minnie.

row.name: Challenger's Odyssey
row.detailed_description: Brand New Mode Update: Challenge Journey — Journey Mode! Adventurers, get ready for a pristine 3D top-down perspective RPG experience! Travel through the Mushroom Village. Engage in real-time generated and evolving events through keyboard typing and acquire items from these events to fend off the monsters that hinder your expedition, ensuring a safe passage through Mushroom Village! Text Adventure Mode Game Features In the game, you will face an NPC driven by GPT3.5. Accomplish real-time generated objectives through dialogue or actions, and participate in intense conflicts. Show the Golden Dragon your miracles! Defeat the invading demons! We have added a new key~ Please follow these steps to use it: 1. In the main menu, click on 'Get Public Key'. 2. After successfully obtaining the key, click on 'Advanced Settings'. 3. In the additional 'API Settings' section that appears below, click on 'Use Other API URL'. 4. Enter the URL: This way, you can use the new key to play.
row.short_description: Journey Mode Update! Dive into a brand-new 3D top-down RPG adventure world within Journey Mode. Engage in events generated in real-time, acquire items, and fend off monsters that block your way! Can you make it through Mushroom Village?

row.name: Goat Scourge
row.detailed_description: Quiet village life is disturbed by the attack of the Ogre Sorcerer, who needs goat bones for his magical experiments. The beloved pet goat of a village boy is stolen - and he risks it all to save the goat's life. Help him retrieve his pet - and explore the village and its outskirts in our game. The game contains several scenes in which the main character solves quests, explores the level with platformer mechanics, and confronts NPCs. The main goal of the character is to overcome all the obstacles, and save the goat. He will face the antagonist, whose aim is to collect the artefacts for his magic potion. You will have a chance to play for both of them. The entire game is quite short: you will jump on an adventure and will be done in less than an hour. But what an hour it will be! This game was made with MANU Video Game Maker - no-code game engine! Controls: Movement - WASD; Jump - Space; Interact - E; Interface buttons - 1-5; Menu Interaction - Enter; Attack/Chop - LAlt; Goat Minigame - 1-3; Quest Open/close - Q
row.short_description: Quiet village life is disturbed by the attack of the Ogre Sorcerer, who needs goat bones for his magical experiments. The beloved pet goat of a village boy is stolen - and he risks it all to save the goat's life. Help him retrieve his pet - and explore the village and its outskirts in our game.

row.name: 激战王城-三国
row.detailed_description: 《激战王城》突破传统策略游戏的束缚，快速开荒橙将开局，范围连地快速铺路，独创模拟比武，无需战损也可验证阵容。 组建自己的阵营，义结群雄共创大业；亦可勇战各路豪杰，夺取无双荣耀；还可剿灭异族捍卫九州，一统万里江山。100万格多变沙盘恭候各位主公的降临，谁又是下一位天下之主？ 【橙将开局 - 首抽重刷 无惧锁卡废卡】 无需担心开荒阵容，首抽无限重置，抽到满意再开局。打破传统锁卡禁锢，百位名将悉数登场，无双阵容随心搭配，每位主公皆可大展宏图霸业。 【快速开荒 - 范围占领 拒绝通宵开荒】 创新辐射连地，视野所见皆可占领，拒绝逐格铺路熬夜爆肝。首次攻占资源地、城池均可额外获得丰厚的首占礼包，颠覆以往三国策略游戏的枯燥体验。 【无损试将 - 独创阵容演练 摆脱战损负担】 想验证阵容但心疼战损？钻研配将却无人可以切磋？独创模拟沙盘玩法，为各位主公提供脑力演练的绝佳战场，你的谋略不再是纸上谈兵！
row.short_description: 《激战王城》突破传统策略游戏的束缚，快速开荒橙将开局，范围连地快速铺路，独创模拟比武，无需战损也可验证阵容。组建自己的阵营，义结群雄共创大业；亦可勇战各路豪杰，夺取无双荣耀；还可剿灭异族捍卫九州，一统万里江山。100万格多变沙盘恭候各位主公的降临，谁又是下一位天下之主？

row.name: Guano
row.detailed_description: Play as Guano, a dumb seagull that has a lot on his shoulders! While the protectors of the Pohemeda Islands, the Three Grand Masters, are neutralized, you’re the only hope to rescue your home. Food Inc., an evil and polluting megacorporation, seems to have set its mind on destroying every natural aspect of your archipelago. Get strong enough to stop Food Inc. before their garbage overtakes the islands! Your mission, should you choose to accept it, is to wreak havoc in the Food Inc. installations, by pooping, screaming and stealing the food of tourists attracted by the corp and its leisure-filled resort. Use the stolen food to feed the Grand Masters, restore their strength and acquire their powers through a very sacred ritual: Regurgitation. Fly at incredible speeds in a stimulating open-world, populated by goofy characters! Friends or enemies? Race against them through breathtaking landmarks to discover new powers! Save the Pohemeda Islands from Food Inc, a megacorporation polluting the heavenly archipelago. Get help from three powerful Grand Masters to succeed in your quest. Finally get the chance to drop a dookie on those pesky tourists! Yell at Food Inc. employees until they go flying! Steal their food just like they stole your land!
row.short_description: Play as a delightfully dumb seagull, find food and complete quests to help free the Grand Masters and gain their powers. Harrass humans and free the Pohemeda Islands from the evil Food Inc. with your powerful poop and loud screams!

row.name: Zarathustra - Cybergeddon
row.detailed_description: In the aftermath of The Inflection, a momentous event that unveiled cosmic truths and alien technology, two religious factions emerge: the Church of Flesh, embracing chaos and free will, and the Church of Neon, upholding order and stability. Amy, an FBI agent affiliated with the Church of Neon, carries with her a unique asset: a cybernetic implant housing the consciousness of a past individual—you, the player. Together, you navigate the complexities of a case involving a book stolen from the Church of Flesh. This investigation is set against the backdrop of a world grappling with the implications of its newfound enlightenment and the delicate balance between these two divergent philosophies. Zarathustra is a classic point and click adventure with inventory and dialog puzzles. It's a rather casual experience with no dead-ends or overly difficult puzzles.
row.short_description: Take on the role of Agent Amy Tanner and solve a case in a cyberpunk future, where technology and religion have become one - A classic pixel art point&click adventure.

row.name: Bolt'N'Punch
row.detailed_description: Food for Thought strives to deliver the best food products to the common people, but when its robot workers turn against Lyft, the last human in the factory, she has to step up and punch some steel. Uncover the truth behind this attack, find your boss for answers, and put an end to this with style and power. Unleash powerful blows to enemies, use them as a weapon and utilize the environment to your advantage. Delve deep inside Food for Thought 's factory and unravel the dark secrets that have been hidden for many years. Encounter a variety of enemies that can punch, shoot or block your attacks. Finish them off in style with a devastating blow.
row.short_description: Exploring a disarrayed food factory, play as Lyft and fight your way through this chaos using powerful abilities. Face off against relentless robots and bring them to pieces. There’s only one option left to stop them: destroy them, throw them, PUNCH 'EM!

row.name: Stories to Tell [Alpha 1] - Run Away
row.detailed_description: Stories to Tell is a saga of psychological horror video games where each episode is based on dreams/nightmares that I, the developer, have had. (the episodes are short). -This is the first video game in the saga. In 'Stories to Tell - Run Away' you are a young Spanish man named Mike who is staying at his grandparents' house since his parents have gone on a trip. One night his grandparents went out to dinner and Mike was all alone, or so he thought... key features of 'Stories to Tell - Run Away' -VHS aesthetics. -Dialogues between characters.
row.short_description: In 'Stories to Tell - Run Away' you are a young Spanish man named Mike who is staying at his grandparents' house since his parents have gone on a trip. One night his grandparents went out to dinner and Mike was all alone, or so he thought...

row.name: Erentis, l'académie de magie
row.detailed_description: Un MMORPG gratuit ( free-to-play ) dans un univers imaginaire. Nécessite peu de ressources graphiques et jouable via l'application Steam ou par navigateur sur PC ou Smartphone. Devenez apprenti magicien, intégrez l'école de magie Erentis et spécialisez-vous dans l'une des quatre magies élémentales pour élucider le mystère lié aux esprits frappeurs. De nombreuses activités en solo vous attendent : quatre territoires à explorer en monde ouvert, rencontrez des personnages haut en couleur et approfondissez vos liens avec eux, des combats PVE stratégiques en tour par tour, de la récolte, du farm et du craft, de nombreuses professions tel que l'alchimie, l'enchantement, l'herborisme, la guérison et la cuisine, et des donjons remplis de monstres à traverser façon roguelike. Vivez l'expérience d'un MMO : commercez avec les autres joueurs et enrichissez-vous, intégrez une guilde et faites croître sa puissance, et entretenez l'environnement et l'académie pour éviter leur dégradation. Un jeu vidéo indépendant aux graphismes 2D originaux et uniques, régulièrement mis à jour avec plein de nouveautés. Aurez-vous l'audace d'aller au bout de cette aventure ?
row.short_description: Un MMORPG 2D free-to-play dans un univers de fantasy avec des combats en tour par tour, des professions avec un gameplay uniques, des dialogues avec choix de réponses et bien d'autres fonctionnalités !

row.name: Screen TRPG
row.detailed_description: ScreenTRPG is a free 3D Virtual Tabletop tool for TTRPGs(tabletop role-playing games). You can create your own adventure scenarios and play online with friends, which is similar to a virtual tabletop platform, with extended features. Design you campaigns! With ScreenTRPG, you can build up the scenes where your story takes place, with a variety of map components, including mordern and fantasy style, You can draw the terrian and adjust the weather. You can import your own model into the scene and use it the the adventrue. Play with friends online! You can create your own room and invite your friends to join the game. The Gamemaster can change the game settings while hosting the game. You can chat with friends and use dice-roll commands in chat window. Private Chat is also supported. Create your character! You can create characters by filling up the self-calculating character sheet. Different TRPG rule system will have different sheets.  You adjust height, weight, facial features, and colors of the character. You can also change the statistics of your game character during the game using chat window. Share your creations in the Community! You can upload your campaign to Steam Workshop. You can also download models made by others from Workshop and use in your game.  Please note: The game is not a finished product. It is still under development status.  More features will be added in the future. So the game is still a beta build. In the future, users will be allowed to compose and share their own TRPG rule system!
row.short_description: A game for online tabletop role-playing, where you can play solo adventures, join friends for multiplayer role-playing, and even create your own story.

row.name: The Cyber Masquerade
row.detailed_description: Kinetic visual novel. (Only Main heroine is fully voice-acted.) The year is 2052. In a dystopian future where no one goes outside. Birth rate at an all time low, suicide rate at an all time high. On the Rings of Atlantis, a ring of artificial islands built to withstand the rising sea level, a degenerate loner attempts to revive a stolen android. The attempt to jailbreak fails at first, until it didn't. To his surprise she wakes up. Playful, poetic, philosophical, and perhaps even a little possessive. Beneath her charismatic demeanor she hides a dark secret. Unravel the city together with her. Nothing in the world compares to the real thing. The frequent sexual content disclaimer is off, I am trying to get the ratings removed, there is no sex in here, so if you're here for tits and tits only, you might want to reconsider reading it.
row.short_description: Degenerate loner jailbreaks a stolen android.
row.notes: Mention of self-harm. Mention of nudity. Mention of content that is sexual but no explicit sexual scenes.

row.name: MR 333 II: Planetbirth
row.detailed_description: After leaving the portal you are taken HOME. Home of origin will require you to seal off entities linked from escape portal. It will not take long for them to follow back, and thus opening the doorway for MR 333. Failure to complete the ritual you embarked on will open your home to the being and his entities wish to ensure this happens. The only way to seal off and continue the ritual is to birth a prison planet in their realm, a place where the vibrations can hold them and not give them reign in yours. Become pregnant, birth a planet and seal off the entities. MR 333 II: Planetbirth features a first person perspective with frantic gameplay requiring you to locate items, fight entities and run from enemies existing in your realm. Navigate the house after returning 'Home' and explore the surrounding areas. Rebuke entities and run from those corrupted. Become pregnant with the planetary fertile snake and fight the entities through each trimester. This is a small sequel to MR 333 that features an additional level to take place directly after the completion of the ritual from the previous game.
row.short_description: Fight back entities and run from those they persuade as you seal the portal before MR 333 is given access to the world of your home.

row.name: DragonLoop: Prologue
row.detailed_description: This is the prologue of DragonLoop. The prologue version is the first hour of the official edition. DragonLoop is a 5-day timeloop metroidvania, with the prologue being a specially customized 3-day timeloop of 1 hour content. Players will be able to play some of the areas in this episode over a 3-day timeloop. Please wishlist the DragonLoop if you like this game. The heroine who lost her memory was trapped in a five-day loop. Together with your partner, travel through a world with strange time changes, escape from reincarnation through exploration and combat, and learn the truth about the world! In the cycle, you will regain your memory and continue to become stronger. You can take advantage of new abilities, explore new areas, and defeat new enemies. You can also go back to the old area, defeat enemies that are different from what you remember, and try to change your known destiny. The game is a time loop Metroidvania. Change of time Dynamic world! Enemies, maps, NPCs... many contents will change over time. The game has a special timing method that allows you to explore as much as you want. Fight happily Easy-to-learn, fast-paced and smooth combat! Use the flexible [Link] to dash forward quickly, combine combos, and summon practical plants to assist in combat. Boss battle Use your powerful performance to engage in high-speed duels with dangerous bosses with different styles!
row.short_description: The heroine who lost her memory was trapped in a five-day loop. Connect with your partners to travel through a world with strange time changes, continue to become stronger, retrieve memories, and understand the truth. The game is a time loop Metroidvania.

row.name: That Way!

row.name: SWORD OF JUSTICE
row.detailed_description: “Sword of Justice” is sparking a rebellion against outdated RPG builds! This groundbreaking Open World MMO defies tradition with stunning visuals and an immersive, lifelike atmosphere that deeply influences the game world. Step into 'The Pulsing Martial World' and experience its breath-taking allure. Premium Quality, Top-Tier Artistry “Sword of Justice” is adapted from the classic literary masterpiece “The Four Great Constables: Sword of Justice” by Wen Ruian, one of the 'Four Grandmasters of Chinese Martial Arts Literature.' Combining pure Oriental classical aesthetics with modern chip graphics technology, it creates a unique and refined art style.It offers a solid single-player Open World RPG experience, blending the joy of inclusivity with a rich and layered sparring system. No Grind, No P2W, Your Journey, Your Way Sword of Justice introduces the groundbreaking 'Paths Converge' system, where both competitive and casual players can earn full rewards through their preferred playstyles. The game abandons tedious grinding and shatters outdated MMO conventions, offering a stress-free experience. As the first season-based open-world MMO, the game offers hundreds of skills and pieces of equipment across its vast world for players to explore and acquire without paywalls. Open World, Endless Possibilities Players step into a vast open world, rich in Eastern aesthetics and the breathtaking scenery of the Song Dynasty. Roam the land, conquer peaks and caverns, and seek out lost weapons and martial techniques. Solve ancient puzzles and uncover wonders. Master martial arts to battle mythical beasts and outlaws across the wilderness, gathering rare treasures. Beyond combat, Sword of Justice brings the bustling streets of the Song Dynasty to life. Players can perform, test their skill in archery, preside over court trials, and engage in nearly a hundred professions in a world inspired by Along the River During the Qingming Festival. Unparalleled Competition, Challenge Accepted The game breaks free from traditional class restrictions with a revolutionary martial arts system. Tanks can heal while healers can unleash powerful attacks. Players can combine hundreds of martial skills freely to create unique fighting styles—your game, your rules. Epic Dungeons, Stunning Visuals Rally legendary heroes for epic dungeons, and feast your eyes on unique weapons, stunning skill effects, and cinematic combat animations. Solo Gamers' Haven, Relax and Play Breaking away from traditional online games that force players into mandatory team-ups, the 'NPC Companion System' enables solo players to tackle group dungeons, making gaming less stressful. “Sword of Justice” emphasizes the joy of diversity and values the experience of laid-back players. Its 'casual light gameplay' is exceptionally rich, offering equal core rewards. Farming, fishing, chess, sightseeing, travel, and archaeology—activities often considered 'offbeat' in traditional RPGs—take center stage in Sword of Justice. Sword of Justice invites players to step into its pulsing martial world. Together, we'll forge a new era of MMORPGs. Every encounter in the world is written by fate.

row.name: The Lost Glitches
row.detailed_description: Play Your Story The Lost Glitches is what happens when a bunch of card nerds, storytellers, and artists asked: “What if a deck was more than a win condition — what if it was your story?”  So we built a world where your cards don’t just play, they speak. This is a game where deckbuilding meets character progression, where your strategy evolves as your avatar does. With layered RPG mechanics, open-ended build paths, and faction mixing that encourages experimentation, The Lost Glitches invites you to play with intention, and identity.  There’s no single way to win here. No perfect list to copy. Just a city full of memory-hunters, code-benders, and digital ghosts waiting to see what kind of story you’ll tell through the cards you choose to bring to the fight. Features Play your army strategically, only 5 slots available. 300+ cards to collect Play ranked against players of your level Monthly season with booster pack rewards based on your rank Complete daily, weekly & monthly challenges Fair reward system of packs and items that promotes gameplay and strategy Play private unranked matches with friends Persistent progression with 3 skill trees, with 20+ skills each. Bring 3 skills to battle Growing inventory of cosmetics like avatars, sleeves and more to come Immerse Yourself in a Cyberpunk World Step into a world that feels like it’s been patched together from old code, forgotten dreams, and neon scraps. The Lost Glitches throws you into a cyberpunk universe buzzing with energy, where hackers are heroes, and memories are more valuable than currency. It’s part card game, part RPG, all style, made for those who get a kick out of cracking systems and crafting wild decks. No hand-holding, no fluff, just you, your cards, and a city that’s alive with static. Strategic Depth with Zero Hand-Holding Every match in The Lost Glitches is a mental dance — no gimmicks, no cheap wins. Just pure tactical thinking and raw decision-making. Build your collection card by card, shape your character over time, and grow stronger not because the game gave you a shortcut, but because you figured it out. Progression here isn’t dressed up in flashing lights. It’s slow-burn satisfaction. The kind that comes from unlocking synergy, pulling off a crazy combo you built from scratch, or turning a losing hand into a last-turn win. This is for players who want to think, not just click. Victory’s never handed to you — it’s earned! Skill-Based Mastery The Lost Glitches rewards true TCG enthusiasts who take pride in their strategic brilliance. Outthink and outmaneuver your opponents in matches that highlight your expertise. Experience the satisfaction of mastering a game that values your skill over chance. The Lost Glitches delivers for both Pilots and Builders alike! Unmatched Stunning Art Luck might hand you a win once, but The Lost Glitches is built for players who thrive on outthinking their opponents. Every match is a mental duel. You study the board, play the long game, and pull off wins not because the stars aligned, but because you earned it. If you enjoy learning the ins and outs of every card, crafting smart plays, and watching your strategies unfold exactly as planned, you’re in the right place. Grimy, Poetic, Indie Grit The art in The Lost Glitches isn’t just eye candy. It’s part of the code, part of the story. Cards don’t just sit there — they flicker, pulse, breathe. Every detail feels like it was ripped from a corrupted hard drive and stitched back together with neon thread. This world is messy, strange, and beautiful. Exactly how it should be. Creative Freedom Without Limits No rigid deck archetypes. No locked-in combinations. You build how you want. Smash together different syndicates. Stack up wild combos. Create something nobody saw coming. If you’ve got an idea that sounds crazy on paper but might just work — try it. Half the fun is in the experiment. The other half is when it actually works. A Collector’s Playground with Real Stakes There’s something special about pulling a card that wasn’t meant to be easy to find. That rush, that moment. We get it. The Lost Glitches is full of those moments. Rare drops. Limited editions. Cards that feel personal because they were earned, not handed to you. And soon, what you collect won’t just sit in your account, it’ll be yours to trade, show off, and take pride in. Style Is Part of the Strategy Decks don’t have to just function. They can speak. From avatars and card backs to emotes and effects, TLG gives you tools to make your style loud, subtle, or somewhere in-between. It’s not about showing off, it’s about making your presence known. When your deck hits the field, it should feel like you. Start Your Journey You don’t need to know everything to begin. You just need curiosity and a little fire. Whether you’re here for the strategy, the collection, the art, or just to see what happens when you throw a weird deck into the ring, there’s a place for you in The Lost Glitches. Let’s see what you can do.
row.short_description: The Lost Glitches is a Techno Optimist Trading Card Game with RPG progression. Head to head PvP battles require strategy, unique deck construction and clever wits to climb the ladder.

row.name: Raiverb
row.detailed_description: Raiverb is a versatile localization assistant. Its main feature is an intelligent translator, built to work with AI from the ground-up, able to provide context-aware and accurate translations, following your directions, your glossary and every bit of context you will be able to provide. The translator is fast and cost effective. Raiverb also comes with a range of tools to ease various daily localization tasks: an OCR image-to-text extractor, an LQA tool, a WYSIWYG (What You See Is What You Get) Editor, among others. Raiverb is built to be as intuitive to setup and use as possible. Import your game or app's translatable data effortlessly from spreadsheets or from a variety of popular formats, accompanied by comprehensive context, and let Raiverb handle the rest. Adjust as needed, either within Raiverb, or other software. The languages currently available for translations are: English, French, Chinese, Spanish, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hindi, German, Portuguese. Key features: Translation * , Proofreading * , LQA: Ensure accurate translations with built-in translation, proofreading or LQA. (read below for limitations) Common Formats Supported: Import content from various formats including .XLSX, .DOCX, .PO, .POT, XML-based (beta), HTML, and PDF (experimental). Leverage Translation Memories and Glossaries: Use your existing Translation Memories (.TMX, .XLIFF) and Glossaries for consistency and/or generate them dynamically within Raiverb. This allows for interoperability with other CAT tools for review and proofreading. A WYSWIG Editor: Having to review and edit texts full of tags or had to decipher variables? The easy WYSIWYG editor will allow you to see exactly where you are, add or edit new tags, make sure there are no errors, but also include more advanced functionalities, such as sentence splitting. It will even allow you to see your glossary matches! Will also detect the language automatically. TM Converter: Included converter for Translation Memories. No need to use a dedicated software or even no particular knowledge required. Extensive Customization: Tailor your output by defining character limits, providing contextual information, or referencing previous translations. Image Recognition: Import images (JPG, BMP, PNG), extract text, and auto-detect language. Flexible Export Options: Save your translated content as you need it: in its original format (see list of supported formats in manual), export to a spreadsheet, or integrate with other software. Archiving and Editing Functionality: Automatically record all translated content for proofreading, confirmation, and reuse. Industry compatible: Raiverb doesn't lock you in and doesn't force you to keep a credited account to access your data: export your data at any time, compatible with all other software. * Translation and proofreading are free within certain limits (request length, speed and daily usage), free servers are provided for testing and experimenting. Sustained use will require a participation allowing access to priority servers. Other functions are unlimited and do not connect to any server.
row.short_description: Localize your games or apps faster and easier, add new languages or translate your updates with ease. Raiverb is a versatile localization assistant, capable to leverage your existing content to deliver context-aware, accurate and fitting translations. Includes a range of quality-of-life features.

row.name: EDYN
row.detailed_description: EDYN  plunges you into a dynamic multiplayer realm where you forge mighty settlements, command vast armies, and clash with rivals in epic PvP warfare with no Pay-to-Win or catchup mechanics . Embark on a grand quest to shape a living world with your strategic brilliance, forging alliances and conquering foes to etch your legacy into EDYN's history. In a land teetering on the brink of chaos, only the sharpest minds will unify the realms and bring order to EDYN. Build, Expand, and Conquer! Your journey begins with one of eight distinct factions, each offering their unique perspective of the world. Your faction can also determine your allies and rivals. Although considered teammates, the sandbox nature of EDYN means that these bonds are not set in stone. You have the freedom to forge or break alliances whenever you see fit. Should you wish, fallen members of your faction can be revived back into the world of EDYN in order to assist your cause. Though beware, reclaiming a fallen ally’s settlement is no small feat. In an ever-evolving world, your choices define your destiny. Will you unite under a common banner or carve your own path to supremacy? Begin your journey by constructing essential structures to gather vital resources like gold, wood and food for your troops. Transform your humble settlement into a sprawling empire. Delve into deep resource management, balancing production and expenditure to fuel your expansion. Invest wisely in building enhancements, army recruitment, and technological advancements to outpace your rivals. Your economic acumen will be the backbone of your dominance. Assemble an unstoppable force from a diverse selection of units, each with unique strengths and battlefield roles. Whether you prefer overwhelming foes with sheer numbers or deploying elite squads for precision strikes, tailor your military to reflect your unique strategy and ambitions. From your War Room, lead grand campaigns against NPC settlements and rival players. Launch daring raids to seize resources, deploy specialist units to crush enemy defenses, and halt their offensive. Conquer all of EDYN and assert your supremacy. Forge powerful alliances and engage in intricate diplomacy. Utilize in-game chat and direct messaging to conspire with allies, negotiate pacts, and influence the world's fate. Support your friends with resources or troops, and together, leave an indelible mark on EDYN. In EDYN, the true test lies not just in expanding your territory or advancing your settlement, but achieving legendary status. Through cunning diplomacy or decisive warfare, make your mark on a world where only the most exceptional rise to the top. Attain the ultimate accolade—exclusive, ultra-rare cosmetics reserved for the elite. These unique rewards persist across new servers, eternally showcasing your unmatched status for all to see. Do you have what it takes to seize the crown and become a legend, forever woven into the history of EDYN? There’s only one way to find out. Stand out on the battlefield with extensive customization options for your avatar. Unlock exclusive cosmetics through seasonal events, achievements, and progression milestones. Express your identity and let your legend be known throughout the realms. Note: Our in-game shop is purely for in-game cosmetics and will not impose an advantage or in-game mechanic advantage for participating.   Be among the first to shape EDYN's future. Dive into exclusive Early Access content and experience new features before anyone else. Connect with our community on Discord, share your insights, and influence the game's development with your feedback. A world on the brink awaits a leader. Gather your forces, strategize your conquest, and embark on an epic journey to become a legend in EDYN.
row.short_description: Join the battle for EDYN, the ultimate multiplayer strategy game. Build settlements, command armies, and unify the realms in epic PvP warfare to etch your legacy into history. Raid, loot, make alliances, and unite to conquer the planet itself, with no Pay-To-Win mechanics to upset the playing field.

row.name: Messorem
row.detailed_description: A compelling narrative about death You play Messorem, a graveyard reaper. Your job is simple, guide the souls of the dead to eternal rest. After many years of the same job, Messorem starts to wonder if there is more to their life. Messorem stops doing their job and the souls no longer have someone to guide them to rest. One day a woman named Mallory arrives at the cemetary with her deceased son. In exchange for putting her son's soul to rest Messorem can finally get eternal rest themselves. To put the son to rest however, Messorem must gather his family for the funeral. The only problem is, the family is spread apart and the roads are filled with the frenzied spirits Messorem have neglected. To gather the family, Messorem must travel across the land and put all souls to rest. Magical combat arenas! Once combat is initiated, an arena is created from the element used to initiate the fight. Each arena has its own effects that can both affect the player and the enemy! Messorem's combat utilizes both melee combat and a ranged magic system. Each spell has their own effect and based on a rock, paper, scissors system connected to their own element. Wield nature's magic and choose the correct spell to put the frienzied souls to rest! Puzzles! To get an audience with some of the family members, you must complete a puzzle related to their personality. So get your dance shoes on and get ready to impress! Music by SHINE! The soon-to-be music phenomenon SHINE provides the music with the «Sounds From The Afterlife - Concept Album For Messorem». The norwegian 8-piece delivers an astounding 65+ minutes of live orchestrated music that paints the world of the game with a magical assortment of sounds, genre-variety and instrumentation. SHINE brings the action and drama to new levels with the two vocal-tracks «The Final Hour» and «Shimmer». From blistering speed-metal to folky J-pop undertones, the band delivers audible spectacle like no first-time Indie game has ever seen (or in this case heard) before.
row.short_description: An emotional journey about death, family and acceptance. Step into this thrilling narrative driven Action-RPG to experience an exciting combat system and a story tackling deep themes.

row.name: 100 KILLS CHALLENGE: ORIGINS
row.detailed_description: ADD TO WISHLIST About the Game 100 Kills Challenge is a fast-paced first person shooter, combining the bloody reality of modern combat with a return to basics: Kill one hundred enemies before anyone else. How you do it is up to you: Be brutal, be clever, fight on your own or as part of a team, just be the first to reach one hundred kills. Remember the rules: There are none. All that matters is reaching one hundred kills: Fighting as a lone wolf in 12 player deathmatch, as part of Blue or Red teams in team deathmatch, or facing a computer-controlled onslaught in our brutal PVE modes. And remember: The amount of ways to kill will increase, as the game is being constantly expanded and developed! About 100 KILLS CHALLENGE ORIGINS: Only the death match mode and 2 maps are open, with a total of 19 weapons to choose from. The official version will have a team death match mode, 12 maps, and more than 40 weapons.
row.short_description: Enter the fray in an intense, fast paced first person shooter experience. Kill using firearms, explosives, drones, and air support. Dominate maps in deathmatch, team, and PVE. Win with tactics - or sheer brutality. Remember: Hundred kills. One arena. Zero rules. May the best player win!

row.short_description: Snow Cone Serenade is a short and sweet liminal adventure. Choose your mood and roll the dice to succeed or fail in spicy situations. Enter a cursed snow world to save your sick dog, Jedediah. Unravel a mind-bending mystery to face your innermost fears.

row.name: Tangles - تشابك
row.detailed_description: History, Truth, Dreams In the heart of an isolated island, a deserted camp sets the stage for a mysterious military mission. A team of 8 soldiers arrive for this mission. During the first days of training for the mission, Soldier Basel sustains a serious injury that leads him to a prolonged coma. Upon awakening, he discovers a startling reality – all those in the camp have vanished, leaving behind a trail of enigmatic secrets. Embark on the journey, piece together the mystery, uncover the secrets surrounding the mysterious disappearance of the other soldiers, and discover the secrets of the mysterious mission. Psychological Horror: Encounter psychological horror elements that go beyond jump scares. Be prepared for a storyline that twists and turns, leaving you questioning reality and adding a unique psychological depth to the gaming experience. Stunning Graphics: Tangles boasts high-quality graphics that bring the mysterious island and its secrets to life. Explore the detailed environment as you unravel the mysteries that shroud the camp. Hidden Secrets: The adventure doesn't end with the main storyline. Engage in optional side missions after completing the game to discover five hidden secret documents scattered throughout the camp. Each document provides unique insights into the island's history and geography. Engage with the intricate storyline, solve puzzles, and unravel the twisted events that await you on the mysterious island.
row.short_description: Awakening from a long coma following a training injury, Soldier Basel finds himself alone in an isolated camp on a deserted island surrounded by questions and mystery. He begins to search for answers to uncover the secrets, and whether they are painful truths or terrifying illusions.
row.reviews: “Tangles manages to deliver a gripping psychological horror experience that leaves a lasting impression. This is a game for people who have lost their cats in real life, in this game, players can DIY their own cat image.Players can run with cat,earn gold coins, buy cat food in the cat star scene, and continue to complete the fate of feeding and accompanying cats.

row.name: Battle Clash
row.detailed_description: Battle Clash is a medieval multiplayer PVP game with 10 unique classes, each with their own abilities. When the match starts, each player begins as the classic Knight class. From there, after every death, players either get to choose their next class, or have it assigned randomly (depends on match setting) There are 10 medieval classes in the game, and they each have their own unique set of skills: Knight: Primary: Sword Slash Secondary: Shield  ULTIMATE: Blitz Archer: Primary: Bow & Arrow Shot Secondary: Bow Shove ULTIMATE: Ruthless Heavy: Primary: Battleaxe Bludgeon Secondary: Dash ULTIMATE: Rage Wizard: Primary: Spell Cast Secondary: Staff Shove ULTIMATE: Fireball Assassin: Primary: Dagger Stab Secondary: Double Dagger Strike ULTIMATE: Cloak Swordmaster: Primary: Katana Slash Secondary: Katana Thrust ULTIMATE: Barrage Spearman: Primary: Spear Thrust Secondary: Spear Spin ULTIMATE: Impale Arbalist: Primary: Crossbow Bolt Shot Secondary: Crossbow Shove ULTIMATE: Surge Farmer: Primary: Pitchfork Stab Secondary: Charge ULTIMATE: Stampede Miner: Primary: Pickaxe Slash Secondary: Pickaxe Slam ULTIMATE: Avalanche Choose Your Battleground - 3 Maps! Weather Choices - Spice up the visuals! Toxic Emotes - Taunt with these classic medieval emotes, of course And yes, if you're reading this far... the characters are naked. You're seeing that right. For bug reports, visit our Steam Discussions, and fill out the annonymous google form! So what are you waiting for? Battle in the Clash right now!
row.short_description: Battle Clash is a fast-paced medieval PVP game where 10 unique classes battle for victory. Master each class's abilities, rack up kills, and unlock powerful ultimates to crush your enemies. Dominate the battlefield and lead your way to the win!

row.name: Wizzerd Quest
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the mysterious land of Wayword! Wizzerd Quest is a bite-sized open-world RPG with full splitscreen co-op. Its aesthetic and gameplay sit somewhere between DOOM and Daggerfall, and it's designed to be a fun little excursion without wasting your time. The full game, which is totally free, includes: A main story quest that takes you all around the open world (Takes ~3 hrs to beat the game) 6 classes, assigned dynamically based on leveling 8 enemy types plus two bosses 12 hand-crafted dungeons 3 towns with facilities such as banks and traders Over 40 NPCs, all with unique, witty and funny (according to the devs) dialogue A full day-night cycle A voiced opening cutscene with cringe voice acting straight out of 1995 The ability to ATTEMPT BARTERING WITH FARM ANIMALS Absolutely ZERO microtransactions, network telemetry or invasive DRM Kondoorsoft offers this game to you totally free of charge. But make no mistake: this is no mere marketing demo. It's a full game, given freely to the community in the hopes that it will bring entertainment to those that play it. But if you like it and wish to support us, consider looking at the rest of our game catalog.
row.short_description: Wizzerd Quest is a bite-sized open-world RPG with full split-screen co-op. Its aesthetic is straight out of the mid 1990's, and it's designed to be a fun little excursion without wasting your time. Play the entire game for free with zero microtransactions or DRM!

row.name: Neon Runners: Craft & Dash
row.detailed_description: Neon Runners: Craft & Dash – The Ultimate Racing & Running Game! Get ready for an action-packed racing with simple controls! Compete in fast-paced running races, conquer stages, and defeat monsters in a thrilling sprint to victory. Unleash your creativity in the Level Maker, share your designs, and challenge the world to fun, neon infused races! This is the core mode that defines Neon Runners : Four enter, but only one emerges victorious. Race against three opponents, each equipped with powerful abilities, and be the first to reach the goal. The courses are filled with game-changing power-ups and gimmicks that add excitement—or chaos—to the competition. Daily Contest Take on the ever-changing Daily Contest map to receive amazing rewards. The greater your skills, the better the rewards that await you! Stage Mode Clear 100 unique stages and test your racing skills. Collect super coins to level up and grow your character! Endless Mode Keep the challenges going in Infinite Mode. Show off your skills without any limits and dominate the leaderboard! Build and Share Your Own Levels! ■ Create your own levels with a simple and intuitive level editor. Design race tracks that are nearly impossible to conquer or create the fastest route imaginable. You can even craft challenging puzzles that will push your friends to their limits! ■ Create with the community! Share your custom courses with the community and showcase your creativity. Build your own racing kingdom and become the star of your maps! Race with Style Discover your favorite among a cast of vibrant and distinctive characters that can change the game. Experiment with different Runners or master a single one to showcase your true skill. Receive rewards based on your mastery level and unlock exclusive character skins for each one. Neon Runners: Craft and Dash
row.short_description: 4 enter, 1 leaves! Dash, design, and dominate in high-speed neon races! Race against 3 others, choose runners with unique skills, and unleash powerful power-ups. Compete globally in daily time attacks or create your own custom courses to challenge the world!

row.name: Ảo Mộng Tru Tiên - Gamota
row.detailed_description: Ảo Mộng Tru Tiên là game MMORPG do Perfect World phát triển chuyển thể nguyên gốc từ tuyệt phẩm Tru Tiên nổi tiếng và được NPH Gamota độc quyền phát hành tại thị trường Việt Nam. Tái hiện thế giới tiên hiệp sống động, đồ sộ và đầy màu sắc, Ảo Mộng Tru Tiên là phiên bản kế thừa những tinh hoa, viết tiếp hành trình chinh phục game thủ trong suốt nhiều năm qua. 1. Đồ Họa Đỉnh Cao - Không Lo Giật Lag Cải tiến engine đem đến chất lượng đồ họa tuyệt đẹp, sắc nét đồng thời tối ưu cấu hình trên nhiều thiết bị, đảm bảo trải nghiệm mượt mà. Người chơi thỏa sức khám phá con đường tu tiên hay chiêm ngưỡng tiên cảnh trong game mà không lo giật lag 2. PK Cực Đã - Thỏa Sức Va Chạm! Trong Ảo Mộng Tru Tiên, người chơi được tiếp cận tới nhiều hoạt động PvP, PvE độc đáo, có chiều sâu. Tham gia những trận PK 1vs1, 3vs3, 5vs5 nảy lửa hay cùng chiến hữu đạt Vương Giả Tranh Bá vang danh khắp chốn. Có thể nói Ảo Mộng Tru Tiên là trò chơi thực tế có nhiều hoạt động trong game bậc nhất 3. Ngự Kiếm Phi Hành - Săn Boss Tung Hoành Trong Ảo Mộng Tru Tiên có hẳn cơ chế Ngự Kiếm Phi Hành. Người chơi có thể cưỡi những thanh bảo kiếm, ngang dọc trên bầu trời, chu du thiên hạ, trừ gian diệt ác 4. Biến Hóa Thời Trang - Ngoại Hình Tùy Chỉnh Ảo Mộng Tru tiên có kho ngoại trang đồ sộ, người chơi tha hồ lựa chọn những bộ cánh bảnh bao hay những tà váy yêu kiều cho nhân vật của mình, ngoài ra người chơi có thể tùy chỉnh diện mạo, ngoại hình cho nhân vật một cách cực kỳ chi tiết 5. Đa Dạng Môn Phái - Đỉnh Cao Chiêu thức Với 15 môn phái khác nhau và vẫn có lộ trình phát triển thêm, Ảo Mộng Tru tiên là một trong những game có số lượng Môn phái đa dạng và phong phú bậc nhất. Mỗi môn phái trong game đều có những thế mạnh riêng cùng hàng loạt chiêu thức đỉnh cao để người chơi khám phá Còn chờ đợi gì nữa, tải Ảo Mộng Tru Tiên ngay hôm nay và nhận nhiều phần quà siêu xịn từ NPH Gamota!
row.short_description: Ảo Mộng Tru Tiên là game MMORPG do Perfect World phát triển chuyển thể nguyên gốc từ tuyệt phẩm Tru Tiên nổi tiếng và được NPH Gamota độc quyền phát hành tại thị trường Việt Nam.

row.name: Bond Blues
row.detailed_description: Christopher has started his new job as an assistant, others would say, an enforcer, for a bail bondsman in Burlington, Vermont. Does he take a gentler, or more forceful touch? When he begins to notice things beyond his pay grade, how does it play out? Learn what a bail bondsman is Small town intrigue Fully voiced Hand-drawn art 12 emails 29 music tracks A visual novel made for the CasualCord Game Jam 2022 - After a year in development, hopefully it's been worth the wait.
row.short_description: It's 2026, and you're a bail bondsman in Burlington. A fully voiced visual novel exploring the obligations of duty, and what justice really means.
row.notes: A gun is in the game and gun violence occurs in one of the endings. A character can commit suicide offscreen.

row.name: IVRI
row.detailed_description: IVRI immerses players in a gripping space adventure where they navigate an eerie, abandoned space station, meticulously piecing together the puzzle of the missing crew and uncovering the enigmatic secrets hidden within the ship's walls, delivering an enthralling narrative experience. A Space Narrative Horror Game: ● 20+ rooms to explore ● Windows 95 aesthetic ● Fun puzzles ● Time travel shenanigans ● Humorous dialogue ● Eerie and Cute Enter the chilling world of IVRI, a gripping horror game where you embody Ollie Rex on a mission to uncover clues about the vanished crewmates. But as you delve deeper, an ominous presence lurks aboard the ship, trailing your every move and unleashing chaos at every turn.
row.short_description: IVRI is a space-station exploration game in which you navigate an eerie, abandoned space station, piecing together the puzzle of the missing crew and uncovering the secrets hidden within the ship's walls.

row.name: 乾坤盘
row.detailed_description: 《乾坤盘》的故事发生于一次突如其来的战争当中，你将扮演一位隐居山野的修行者，通过刻画符阵的方式，拦截北方游牧民族踏入中原的铁蹄。 在这款游戏中，你体验到如下内容： 1、经典的棋盘式塔防模式 2、紧张刺激的三场BOSS战 3、有趣的中国传统游戏 4、新奇的强化系统 5、丰富的配音剧情
row.short_description: 《乾坤盘》的故事发生于一次突如其来的战争当中，你将扮演一位隐居山野的修行者，通过刻画符阵的方式，拦截北方游牧民族踏入中原的铁蹄。游戏采用经典的棋盘式塔防设计，你在“乾坤盘”画下的每一笔，都将演化为战场上的符阵，抵挡以纸人形象呈现在“乾坤盘”上的北朝军队。

row.name: Crystal Conquest
row.detailed_description: Crystal Conquest is a Free-To-Play VR game where you control the elements and battle for victory. Imagine the elemental magic of Avatar in VR across fighting, MOBA, and level based campaign modes! Key Features: Play as elemental mages - 4 available by default, unlock more over time Choose which spells to take into battle, unlock more over time Customize your in-match shop - choose your potions, wands and other items, unlock more over time Different modes to suit your mood: Duel (1v1), Conquest MOBA (3v3) or Gauntlet (players vs waves of enemies) Single player or Multiplayer Private lobbies available, bring your friends Skills-based matchmaking to pair you with equal opponents Shape the game's future by communicating with the Studio on Discord Build your mage:  Choose the class that matches your playstyle and elements. Unlock class variants as you grow and customize your build. Harness the elements:  Battle with elemental magic where each element has unique properties. Use earth, fire, water, and wind to block, dodge, and deflect your enemy's attacks. Grow in Power:  Level up and unlock even more epic spells that change how you control the elements. Choose Your Battle Mode:  Battle in 3v3 matches to capture crystals and topple towers, face off in duels, or team up in co-op to take on waves of AI. All modes support AI for solo or practice play.
row.short_description: Crystal Conquest is a free-to-play VR game where you control the elements and battle for victory. Harness the power of fire, water, earth, and air in epic 3v3 MOBA-inspired combat or intense dueling modes!

row.name: Purrfectly Hidden Cats - Kittenrock
row.detailed_description: UPCOMING GAMES MORE KITTENS About the Game Purrfectly Hidden Cats - Kittenrock' welcomes you to a richly interactive 2D world set in a picturesque mountain resort. The hand-drawn scene in Kittenrock is a labor of love, brimming with intricate details, natural beauty, and humorous Easter eggs, inviting thorough exploration and discovery. The gameplay blends classic hidden object mechanics with a unique twist—interactive people and cats around the map, enhancing the engagement and depth of the experience. Your primary goal is to spot the skillfully hidden cats that merge seamlessly into the scenic resort surroundings, often revealed through playful interactions with the environment and its inhabitants. Beyond the joy of discovering cats, the game unfolds engaging mini-stories that add layers of depth and charm. These stories are woven into the fabric of Kittenrock, creating a narrative that celebrates exploration and curiosity. In 'Purrfectly Hidden Cats - Kittenrock,' the game's zoom feature enhances your experience: zoom in to uncover intricate details and interact with characters, or zoom out to admire the whole scenic beauty of the resort. Whether you prefer a close-up exploration or a broader perspective, the game offers a uniquely engaging and visually stunning journey, encouraging you to discover hidden cats and enjoy the diverse landscape of Kittenrock. Engaging hidden object gameplay with an emphasis on observation and interaction. Interactive characters that add dynamic layers to the gameplay. Mini-stories linked to each discovered cat, enriching the game's narrative. A vast, interactive mountain resort environment filled with delightful Easter eggs. Distinctive line-art graphic style enhancing the game’s visual appeal. Soothing and immersive background music, perfectly matching the game's rhythm. A variety of achievements to encourage exploration and reward your discoveries.
row.short_description: Welcome to the enchanting 'Purrfectly Hidden Cats - Kittenrock' resort! Uncover hidden cats in a captivating mountain setting, complete with nature, cabins, and campgrounds. Delve into charming mini-stories and find surprises in a world that's playfully inviting!

row.name: LowPoly Towerdefense
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Lowpoly Tower Defense! In this game, you have to manage resources and towers to prevent the enemies from reaching their goal. You'll be battling LowPoly SciFi enemies in a desert! But be aware: Resources are quickly depleted! You need to ensure a steady supply. Moreover, your opponents will increase with each round! Utilize the interim periods to construct towers, organize resources, and fortify chokepoints with towers. This game is designed as a supplementary activity for an instructional course and is developed without any commercial intentions. If you wish to recreate this game for your personal use, please contact the publisher! Now, enjoy building and best of luck! Best regards, Holger Instructions Welcome! After the game has started, simply click on Desert Fight in the Main Menu. Now you can move using WASD. First, you should build resource ships (click on the building directly in front of you). The ships will then fly to the silos and collect resources on their own. You can unlock additional silos - just click on them. Make sure you have enough resources to unlock a silo. Use the resources to build towers on the platforms, which will automatically attack the enemies. The towers have a limited range - try it out. Try to catch all enemies and pay attention to their paths. If you let too many enemies escape, you lose. The enemies appear at the top left in three different locations and then move down to the three caves on the bottom right. There are a maximum of 15 rounds! Good luck!
row.short_description: You play in a SciFi environment with LowPoly graphics, engaging in Tower Defense. Manage resources! Each round introduces more enemies that you must defeat. Build resource ships in the factory and simultaneously construct towers on the platforms to fend off the adversaries.

row.name: The Bridge to Yesterday
row.detailed_description: Embark on an intimate journey through the remnants of a post-apocalyptic world in this heartfelt single-player adventure game. Take on the roles of two sisters, each blessed with unique abilities, as they collaborate to surmount obstacles and unearth the secrets shrouding their past. Upgrade your camp to increase your strength, stamina, and spirit for the treacherous journey ahead. Pick up resources along the way and meet a small cast of other explorers in this weird landscape. Solve puzzles to unlock new areas and be wary of the environment for clues on how to solve them. Unlock new abilities to help with the purpose of both combat but also dealing with the evil creatures along the roads of the forest. As players traverse the desolate landscapes, they'll gradually unveil fragments of the sisters' memories, immersing themselves in a narrative that explores themes of identity, resilience, and the unbreakable bonds of sisterhood. Crafted with dedication and passion by a close-knit team of six students from ITU Copenhagen, this cozy adventure invites players into a world brimming with charm and nuance. With its captivating visuals, poignant storytelling, and inventive gameplay mechanics, this indie gem promises an unforgettable experience.
row.short_description: Step into a beautifully crafted world, where you'll embark on an emotional journey filled with intrigue and danger. Explore the touching relationship of two sisters, their struggle for survival, and their unwavering determination in a world where the past crumbles and the future is uncertain.

row.name: Rama's Quest
row.detailed_description: Rama's Quest is an action survival game where you equip unique weapons and get divine powers from the gods to help you face endless demons in the forest. Become Rama, the legendary archer Wield your bow against challenging swarms of demons that haunt the Dandaka Forest. Invoke Divine Powers Meet Vishnu, Arjuna, Krishna, and more legendary gods from Hindu mythology. Perfect your builds by invoking their boons. Fight unique enemies The forest contains Rakshasa with various attack styles, like sword slashing, ground slamming, spear throwing, and more Face Powerful Bosses Fight through powerful Rakshasa bosses to win Join the community Join the Discord to keep up with updates and new releases from Roadtrip Games.
row.short_description: Rama's Quest is an action survival game rooted in Hindu mythology. Invoke divine powers from the gods in your custom builds as you face waves of Rakshasa demons.

row.name: Lights Off: Director's Cut
row.detailed_description: Lights Off: Director's Cut Welcome to 'Lights Off: Director's Cut', an immersive horror game that preys on the universal childhood fear of darkness. This fully re-imagined edition of the acclaimed indie game plunges you into a chilling atmosphere where the simple act of turning off the lights becomes your worst nightmare. Game Features: Seven Nights of Terror: Each night, the darkness grows more suffocating, and the horrors lurking in the shadows become more cunning. Three Distinct Endings: Can you find all three? Steam Achievements: Unlock Steam Achievements for finding the secret endings Fully Free: 'Lights Off: Director's Cut' is completely free to play. Experience the full terror without spending a dime. Dare to Turn Off the Lights?
row.short_description: Play through a common childhood fear about turning the lights off and going to bed. This time extended, remastered, and re-imagined.

row.name: Battle Babes
row.detailed_description: 🔥 Welcome to Battle Babes: The Ultimate Fantasy Turn-Based Strategy Card Game! 🔥 Embark on an exhilarating journey with Battle Babes , a brand spanking new, action-packed free-to-play card battle game. Master the art of strategy with 3+ dynamic hero decks and over 600 distinctive cards, each boasting unique magic, powers, and abilities. Immerse yourself in thrilling fast-paced battles where smarts, luck, and skill lead to victory. Personalize your decks and dominate in epic snap duels against challenging AI opponents! Are you ready to lead your Battle Babes to fame and glory? Base Game (Free to Play): Includes access to the following Hero Power Decks: Fire, Water, Nature DLC 1: Battle Babes: Blood, Sun & Moon Adds the Blood, Sun, and Moon Hero Power Decks. (Includes all content from the base game.) DLC 2: Lightning Adds the Lightning Hero Power Deck. (Includes all content from the base game and DLC 1.) DLC 3: Love & Death Adds the Love and Death Hero Power Decks. (Includes all content from the base game, DLC 1, and DLC 2.) DLC 4: Lust, Space & Shadow Adds the Lust, Space, and Shadow Hero Power Decks. (Includes all content from the base game and all prior DLCs.) Choose the decks that suit your playstyle, and dominate the battlefield in style! 🌟 Key Game Features: 🌟 3 Playable Hero Powers: Fire, Water & Nature! (Claim 1 Free Starter Deck Immediately) Battle 18 AI Hero Power Decks: Blood, Sun, Moon, Lightning, Love, Death, Lust, Space, Shadow, Wind, Frost, Astra, Earth, Air, Ocean, and more for epic AI challenges! Defeat Challenging AI Boss Decks: Dragon Clan & Succubus Queen. Earn Coins, Buy Card Packs. Collect 600+ Blessed Cards! Dynamic Turn-Based Combat: Engage in electrifying battles, blending deep strategy with an element of chance. Expansive Card Collection: Over 600+ unique cards featuring formidable babes, each with their special abilities and rich backstories. Deck Customization: Tailor your deck with a diverse mix of babes, spells, secrets, and artifacts to outmaneuver your opponents. Exquisite Artwork: Dive into a world of stunningly illustrated cards and breathtaking landscapes. Frequent Updates & Events: Stay engaged with regular additions of new babes, challenges, and rewards. Interactive Tutorials: New to card games? No problem! Our babes will guide you through the basics. Beginner-Friendly: Learn the ropes with interactive guides, making it easy for newcomers to join the fun. Play Solo: Practice against Advanced AI which shows no mercy. 🌌 Join the Battle Babes Universe: 🌌 Engaging Strategic Gameplay: Easy to learn, yet challenging to master – like mastering the art of walking in stilettos. Regular Content Updates: New cards, new babes, new ways to conquer. We keep it fresh so you'll never get bored. Continuously evolving gameplay with new hero powers and characters, keeping the experience fresh and thrilling. Expanding Fantasy World: Regularly introduced new cards and characters ensure an ever-evolving battleground. Battle Babes: A realm where sass meets class, elegance meets energy, artistry meets ambition. Sharpen your skills, customize your decks, and engage in fierce battles against worthy adversaries in the AI realm. Join the Battle Babes saga today and shape your path to glory! Say hello to Battle Babes, the epic single-player collectible card game that’s here to take over! Get ready to collect, strategize, and battle your way to victory with the sassiest, most powerful babes in the realm. Battle Babes, where fantasy, fun, and fierceness collide in a collectible card game like no other! You want a game that's easy to dive into but offers deep strategic play. What are you waiting for? Don't make these babes wait! 💋
row.short_description: Battle Babes is a fast-paced, free-to-play single-player turn-based strategy card game. Collect, strategize, and battle your way to victory with 3+ hero powers! Experiment with 600+ unique cards, each with their own special abilities. Customize your decks and challenge AI decks to a fight!
row.notes: Some outfits are more revealing than others. No nudity.

row.name: Genopanic: Prologue
row.detailed_description: ✨ WISHLIST FULL GAME ✨ About the Game Step into the World of Genopanic: Prologue Embark on an Intergalactic Adventure! Dive into the thrilling universe of Genopanic with this Prologue, offering a taste of the epic journey ahead. Perfect for newcomers and veterans alike, immerse yourself in a world where you can master the game's style and controls, all while getting a tantalizing preview of the adventures that await. A Compact, Rich Experience Designed to be completed in under an hour, the Prologue introduces you to the very beginning of our expansive story. Battle a formidable boss and get a glimpse of the challenges and triumphs that lie ahead in the full game. Discover the Gameplay Mechanics Experience a selection of the gameplay mechanics that make Genopanic unique. Although just a part of what the full game offers, the Prologue provides a solid foundation of what to expect in terms of gameplay and strategy. Stunning Visuals and Atmosphere The Prologue shares the same striking graphics and visual style as the main game. Every frame is a piece of art, setting the stage for the incredible journey that unfolds in Genopanic. A Sneak Peek into the Genopanic Universe Perfect for players new to the series or those eagerly awaiting the full release, the Prologue serves as an introductory chapter to the vast, mysterious world of Genopanic.
