Sample of Combat - Engage in a thrilling boss battle that showcases the dynamic combat system. Familiarization - Get comfortable with the game's controls and mechanics, setting you up for success in the full game. Visual and Audio Treat - Enjoy the same high-quality graphics and atmospheric soundtrack as the main game. Prepare yourself for an unforgettable journey with Genopanic: Prologue - your gateway to a grander cosmic adventure!
row.short_description: Enter 'Genopanic: Prologue,' the beginning of a dynamic story in a Metroidvania-style experience! Wield a plasma cutter, team up with your virtual dog LAIK, outsmart the cunning cat-girl AI VOLGA, uncover the secrets of Dark Matter, and delve into DNA experiments in a galactic adventure.

row.name: Let Them Breathe: Hello Mother
row.detailed_description: 06/21/2024 We have another winner to Let Them Breathe: Hello Mother Speed Run Event: GandaCu. Feel free to watch the video below; we sent him a comment and hopefully we can work out his prize soon! 06/08/2024 We were hoping to set up a pre-record of the speed run of the winner but it seems it may be too advanced for our small team at the moment so instead, here is the speedrun. This winner was the sole participate of the event but hey, even so, they got a cash prize: Let Them Breathe: Selena's Awakening is our next project scheduled for September 2nd, 2024. We hope to have the game play trailer out on the 17th so you all can add it to your wish list. Buzz We have a WINNER for the Speed Run Event. The winner will be announced the same day we announced the title of the upcoming game currently in production. So expect later this month! 03/02/2024, 09:07 PM CDT This game does not have a tutorial. To play the game, one must think of the general mechanics of a PC game. For instance, if the mouse clicker is hidden on your screen when starting the game then click the 'windows' icon on your computer so as the mouse can appear. 03/8/2024, 11:44 AM CDT We're quite please to see the good reviews for Hello Mother. And yes, we also saw the discussion on the page; for a game to be submitted on , a player needs to request it. Now we could request it ourselves but that would mean we would also have to participate within the run's contest. 04/23/2024, 5:43pm CDT It has come to our attention one can not submit the game to Speed Run unless they are a well known user. As a result of this finding, if submitting to the speed run event: 1.) Upload to Youtube 2.) Email or comment the Youtube Link to us 03/17/2024, 12:52 PM CDT So glad so many are enjoying the game! Also there will be no more updates for this game. We are in the mist of working on our next game. Still, good luck to all those who enter into the contest! About the Game Mrs. Chen, the mother of Jesse Chen, is asked to pick up some documents; these documents reside at the University of Tokyo where she used to work. Upon her picking up these documents, she engages with audio recordings and diary entries that tells her what exactly took place in the experimentation room. Follow Mrs. Chen and discover more about the world of Let Them Breathe. In this walking simulation and collectable game, you will explore a small abandoned laboratory. Within the different compartments of the library, you will find items in which you will be able to engage with such as recordings, and documents in which you have to collect so as to win the game. In this casual short game with a spice of thriller, the atmosphere allows for the player to walk the environment to discover what took place within various locations of the game. The player will find out more about the location, and the two individuals who once occupied the space prior to the player's arrival. Let Them Breathe: Hello Mother is a video game that takes place within the Let Them Breathe franchise. It tells the story of Mrs. Chen who is the mother of one of the characters in the indie web series and even the indie movie, Let Them Breathe: City on the Ocean.
row.short_description: Mrs. Chen is asked to pick up some documents; these documents reside at the University of Tokyo where she used to work. Upon her picking up these documents, she engages with audio recordings and diary entries that tells her what exactly took place in the experimentation room.

row.name: Loop Theory
row.detailed_description: Immerse yourself in the game created on the Unreal Engine 5. Solve puzzles, make your way through various rooms, use objects and find out more about the fate of the main character. Average time to complete the game: 45 minutes This is a story-oriented horror game. Take part in the mysterious investigation of the crimes of the most ordinary family. The narrative in the game does not provide direct answers related to the paranormal story of the main character, so you will have to collect the missing pieces of the puzzle yourself. Will you be able to get answers to questions about your character's past and present? During the passage of the plot, you will come across notes and inscriptions, study them! Waiting for you: - A mysteriously changing house - Riddles - An ambiguous plot ATTENTION: The game contains images of violent scenes that can have a negative impact on the psyche.
row.short_description: Loop Theory is a horror game in which every minute spent in the game changes your idea of the story. Take on the role of a character with a mysterious past and find out about what happened.

row.name: Passing Into Fantasy
row.detailed_description: Jordan Jones, mild mannered engineer, was showcasing a nuclear reactor at an anime convention, when the worst of disasters struck. A magical substance known as contrivium was spilled onto his reactor model, causing the convention center to undergo a magical girl zombie apocalypse. Both merchandise and attendee alike have undergone startling transformations into malevolent magical girls. In the ensuing chaos, Jordan was bitten by a radioactive cosplayer and became the superheroine known as Lunar Heart Skydancer. Along with her friends, she now must defeat the evil sorcerer-of-culture, Victor Haqdev, who is using his foul chaos magics to force every animal, mineral, and vegetable into his harem of magical girls. Will Jordan and the other survivors escape this anime-convention-gone-wrong, or will she experience humiliating objectification? PIF is a top-down shooter with a shmup soul. Dodge hundreds of bullets in 360 degree danmaku. You'll not only need reflexes, but clever wits to analyze the challenging spell card patterns. In retro fashion, the game has few features save one: save you the player as much time as possible and keep you engaged in the action, with perhaps a few minutes of indulgence into a very comedic plot.
row.short_description: Otaku culture inspired top-down danmaku shooter.
row.notes: This game is naughty enough that you'll not want to play it in front of your grandmother. (Or maybe so, if she happens to be a babushka-of-culture. I won't judge.) There's censored nudity and a few adult conversations. Nothing explicit. Both hands will be required to play the game.

row.name: ChatBBT
row.detailed_description: ((Warning: This game contains quick flashing light)) Artificial intelligence is all the rage nowadays! You can't walk down the block without someone saying 'AI this!' or 'AI that!'. What does it all mean? The future seems so uncertain!? If only there was some way to get away from it all, return to a simpler time, a time where we could live without fear of AI generate images' or LLVM induced singularity's cold, silicon breadth pouring down the back of our neck, and retreat to some good old homegrown software. Software that takes us back to a carefree time... an AI free time... ChatBBT proposes to simulate just this innocence we've all been pining for, and ChatBBT is powered by THE most cutting edge AI to bring you the experience of conversing with the epitome of innocence itself: A baby. Features: Ask ChatBBT all the questions you've been dying to ask a baby since your foregone infancy Acquaint yourself with Binderclipply: ChatBBT's built in assistant Customize your profile Become hyperfixated on the graveyard that is progress Take a look at the Q&A section (maybe there's some helpful stuff there) Confront your own mortality Maybe think about upgrading to a premium membership? Wrestle with your lack of free will Rate ChatBBT responses, providing feedback so we can improve this top of the line baby technology Plunge headfirst into the mystic visions you always knew God would provide you with
row.short_description: Explore the fictional, baby themed chatbot, ChatBBT, in this short, story driven adventure to the heart of the psyche, led by none other than software's leading assistant, Binderclippy. Go ahead... Ask 'BBT something! Anything!!

row.name: A 20-year-old RPG Maker game remade with the latest RPG MAKER UNITE and available for free?! ~The Heroes of the RPG Maker series vs. the Demon Lord~
row.detailed_description: ◆A Game Created 20 Years Ago, Now Remade with the Demon Lord as the Star! The legendary game born 20 years ago with RPG MAKER 2000 is making an unexpected comeback with the latest RPG MAKER UNITE! (This is the storyline setting, and the RPG MAKER UNITE version is real!) But it’s not just a simple remake—this time, the main character is the Demon Lord! The legendary heroes who have colored the history of RPG Maker, transcending time and the boundaries of works, are gathering and beginning their fierce assault on the Demon Lord’s castle! As the player, you will defend against them as the Demon Lord. Can you withstand the heroes’ fierce attacks and maintain the dignity of the Demon Lord’s army? ◆A Surprising Combination of Tower Defense × Shooting!? This game, made with RPG MAKER UNITE , is a tower defense shooting game utilizing Unity’s features!! Repel the heroes who attack one after another with magic, traps, and the monsters of the Demon Lord’s army! Recruit monsters to build the ultimate formation! Use the shooting elements to attack and scatter the heroes! The heroes will attack with a variety of skills and equipment. Depending on your monster formation, create your own strategy to defeat the heroes who will attack one after another! ◆ Don’t Miss the Treasure Chests on the Map! When it comes to adventure, treasure chests are a must! But these treasure chests in the game aren’t just item supply points... Surprisingly, the treasure chests also contain comments from RPG MAKER series developer Mr. Ojima Yoji ! There are some never-before-released behind-the-scenes stories, so fans of the series definitely should check them out!
row.short_description: The game that was created 20 years ago with RPG MAKER 2000 has been remade in the latest RPG MAKER UNITE!(←the story setting, but it's true that RPG MAKER UNITE was made!) Let's enjoy this new RPG Maker experience, which fuses nostalgia and chaos!

row.name: Nothing Together
row.detailed_description: Discord Server Join our Discord Server to talk about Nothing: About the Game The hardest game you're ever going to play together. Maybe. Just do Nothing as the timer goes up and climb the leaderboards. If you do Something, you lose. Play in Together mode, where up to 20 players unite to do Nothing, or compete with other players in Battle Royale to find out who's the best at doing Nothing!
row.short_description: A game about doing Nothing Together

row.name: Mini Settlers: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Mini Settlers: Prologue is a free version of Mini Settlers. In this minimalist city builder, settle islands, construct cities, and design efficient logistic networks to fulfill your buildings' needs and fuel population growth to adventure into new worlds. Build your buildings and factories to harvest resources and create new ones to expand your cities and industries. Build a well-connected network of roads, trains & ports between your Factories and Cities to transport and fulfill any need they may have, but be careful not to overload your supply chain. Settle abandoned islands by building your settlement and growing your population by fulfilling all their needs. Features: 🧠 Establish an intricate and wide logistical network 🗻 Settle abandoned islands 🔨 Build large cities, and increase your population ⚖️ Balance your supply chains ⚔️ Compete with other players globally
row.short_description: Mini Settlers: Prologue is a free version of Mini Settlers. In this minimalist city builder, settle islands, construct cities, and design efficient logistic networks to fulfill your buildings' needs and fuel population growth to adventure into new worlds.

row.name: Hidden Cats in Jigsaw Puzzle
row.detailed_description: Do you like Hidden Objects Games? Meow! So let's check out our lovely Hidden Cats Series Bundle! About the Game The beautifully hand-drawn art of the Hidden Cats Series from Nukearts is now in a Jigsaw Puzzle game! Enjoy the free content from Paris City, and play through two game modes and three quantity pieces. Get extra content from DLCs. London, New York, Rome, Berlin, and more await you! Challenges per scene Each scene has six challenge levels where you can choose between three quantities of pieces and two coloring modes. Play with all the pieces already colored. More challenge? Start uncolored. Plan and assemble pieces outside of the board. Use filters to help you play Levels Play a scene by choosing it in the gallery of each City. When you complete a scene on any mode or amount of pieces, you earn the colored version of the art and can appreciate it on full screen. On the base and free game, we have 7 scenes from Hidden Cats in Paris: Paris Boulangerie Catacombs Patisserie Cabaret Louvre Versailles Get more scenes on our DLCs!
row.short_description: The beautifully hand-drawn art of the Hidden Cats Series levels from Nukearts is now in a Jigsaw Puzzle game! Enjoy the free content from Paris City and get more from DLCs.

row.name: My Shadow
row.detailed_description: The Mind can sometimes be too imaginative. While you tuck yourself into your bed and turn the lights off, the creatures of the night begin to appear. As you hide under your bedsheet, they surround you. As you begin to drift away, they take you, down, deep into the depths, of your mind... Welcome to the hauntingly surreal realm of My Shadow, a mesmerizing 2.5D Horror Puzzle Platformer that thrusts players into the enigmatic depths where reality and imagination intertwine. As the night descends, a mysterious world materializes, inviting you to embark on an otherworldly journey through the intricate labyrinth of your own mind. Traverse the intricacies of the distorted dollhouse, solving puzzles that gradually unveil the truth about your innermost demons.
row.short_description: Explore the enigmatic world of My Shadow, a 2.5D Horror Puzzle Platformer where reality blurs. As night descends, illusions materialize, luring you into the intricate depths of your own mind. Unravel the mysteries where the boundaries of reality haze and imagination takes control.
row.notes: There are themes of death and psychological torment/trauma

row.name: Don't Puke!
row.detailed_description: Only a few will make it to the top! Join other players for a crazy ride in a new online, physics-based VR game with unique control mechanics. Explore the world around you and have fun! Discover the vast, open sky island playground that will push your skills to the limit. The island is divided into different areas, each offering unique PvP or Co-Op mechanics. Climb and fly to the highest peaks of the island. Solve mini-puzzles alone or with friends. Mastering your cart control skills is essential to reach the summit. The sky is the limit! CURRENT FEATURES: Players navigate the world using a special cart that moves according to physics principles. Additionally, it can boost, jump, and glide. Players steer the cart by grabbing and turning the wheels. Boost to move faster or ascend steep inclines. Jump to reach higher floors or vault between platforms. Or, spread your wings and soar through the air. The game can be enjoyed in single-player mode or on one of the public servers for even more fun with other players. The game takes place on a sky island, divided into several parts. Each part features a specific mechanic for PvP gameplay. The vertical section of the island presents a challenging obstacle course, ideal for single-player and even better in multiplayer co-operation. Utilize your cart control skills to ascend to the island's summit. Players collect stars scattered around the island. Some are located in hard-to-reach places. Collecting all the stars signifies mastering the game. Each star collected grants a checkpoint, which can be used at any location. Use these checkpoints to teleport between interesting locations or to save your progress. The game features online multiplayer, voice chat, and quick visual emoji reactions.
row.short_description: Only a few will make it to the top! Ride, jump, and fly either solo or with friends, in this virtual reality game! Mastering your cart control skills is essential to reach the island's highest peaks.

row.name: 捕鱼大玩咖
row.detailed_description: 《捕鱼大玩咖》是一款刺激有趣的捕鱼游戏，让您沉浸在海底的奇妙世界中，探索栩栩如生的鱼种，体验精彩刺激的玩法，享受极致的捕鱼乐趣，金币爆屏的爽快体验！ 亿万金币免费拿，万倍炮台轻松打，问鼎捕鱼榜首，承包整个海洋！游戏不仅保留了经典街机玩法，还增加了核爆战场、摇钱树等全新玩法，爆率更高，福利更多，画面更炫酷。 【蓝光画面】 超高清极致画质，国内顶尖美术团队倾情力作，带给您超越视觉极限的完美体验 【独创玩法】 彻底颠覆传统捕鱼玩法，刀光剑影，轨道激光，吞噬全场，电闪雷鸣，让您目不暇接，持续享受金币爆屏的爽快体验 【BOSS交互】 业内独一无二的boss场景交互，不亚于AR的视听盛宴，让您仿佛置身于藏匿史诗boss的深海之中 【多重福利】 免费金币每日可领，超多好玩任务，超高任务奖励，助您一举成为捕鱼王者，羡煞众人 【鱼种多样】 数十种功能鱼和史诗级boss鱼齐上阵，超高倍率一炮暴富，等待您去解锁体验 【丰富功能】 锻造武器，体验万倍捕鱼的刺激，神秘抽奖，感受满屏爆金的畅快，每日低保奖励让您领到手软
row.short_description: 《捕鱼大玩咖》是一款刺激有趣的捕鱼游戏，让您沉浸在海底的奇妙世界中，探索栩栩如生的鱼种，体验精彩刺激的玩法，享受极致的捕鱼乐趣，金币爆屏的爽快体验！亿万金币免费拿，万倍炮台轻松打，问鼎捕鱼榜首，承包整个海洋！游戏不仅保留了经典街机玩法，还增加了核爆战场、摇钱树等全新玩法，爆率更高，福利更多，画面更炫酷。

row.name: Death Fighter
row.detailed_description: The world is in peril, as thousands of demons are devastating the world and your village was the first victim. In search of revenge you swear that you're ready to fight, even against the death itself. Begin your journey as a Death Fighter and show the Death itself who's the boss ! This game is a 2D platformer and side scroller where you play a Death Fighter who wants to avenge his friends. Death Fighter is made of three levels with different mechanics and ennemies to defeat by jumping on their head. At the end of each level, you will fight and defeat a boss by jumping multiple times on their head and jump into a portal to go to the next level. Game Features Challenging and complex gameplay Customizable difficulty from beginner to expert ! Unlockable skins and rewards ! Made by an indie game developer, with love !
row.short_description: This is a simple side-scroller made by one person. It's my first game and I would really appreciate any reviews from you !

row.name: Sirocco
row.detailed_description: Ditch the roles, hard counters and last hits in Sirocco. Rally your team as you swap abilities mid-match, load up auto-firing weapons , and craft strategies on the fly. No rules — just fun. Creativity As Meta Without fixed roles and hard counters, learn as you go and discover your own strategies instead of being punished for not following the strategies of others. Auto-firing Arena, Not Farming Arena Sirocco utilizes an auto-fire mechanic and economic system that promotes team fighting and positioning over last hitting NPCs. High Risk, High Reward Every Ability In Sirocco Is A Skill Shot. Deep Strategy, Not Memorization Combine specialized weapons, ship abilities, and ability augmentations to develop your own way to play. Conquer The Five Seas with your Friends by Making New Ones In Sirocco, teams win, not individuals, so whether you are 10-0 or 0-10, our economic system ensures all your friends are critical to achieving victory.
row.short_description: Sirocco is an infinitely replayable 5v5 arena. Rally your team as you swap abilities mid-match, craft unique builds and load up auto-firing weapons as you craft strategies on the fly. No rules — just fun.

row.name: SWAPMEAT
row.detailed_description: Welcome to SWAPMEAT – the co-op action roguelite shooter where every kill makes you stronger... and stranger. Rip through hostile alien worlds, harvest mutant body parts mid-combat, and adapt faster than the enemies before they overwhelm you. Rangus Meats is a galaxy-spanning megacorp whose innovations may or may not have triggered a galactic crisis, infesting worlds with aliens, mutants, and murderous robots. Your job: Drop onto hostile planets teeming with absurd enemy oddities Complete Prime Directives and collect meat samples Swap out your body parts in real time Survive long enough to receive your employee evaluation Every alien you harvest gives you new body parts with unique powers — triple-jump legs, turret-dropping torsos, grenade-launching turkey heads. Each fleshy extremity changes how you fight. Time is never on your side. The pressure never stops. Learn to live in the chaos or get — quite literally — torn apart by it. Swap on the Fly Rip, swap, and mutate mid-combat. Every limb and extremity you graft changes your strategy instantly. Rapid adaptation isn't optional — it's a matter of survival. There are over 3,000 meat combinations available to players. Every part you graft changes your strategy instantly. Adaptation isn't optional — it's a matter of survival. Equip Squat Daddy legs to jump and butt-slam enemies, or an Octo Swirl head that shoots in all directions, or a Stellar Chef torso that grants barrier shields to your squad. Fast, Relentless Combat While roguelikes like Risk of Rain 2 and co-op shooters like Helldivers 2 inspired our developers, the speed of core combat harks back to some of our favorite games, such as Quake 3, Serious Sam, and Overwatch. SWAPMEAT forces improvisation in ways we haven’t seen in traditional roguelikes — you work with what drops and learn to thrive in unpredictability, while under constant siege by alien weirdos. Waves of screwball enemies never stop coming. You dodge, shoot, and swap your way through escalating chaos while racing against time to complete objectives and bring back vital Meat Cores for Carl’s ongoing Smart Meat™ experimentations. Built for Co-Op (1–4 Players) Solo or squad, SWAPMEAT's got something for everyone. Rip through the galaxy alone, or summon your bravest buddies to face the chaos together. With dynamically scaling difficulty, the game gets harder when players join and easier when they leave. Roguelike Replayability Each mission throws new enemies, random events, and unexpected part combinations at you. No two runs are ever the same. Every death teaches you something new. Permanent Upgrades Between Runs Bring your research back to HQ and cash it in for weapon unlocks, new perks, and company-approved improvements. Hostile Alien Worlds Explore a series of ever-stranger worlds, from an urban speedway thick with hungry mutant speedsters to a planetary cookout overrun by hostile aliens. Battle across bizarre, vivid landscapes strewn with the ruins of galactic capitalism.
row.short_description: Rip through hostile alien worlds, harvest mutant body parts mid-combat, and adapt faster than the enemies before they overwhelm you. Every alien you harvest gives you new body parts with unique powers — triple-jump legs, turret-dropping torsos, grenade-launching turkey heads.

row.name: Neon Nova
row.detailed_description: Immerse yourself in a futuristic world brimming with vibrant energy and intense arena battles with our groundbreaking Arena Ship Shooter. Neon Nova seamlessly blends fast-paced action, stunning neon aesthetics, and thrilling game modes for an unforgettable gaming experience. Neon-Styled Atmosphere Experience the thrill of a neon-drenched universe where vibrant colors and dynamic lighting effects bring the gameplay to life. Diverse Game Modes Engage in different game modes, whether it's classic Deathmatch, Checkpoint-Race or challenging Survival modes. Each mode offers a unique gameplay experience, upgrade your ship with Power Up's and ensuring hours of gaming excitement. Customizable Spaceships Tailor your ship to your personal style. Unlock new skins and colors to stand out in the arena and dominate your opponents in intergalactic combat. Intuitive Controls Enjoy seamless and intuitive controls, allowing you to navigate effortlessly through the neon arena and execute precise maneuvers in the heat of battle. Challenging Enemies Face a variety of challenging enemies, from skilled AI opponents to challenging arena fights. Each battle is unique, requiring tactical skill and quick reflexes. Prepare to dive into the future of the Arena Ship Shooter with Neon Nova. Unlock skins, become the master of the arena, and dominate the neon universe! Steam Deck Setup If the game doesn't start on the Steam Deck, you need to go to the Steam library, select the game, go to 'Settings > Properties > Compatibility,' enable the Compatibility tool, and choose 'Steam Linux Runtime.' Steam Deck Controller Setup If you experience issues with the right stick while playing, go to the controller settings for the game on the Steam Deck (press the Steam button) and adjust the Death zone (slightly increase the left slider).
row.short_description: Dive into the adrenaline-fueled world of Neon Nova, a cutting-edge Neon Arena Ship Shooter! Experience intense arena battles, unlock customizable ships with vibrant neon skins, and dominate diverse game modes. Are you ready to be the master of the neon universe? Jump in now!

row.name: ProtectHeart
row.detailed_description: ProtectHeart is a strategy and defense game. Your objective is to protect the heart from various enemies, from turtles to fighter jets. You'll get experience points for defeating each enemy, once you have enough points you'll be given an upgrade opportunity that will last for the rest of the game! You need to pick carefully, it could be the difference between surviving and failing.
row.short_description: ProtectHeart is a strategic defense game, defend the heart at all costs! Are you up for the challenge?

row.name: Seraphim Slum
row.detailed_description: 'The slums are rotting. You are spilling out.' Ezekiel has moved into the slums. She finds herself enamored with its inhabitants: three girls, in particular. Befriend an angel, fall in love, and break them by awakening them. Whisper their tragedies, tell them lies and tell them truths, sing your sweet corrupting song like lovers do. Push them over the edge.  It's not a matter of if they fall... but how they fall. Seraphim Slum  is a sapphic liminal visual novel revolving around fallen angels, the horror of intimate relationships, self-perceived sins, predestination, and love conquering self.  You play as Ezekiel as you explore the slum… Helping Macy, Salxire, and Oriel unravel their self-suppressions and succumb to their desires.  Your love's a perfect sort of obsessive. Some could say it's devouring. Delving into the liminal slum as it is eaten alive by your nature .  Finding out what it truly means to have free will and autonomy… at the price of corruption. GAME OVERVIEW Welcome to the definitive edition of Seraphim Slum. A dark sapphic visual novel about fallen angels. 3 female love interests: Macy , Salxire and Oriel . Esoteric and poetic musings on philosophy and autonomy... Choice-based branching with 4 unique endings ... and a bonus Free Roam route where you explore the slum's depths... Many scene illustrations and a gore toggle for a darker take on an angel's love... Fully voice-acted dialogue. Custom-made OST ... and a hidden bonus track exclusive to the ideal ending. Endings list, CG gallery , and Steam achievements! A playtime of 5-6 hours for a full run. CONTENT WARNINGS This game isn't suitable for those who are easily disturbed. Please play at your own discretion. Epilepsy warning, depictions of mental illness, unhealthy relationships, body horror, distressing sound effects, deranged sapphics. GET TO KNOW THE CHARACTERS Our protagonist, Ezekiel : Love interest #1, Macy : Love interest #2, Salxire : Love interest #3, Oriel : CREW rosesrot - Director, Story Writer, General Programmer, Voice Director Josh Carlat - Lead Developer NOIR - General Programmer, Technical & Background Artist juicydev - Functional and Linguistic Quality Assurance, 'Free Roam' Editor Eli Orcutt - Sound Designer, Dialogue Editor, Composer, Audio Post-Production, Voice Implementation Assistance Kevin Bomer - Cinematography & VFX Anonymous - CG Artist Ethan 'Crowlee' Encinas - Sprite Artist sfilmak - GUI Artist SAN - UI Programmer aivyr - Props Artist, Steam Icon Artist Shahar Hod - VFX Animator, Steam Icon Artist miencha - Illustrator Lorraine Wong - Composer James Molloy - Composer, Trailer Producer Faust - Editor HagGirlSummer - Marketing & Social Media FlareForTheDramatics - Marketing & Social Media CAST Lauren Kong - Voice of Ezekiel Meg TheLovableDork - Voice of Macy Brooke Johnson - Voice of Salxire Elene Pak - Voice of Oriel SPECIAL THANKS Additional sound effects from Zapsplat Programming Assistance by Emilie Brewer Voice Implementation Assistance by NotHack Europa
row.short_description: An eerie liminal game that explores just how far an angel can fall. Play as sapphic Lucifer and corrupt angels into falling... in love with you.
row.reviews: “A bunch of fallen, lesbian archangels and a prophet who lies as easily as she breathes… This game had me so in tune with my sapphic side...” Fuwanovel “I was honest to god blown away by this game, from the moment I saw the cover, and then the art and then downloading and playing it... it's clear as day that so much amazing talent came together to make this, with a lot of very cool visions culminating in something that scratched the itch that games like [We Know The Devil] and pretty much everything by kittyhorrorshow left behind.” Inyssa “Not as much a story as it is art, poetry, music and snippets of philosophy pieced together into a fascinating and sometimes confusing mind trip.” LittleMissLeeStories

row.name: Morph!
row.detailed_description: Morph is a casual indie game that allows you to play in a variety of styles, such as 'possessing' over 100 different objects in a given world to find and chase other players, or quietly hiding. Possess yourself with another object! Possess with a variety of objects to blend in perfectly with your surroundings to hide your presence and strategically gain a tactical advantage. Find other players! Find, chase, and slay other players. Hide naturally! Hide your possessed object inconspicuously by blending it seamlessly into its environment. Use your skills! Create your own play style by combining various skills and enjoy the game. Play with variety maps! Enjoy the game using numerous objects on maps of various concepts.
row.short_description: Morph is a casual game in which you can transform into a bunch of objects in the world of the game, chasing each other, or hiding quietly, and so on.

row.name: Ranocta
row.detailed_description: This game is the second creation of 'Lanota - Music game with story'. An old, broken tuner, and a dark world that has yet to recover. Nevertheless, when they can't give up on purification, a makeshift tuner is created by combining a skeletal judgment line and a music-energy stone called a 'purification stone.' Taking care of this unstable invention and starting over again, there is a whole new style of performance that is more confusing, complex, bumpy, unpredictable, but sometimes colorful, dynamic, brilliant. Characteristics of the game 1. There is a judgment line that freely crosses straight lines and circles, and it is a unique system that remotely hits notes by controlling two 'purification stones' placed on it with eight key inputs. The nine types of notes, each in a different way to destroy, are designed to reflect the characteristics of the game, and the oddly woven patterns, combining all these elements, give you a shock you've never felt before. Enjoy 27 kinds of song pattern, which range from boringly easy to very challenging and difficult. 2. With the permission of Noxy Games Inc. and composers, some great pieces from Lanota were brought. 3. Pictures that exclude characters and place more importance on color than shape fill the screen. Object design and illustration applied for each piece of music are somewhat clumsy and clunky, but on the other hand, they form a sensuous and profound atmosphere. 2023.03 ~ 2024.02 Devoting my senior year in high school, joversound
row.short_description: Ranocta is a note-drop 2D rhythm game in a space that crosses straight and circular shapes. In an emotional and beautiful world full of colors and sounds, experience your own performance to recover lost light.

row.name: Brighter Shores
row.detailed_description: Brighter Shores is an all new adventure from award winning MMORPG designer Andrew Gower. Explore a land of magic and mysteries, with a huge number of professions to try, and something new to find around every corner. Brighter Shores features an ongoing story and hundreds of hours of gameplay. As the newest recruit in the Hopeport town guard, you are looking to make a name for yourself. This soon turns out to be a more challenging role than you had anticipated, with a strange storm raging over the harbor and unrest from the local goblins. You will discover powerful magic sources and become one of the legendary classes of old: Cryoknight, Guardian or Hammermage. Which is fortunate, because something is corrupting the deepest reaches of the nearby Hopeforest, and only through the strength of your new-found powers will you be able to deal with it. Learn a diverse range of professions, such as Fisher, Forager, Chef. Woodcutter, Miner, Alchemist Stonemason, Merchant, Blacksmith, and many more! Encounter a huge variety of fantastical foes over the course of your adventures. The game will be constantly expanding, with new content being released in an episodic format. Each episode features its own unique side quests, professions and lands, as well as advancing the central story. There are hours and hours of content you can play for free. However, if you want more stories, professions and places to explore, you can buy a Premium Pass. A Premium Pass gives you many benefits, including access to all released episodes:
row.short_description: Brighter Shores is an all new adventure from award winning MMORPG designer Andrew Gower. It is an enchanting point-and-click style RPG with hundreds of hours of gameplay, set in a land of magic and mysteries, with a huge number of professions to try, and something new to find around every corner.

row.name: Astro Felix
row.detailed_description: Astro Felix is a fast paced endless skate adventure where you play as Felix, the universe’s coolest cat on four wheels! Dash through the vibrant cyber city, dodge deadly obstacles, outsmart enemies, and collect coins and power-ups to boost your run. This platformer will test your reflexes and charm your heart.  From Home Cat to Pixel Hero Astro Felix started as an experimental passion project based on a real cat, our beloved real life companion! His quirky behavior, skate-like slides across the floor, and curious nature inspired us to turn him into a pixel legend.  Features  Fast-paced 2D gameplay  Cute and quirky space cat protagonist (Yes actually based on our real life cat.)  Avoid enemies  Collect coins and powerful pickups  Gamepad and keyboard support  Pure arcade fun with a unique twist
row.short_description: Skate, jump, and claw your way through endless chaos! Astro Felix is a fast-paced, endless, retro-style platformer starring a fearless space cat on skating wheels.

row.name: Moss Piglets
row.detailed_description: Attention commander of the great moss piglet horde! Your moss piglets need your help to get through these terrible dangerous terrains and worlds. No one is sure of the reason for the moss piglet horde being here in this strange land. Now it falls upon you to rally your troops, maintain your resources, and SURVIVE. As your journey unfolds, you will face many obstacles and strange paths. Do not despair! You can be victorious! This hilarious, simple, top-down RTS game, the player will control their horde of moss piglets through a variety of levels requiring you to solve puzzles, evade deadly obstacles, and to stay alive. This will prove difficult, as moss piglets do not have much of a survival instinct. The underlying lore of this world is sure to fascinate the player with the unexpected and the unknown. Moss piglets have many awesome abilities such as healing, burning, freezing, and more that the player will learn to control. Each level holds surprising new adventures for the player! Good luck! Our Team: Parker Bennion Dane Ericksen Nathan Howard Miriam Jardine Marshall Krueger William Lemmons DJ Swiggett Ethan Ware Tanner Mahovsky Ryan Short
row.short_description: This real-time strategy game requires you to direct your horde of moss piglets through dynamic terrains and great dangers.

row.name: METAL BEANS
row.detailed_description: METAL BEANS METAL BEANS is a 3D Action-Arcade game where you control two desktop buddies in a computer space. Protect the PC from digital threats by charging up your way through virus creatures and upgrading Catbot and Robitz in the system! CATBOT and ROBITZ are your desktop robot buddies that will help you defend the computer! Swap between the two characters as you combine their attack styles and discover their combined battery combo patterns. Upgrade your characters with disks to customize their skills and stats. -- DESKTOP ARENA The DESKTOP ARENA is your hub to access different stores to upgrade your characters, and replenish their systems back to 100%! Starting off, Blippy will help you recycle your Bad Bits from viruses into player upgrades. -- WINDOW EVENTS Enter different windows to face internal computing issues head on in various arcade-action game modes! How will you upgrade your desktop buddies to prepare them for the ongoing hordes? -- THE CYCLE REBOOTS... As the viruses get tougher to delete, so can you! Use your Databucks earned by your session's scores to unlock more features and upgrades! -- See you inside the PC!
row.short_description: METAL BEANS is a 3D Action-Arcade game where you control two desktop buddies in a computer space. Protect the PC from digital threats by charging up your way through virus creatures and upgrading Catbot and Robitz in the system!

row.name: FELLCHASER
row.detailed_description: In a hasty misstep and with a careless attempt at a new potion, you, Henric the town alchemist, led your own love toward an unconscious state. Alas upon brewing a cure, you falter and see Death before you– but your time is far from up. You've stolen Death’s scythe in an attempt to cheat your fate. Now you must escape Purgatory by brewing combo-building potions and reaping hordes of creatures in this hack and slash Roguelike! Explore the Depths of Purgatory Purgatory is made up of a series of islands all connected by time-bending portals. Home to more than just Death herself, Purgatory bears residence to a wide array of bizarre and oh-so-hungry creatures ready for their next meal. Collect Strange Brewables and Create Combo-Building Elixirs Purgatory is likewise home to a variety of herbs, critter remains, and unsettling items. Collect these mysterious ingredients, mix in uniquely shaped bottles, and reap the Souls of the Damned to assist in your expedition through Purgatory. Interact with the Curiously Cozy Beyond the feasting, beasting monsters Purgatory is home to, a curiously cozy crow named John seems to have made the best of a rather dark and dreary situation. Whether you trade ingredients at John’s Wicked Wares or simply stop for a wee rest, John would absolutely adore your company… and business! It’s All Led Up to This! After you’ve slayed hordes of creatures and brewed your final concoctions, a new island of Purgatory will present itself. Will you be strong enough to escape through the Gates of Purgatory and revive your love once and for all?
row.short_description: You've stolen Death’s scythe in an attempt to cheat your fate. Now you must escape Purgatory by brewing combo-building potions and reaping hordes of creatures in this hack and slash Roguelike!
row.notes: Violence with blood and themes of death.

row.name: All City King
row.detailed_description: All City King is a stealth game where the player takes the role of an up-and-coming street artist. Your target is the subway trains and your goal is to make your art travel all over the city. Some games allow you to heist a bank where you take out the guards and escape with a giant pay-check. But in All City King, your “bank” is the trains, and your “pay-check” is your art or whatever message you feel fit to share. Enter the subway quietly, make your mark on the trains, and get out. As you start your career as a street artist and after you have learned the ropes, your goal is to spray paint subway cars in increasingly difficult missions. Sneak past patrolling security guards, leave your mark on subway trains, and watch as your masterpiece leaves the station! Music by: Lars Bjerkholt Skotnes
row.short_description: All City King is a stealth game where you take the role of an up-and-coming street artist. Your target is the subway trains and your goal is to make your art travel all over the city.

row.name: Resttolandia
row.detailed_description: About this game Welcome to Resttolandia, where you don't just play as a gamer, you become the streamer! Get ready to navigate through a challenging world of platforms, pitfalls, and pixel-perfect jumps as you aim to reach the ultimate streaming stardom. In Resttolandia, you'll take control of streamer, equipped with determination to conquer every obstacle in your path. Inspired by the cult classic Jump King, this game puts a unique twist on the genre by immersing you in the thrilling world of online streaming. But beware, as a streamer, every move you make is broadcasted live to your audience. Will you gracefully navigate through each level with finesse, earning the admiration of your viewers? Or will you succumb to the pressure and entertain them with your epic fails? Key Features Experience the adrenaline rush of platforming action with a twist as you play the role of a streamer. Test your reflexes and precision in challenging levels filled with traps, jumps, and secrets. Interact with your virtual audience as you climb higher and higher, earning their cheers or jeers based on your performance. Earn or give subs on stream based on your gameplay.
row.short_description: Resttolandia: A thrilling adventure as you embody a determined streamer aiming for the top. Master precision jumps, dodge obstacles, and climb closer to streaming stardom. Can you reach the summit and join the elite? Jump into action now!

row.name: Atuel
row.detailed_description: Atuel is an award-winning surrealist documentary game in which you explore beautiful, dreamlike landscapes inspired by the topography and wildlife of the Atuel River Valley in Argentina. Perspective is fluid and interconnected as you shapeshift to become different animals and elements that form part of Atuel’s ecosystem. Real-life interviews about the past, present, and future of the Atuel weave together to form a historic narrative about people’s intimate relationship to the land they live on and the effects of the global climate crisis. A beautiful audiovisual experience focused on contemplative exploration. Shapeshift to become different animals and elements of Atuel’s ecoystem. Stunning surrealist landscapes based on the real-world topography of the Atuel River Valley. Real-life interviews with historians, biologists, geologists, and more. A historic narrative woven together from many different, interconnected perspectives. An atmospheric, ambient soundtrack produced by musicians Makunouchi Bento. An impactful half-hour game available in many different languages.
row.short_description: Atuel is an award-winning surrealist documentary game in which you explore beautiful, dreamlike landscapes inspired by the topography and wildlife of the Atuel River Valley in Argentina.
row.reviews: “A climate crisis documentary in the form of a third person walking sim where you play as a river. A high concept with a high execution.” Robert Yang “...not one person's voice, but a collection of voices describing the Rio Atuel in Argentina. You steer a drop of water, or a rush of it, or a bird or fish, as scientists and inhabitants describe their perspectives of the river. A small project but a really lovely, evocative presentation.” Andrew Plotkin “Combines geography, documentary, science, history, and beautiful visuals into a singular and sublime experience.” James Coltrain

row.name: The WereCleaner
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Howlin' Hugs The WereCleaner is a stealth-comedy game about cleaning messes and fighting your own instincts. Explore an ever-expanding office space and master an arsenal of gadgets to clean the office of messes, accidents... and the carnage of your own ongoing rampage. Features One unique and interconnected game world, filled with secret routes and handcrafted details A dynamic NPC system, with dozens of characters to avoid, trick or kill if needed 7 levels of wacky scenarios, shifting layouts, and hilarious surprises 3 multipurpose tools to dispose of every kind of mess - intentional or not
row.short_description: Kyle is a Janitor. He's also a Werewolf. And now he's got the night shift. Try not to kill anyone while working to get your paycheck - in a stealth-comedy game with surprises around every corner.
row.reviews: “I was just looking for something fun and relatively stress-free to jump into. Fortunately, Steam answered this with a surprising free recommendation: The WereCleaner, and its charm and dark humor made it one of my favorite games of 2024 so far.” ScreenRant “Having to work at night bites—because you’re a werewolf! Clean up a bustling office while avoiding coworkers in this darkly humorous stealth game.” App Store Editors's Choice
row.notes: The WereCleaner features cartoon depictions of violence in gameplay, including low-poly blood, gore, and corpses.

row.name: Lux
row.detailed_description: Lux is a 2D platformer that follows Lou, a girl who discovers a magic lantern in her attic. Full of quirky characters and a whole lot of puns, explore the town of Idelham, and discover the darkness that lurks under the surface. This game features: - Solve puzzles - Ton of fun local characters (including many OCs designed by our community!) - A bunch of mini games - Unfolding story - Basic platforming - Gorgeous frame by frame animation and carefully done background art - Observe various things - Unobserve them immediately
row.short_description: Lux is a 2D platformer that follows Lou, a girl who discovers a magic lantern in her attic. Full of quirky characters and a whole lot of puns, explore the town of Idelham, and discover the darkness that lurks under the surface.

row.name: Bulls and Cows - Wild West
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the amazing farm where the captivating game 'Bulls and Cows: Wild West' takes place! Here, children will embark on a unique adventure, meeting a kind and lovely cow-girl. On the farm, amidst green pastures and picturesque meadows, our little heroes will meet Vanessa – a clever and friendly cow-guide. She will enthusiastically explain the rules of the game and help children develop their logical abilities. 'Bulls and Cows: Wild West' will offer children an endless number of levels that will capture their imagination and ignite the desire to conquer all the puzzles. Thanks to Vanessa, our little heroes will strive for new heights in solving the riddles. Immerse yourself in the unique world of the Wild West, accompanied by lively country music. Children will enjoy every level, playing with Vanessa and her friends, and enhancing their logical skills on this captivating farm! Get ready for an exciting adventure on the farm, uncover number mysteries, and become true sheriffs of puzzles in 'Bulls and Cows: Wild West' alongside Vanessa!
row.short_description: On the farm, amidst green pastures and picturesque meadows, our little heroes will meet Vanessa – a clever and friendly cow-guide. She will enthusiastically explain the rules of the game and help children develop their logical abilities.

Click on them to color them! 🐱 Look for kitties in the woods. 😹 Look for kitties in the cabin. 😺 Look for them in the snow. 😹 Look for kitties at the lake. 🙀 Look for kitties in the mountains. 🐱‍ Look inside, around mountain tops and in the woods, but be careful, some kitties hide too well! Key features: 😹 300 different kitties to find! 🙀 There are hints if there are difficulties! 🐱‍ There is a zoom function to help you see the kitties! 👓 Use your imagination and a sharp eye to spot all the cats in the most unusual situations!
row.short_description: Look around the house, mountain peaks and forest to find 300 cats hidden in the most unexpected places!

row.name: 모험가 길드의 해결사: 카를로스
row.detailed_description: 죽으면 처음부터 다시 시작! 당신의 이름은 카를로스, 키 작고 성질 더러운 욕쟁이 흑마법사입니다. 성인이 된 카를로스는 돈을 벌기 위해서 그리고 지금까지 배운 지식과 기술을 활용하기 위해 모험가 길드에 가입하여 모험가가 됩니다. 다양한 퀘스트(99% 전투)를 수행하여 돈을 벌고 번 돈을 투자하여 더욱 강해지십시오. 파산이 두렵다고 투자를 망설이지 마십시오. 괜히 아꼈다가 죽으면 처음부터 다시 시작합니다 … …만 안타깝게도 당신은 전지전능한 무적이 아닙니다. 분명 단 한 번이라도 억울하게, 어처구니 없이 사망하게 될 겁니다. 그렇지만 너무 두려워하지 마십시오. 당신에게 다가올 위협을 학습했으니 다음엔 실패하지 않을 겁니다……. 아마도.
row.short_description: 혹시 가위바위보 좋아하십니까? 승패의 결과는 운이 결정하겠지만 선택은 당신의 몫입니다. 공격, 방어, 스킬 중 당신의 선택이 승패를 결정합니다.

row.name: Illusion Carnival
row.detailed_description: To Contact Us Join our Discord Server We welcome your inquiries at illusioncarnival@hotmail.com Should you encounter a bug impeding your progression, try returning to the main menu and re-entering the game. For further updates on development, follow the developer's social media accounts: Twitter/X @KiZ_qi About the Game This game marks the inception of the 'Illusion Carnival' series. 'Illusion Carnival' is a stylized 2.5D role-playing adventure game that captivates with its unique visuals and character-driven narrative. Immerse yourself in levels reminiscent of carnival games, where puzzles and light action/bullet hell elements await. Characters with distinct personalities and dark fairy-tale-like narratives craft an immersive atmosphere reminiscent of a bizarre amusement park adventure with hints of psychological horror. Trapped within the whimsical and eerie confines of an amusement park, a lost soul transforms into a tiny paper boat embarking on an unique journey, striving to break free. Confettia, once a dazzling amusement park, now stands corrupted and riddled with anomalies intent on consuming your spirit. What befell the park's previous visitors, and what draws you here? In a realm with no death and no escape, what fate awaits should your spirit succumb to utter madness? Navigate enchanting 2.5D pop-up book-style landscapes that transport you into a realm of fantasy and fairy tales. Admire the cute yet slightly ominous art style, where vibrant hues give way to unsettling anomalies, evoking a theater-like ambiance with thematic visuals throughout. Embark on a journey through diverse sections of the amusement park, each with various carnival aesthetics, from roller coasters to whimsical minigames. Engaging in dialogues between characters, adding charm to your park adventure. Interact with adorable yet enigmatic anomalous dolls, unravel puzzles concealed within toy boxes, and gradually unveil the park's mysteries. Partake in thrilling yet manageable combat encounters as you dodge the anomalies' assaults, endeavoring to restore the park to its former glory. Experience a narrative that seamlessly intertwines light-hearted comedy with dark fairy tales. Meet a cast of distinctive residents and fellow park visitors, relishing in their endearing performances and immersive storylines, all while engaging in jovial conversations with them.
row.short_description: A lost soul wanders through a whimsical, eerie pop-up book like amusement park. Dive into fun-filled stages, encounter unique characters, fend off spirit erosion, and uncover the park's hidden secrets. The enchanting yet dark Illusion Carnival begins now.

row.name: Games Advent Calendar 2024
row.detailed_description: In Games Advent Calendar 2024 you travel by train through a magical winter wonderland. Your journey is 25 magical days from the first of December till Christmas. Stop at each station for a new exciting gift. Get your game and just start playing. AUTHENTIC ADVENT EXPERIENCE – Go for the ultimate Advent Calendar experience, or just immediately unlock all the games if you can’t wait FESTIVE CHARACTERS – Choose one of the 8 adorable and funny characters and play with up to 8 players in multiplayer MANY NEW GAME MODES – Experience some fan-favorite returning game concepts in a new setting or enjoy many new ones.
