row.name: Introspection
row.detailed_description: Introspection puts the player into the shoes of Daniel, a guy in his early twenties struggling to find his way in the world. Fight your way through waves of enemies, challenge bosses, and attempt to escape as you explore Daniel’s mental purgatory. - Explore three different layers of Daniel’s personal purgatory, each with their own distinct themes. - Piece together Daniel’s past as you (may or may not) struggle to escape. - Gun your way through rooms of enemies that stand in your way
row.short_description: IntroSpection is a top-down bullethell-like action game about a man forced to confront his past. Delve into memories and blast through waves of inner demons as you explore one man's mental purgatory.
row.notes: This game contains cartoon violence and crude jokes about heavy topics.

row.name: Tombstone MMO
row.detailed_description: [EARLY ACCESS] Tombstone MMO is not your typical MMORPG. Quests are scarce, your choices leave a meaningful impact on your character and the world around you, and you can navigate the game at your own discretion. With 20+ skills to train and several ways to progress, the game essentially adapts to your playstyle, whether you want to brute force it or cleverly get around things. If the main story doesn't interest you, you may carve your own path throughout the game. Whether it's to relax and do some life skills to build your bank or fight the toughest mutants and technomantic creatures for rare items and glory. Train 20+ different skills Several combat choices (melee, ranged, or energy weapons) Many gathering skills to harvest more and more items Many creation skills to use your harvested (or purchased items) to make rarer, more powerful and useful items Four different apocalyptic biomes to explore Two islands: Tutorial island that showcases everything to come, from using most of the skills to progress, to making game-changing decisions, to discovering hidden island secrets for more power. A main island that is much larger, full of more skilling content, monsters to fight and loot, more secrets, and more NPCs to discuss the world with. Make difficult decisions: Some decisions are semi-permanent and will affect how you play the game. Whether you do what's right or wrong, you set in stone your destiny in the lore and the gameplay loop. Player interaction such as trading, marketing, partying up, ganging up, and PVP NPC interactions such as buying, selling, Robbery, and charismatic conversations
row.short_description: Tombstone MMO is a western-futuristic, low-res 2D indie MMORPG set in a post-climate-apocalyptic world.

row.name: Zero's Fantastic Anecdote
row.detailed_description: 'Zero's Fantastic Anecdote' is a shooting game where you will control Zero, a high school student with flying ability who is drawn into a forest world different from the real world. Here, you will face countless fairies and bosses, who will fire danmaku of various shapes and colors at you. You need to flexibly dodge and counterattack in order to survive. Game features: You can freely move in the air and use your superpowers to control the speed of the barrage, creating amazing effects.Engage in intense battles with various fairies and bosses, enjoying the beauty and excitement of barrage.The interesting plot and characters allow you to understand Zero's Fantastic Anecdote's background and destiny, discover his relationship with the forest world, and uncover the truth hidden in the fog. Featuring traditional shooting game modes and handling techniques, it brings a unique gaming experience. If you enjoy shooting games, then ''Zero's Fantastic Anecdote' will definitely bring you a different adventure. Come and experience what Zero has experienced with her! If you love the music in the game/are a fan of Zero’s amazing work, please check out OST~ 🎵🎶 You’ll make her super happy! 😊 The currently publicly released version is only the trial version of the first two stages, and Zero will release the complete version as soon as possible! I want to make easy and normal difficulty as a way to kill time, while hard and lunatic are aimed at professionals. (although there are many imperfections in current version, including the fact that the final boss has not yet been put into the game)
row.short_description: A Danmaku Shooting Game.

row.name: 我愛師大附中HSNU
row.detailed_description: I love the High School Affiliated to Normal University: This is an online connection game, In this game, you will control a character who can randomly visit scenes in the High School Affiliated to Normal University. You can upgrade by defeating monsters, and they will be reborn at fixed points. You can use the A.D.W.S on the keyboard to move, the left mouse button to attack with swords, and the right mouse button to attack with spells. If you are a classmate or graduate of the High School Affiliated to Normal University, it is recommended that you enter your class number. The latest update is as follows (03/09) 1. There are 9 main types of monsters, each monster has 4-5 color versions, and the maximum level of the monster is 200. 2. Starting from level 1, a character will gain 100 points and gold coins. These 100 points will determine your initial game experience. 3. The character's death will count down and reborn. As the level increases, the countdown time may be as long as 30 seconds or 60 seconds. 4. Reach the specified level within the time, and a piece of super high-level equipment will be randomly distributed, and the cycle will be repeated 10 times in total. feature: - Nostalgic school song music - Featured and realistic modeling - Online interactive games About the origin of game development: This is an online game about the scene of the High School Affiliated to Normal University, The developer is a mathematics teacher at the Central China Normal University. He became interested in making games because he was a student in the Department of Digital Media. I taught myself blender and unity for more than a year and spent another whole year building the campus scene of the attached middle school. Currently, I have used this work to get admitted to the Graduate School of Digital Media Design Department of Yunlin University of Science and Technology. My C# programming ability is relatively weak, so if I encounter a bug, it will take several weeks to resolve it. Please forgive me. This game is free. I have paid the annual server fee of 4,000 yuan. Up to 100 people can be online at the same time. Modeling: The first one to model was the central part of the country, so it was the most detailed but the technique was the roughest. Each of the subsequent buildings takes about half a month to complete, and may be different from some of the current conditions. We will slowly correct them when time allows. Game update goals: 1. Currently, only minor updates can be made before the start of school in September. Because I need to make a place-creating intelligent design-type game (introducing Zhongxing New Village), and use the work to find a mentor. It will mainly be made into a mobile game, and a copy will also be placed on Steam. 2. Update the target later and release it around the end of the year or the new year. The current attack modes are only slashing and spells, but the attack explosion range and spell explosion range can be increased. In the new year, many other optional auxiliary skills or passive skills will be added, and skill points will be obtained with specific tasks attached. From time to time, there will be monsters in the playground that exceed the player's level, and you need to cooperate to defeat them to get rewards. At present, player attacks against players are ineffective, but as you go to the basement, the further away from the ground, the lower the player's damage reduction will be. Start making some easter eggs in corners of the campus to surprise everyone. common problem: 1. Why can’t the mouse move the game perspective. I spent a month on this problem, but the discomfort caused by the game lens violently hitting surrounding objects (especially going up and down stairs) was too strong. After adding some code, the improvement is limited, so it is currently on hold. However, I personally hope that I can use the mouse to move the perspective. If you have some ideas or suggestions, we can discuss them with each other, thank you. 2. The computer is stuck when playing games. When making the modeling, 2K quality images were used, so it was found that it was very time-consuming in accumulation, so as to reduce the number of points and faces for modeling. The code may use too many loops for timing, but I don’t know how to deal with advanced C# methods. I am learning. It is recommended to use a graphics card of 1070 or 2060 or 3050 or above sponsor: If you want to sponsor a little bit of the tuition for graduate school for the next two years and the cost of the high-speed train to Yunlin every week, there is a small QR code at the end of the left hand corner of the map that can help me. Thank you.
row.short_description: This is an online game about the scene of the High School Affiliated to the Normal University. If you meet a classmate of the Middle School Affiliated to the Normal University in the scene, remember to say hello.

row.name: Treasure Defence
row.detailed_description: This is a VR-Only game, using OpenXR Argh Pirates!! The brits are attacking your pirate cove! Get ready to fight them, using towers you acquire from various mini games. Place them on the board and slam the bell to start the wave. The towers will automatically target the British boats when they pass by. Types of towers: Rifleman Tower - Fast Projectiles with low damage Bomber Tower - Slow but high damage Monkey Catapult - Attaches itself to a enemy boat and deals damage over time Harpoon Tower - Slows down the enemies The towers can be acquired by interacting with the arcade machines. Claw Machine Whack-a-moneky: Essentially Whack-a-mole, but with a monkey's hand instead. Hit that monkey a certain amount of time to be rewarded a tower Shoot a bottle: Inside the cabinet is a shooting range, where you have to use a pistol and shoot a certain amount of bottles to be rewarded a tower. Controls: Adjust height: Hold either the right laser point or right controller and aim at the box icon with text “Height up” or “Height down”. This will adjust the player's height in the VR build. Turn off laser in game: X Button / Primary button on the Left VR motion controller. Teleportation: Hold the right VR motion controller primary button / A to show the teleportation circle “gizmo”. While holding A on the right motion controller press X / Primary button on the left motion controller to confirm and teleport to the location that the player is aiming at. Blue circle gizmo - Can teleport White circle gizmo - Cannot teleport Rotate view: Right VR controller joystick Regular movement: Left VR controller joystick Interaction/grab: Grip button on each Vr controller. Allows two items to be picked up, one on each hand. Reset player position: Left Joystick click
row.short_description: Treasure Defence is an award winning VR game that innovates on the classic tower defence genre. Play arcades, win towers and fight The Royal British Navy. Plunder gold from destroyed ships and fortify your pirate cove.

row.name: Icy Incline
row.detailed_description: 'Icy Incline' is a experience where you control a penguin sliding through 24 icy trails. Race against time, avoid obstacles, and find the best route for the fastest time and reach the end of each trail. See your performance with stats like best score, worst score, and crashes. As the penguin, your goal is simple yet thrilling: reach the end of each trail in the shortest time possible. The icy trails are filled with obstacles that demand quick reflexes and strategy. Feel the rush of the chilly wind as you gracefully navigate the 24 trails, avoiding crashes and collecting powerups. The obstacles consist of candy canes, cones, rocks, and ice patches. Candy canes, cones, and rocks will end your run, while ice patches will slow you down. Controls: A, D - turn left, turn right Credits AJ - Developer, Design Jérémie - Trail design Kross Kancel - Sound
row.short_description: 'Icy Incline' is a experience where you control a penguin sliding through 24 icy trails. Race against time, avoid obstacles, and find the best route for the fastest time and reach the end of each trail. See your performance with stats like best score, worst score, and crashes.

row.name: Grid Dungeons
row.detailed_description: Immerse yourself in the strategic depths of our turn-based dungeon game! Take command of a party of diverse characters, navigating through grid-based maps to outwit and conquer enemies. Your mission: strategically eliminate foes while minimizing damage to your own team. Explore the treacherous depths of dungeons, where every move counts in this thrilling adventure of tactics and skill. Can you emerge victorious against the lurking dangers? Embark on a strategic journey through a myriad of maps in our turn-based dungeon strategic game! Command a diverse party of characters, each wielding unique weapons - from swordsmen engaging in close combat to archers picking off enemies from a distance, and mages unleashing powerful spells. Unlock a plethora of actions, allowing you to tailor your approach to each challenge. Navigate the grid-based landscapes wisely, combining the strengths of your team to defeat foes and uncover the secrets hidden within the dungeons. Master the art of strategy in a world where every move and action shapes your destiny!
row.short_description: A turn-based strategy game. Command a team with swordsmen, archers, and mages, strategically navigating grid maps. Unleash unique actions to defeating enemies. Master tactics, minimize damage, and conquer in this immersive strategy adventure.

row.name: Wittle Mistakes - Prologue
row.detailed_description: SUMMARY Welcome, dearest players, to 'Wittle Mistakes,' an adventure curated with the utmost care by yours truly, Mother. Here, you'll navigate the trials of the Mother Corporation as an adventurous infant. Each challenge is a lesson, with surprises and secrets tucked in every corner. From the dangers of our playpen to the mysteries within our toy-laden landscapes, your journey will be filled with discovery and confusion. But tread carefully, for not everything is as playful as it appears. What truths lie behind our cheerful facade? Only the brightest and bravest will uncover the secrets and learn what it means to make a 'Wittle Mistake.' 'Wittle Mistakes' is more than a game; it's an adventure where every challenge is a tender embrace, every obstacle a chance to grow. Are you ready to join our family and discover the love and learning that await in Mother’s world? Let's begin, and may your mistakes be wittle but your discoveries grand. GAMEPLAY 'Wittle Mistakes' is a third-person 3D platformer, adventure game, that thrusts you into the wobbly legs of an infant baby destined for greatness (or failure).We invite players into a richly imagined world where the charm of childhood curiosity meets the challenge of intricate puzzles and survival against odd, even whimsical, adversaries. As an infant protagonist, players will navigate through a series of escalating trials orchestrated by the enigmatic M.O.T.H.E.R. corporation, blending elements of platforming, puzzle-solving, and stealth in a 3D environment rendered with a mix of surreal beauty and eerie undertones. KEY FEATURES Movement Mechanics: Players start with basic movements (crawling, standing, walking) and progressively unlock more complex abilities. Mastery of these movements is crucial for overcoming physical obstacles and advancing through levels. Narrative-Driven Single-Player Story: Immerse yourself in a gripping tale that blends humor, absurdity, and unexpected twists. Discover the secrets behind the M.O.T.H.E.R. corporation's bizarre trials and the true nature of the world you're crawling through. Puzzle-Solving: Each level is structured around unique puzzles that integrate physical navigation with environmental manipulation. Players must solve these puzzles to unlock new areas, evade dangers, or manipulate the environment to their advantage. Skill Progression: The game is designed to teach and then test. Early levels focus on learning and mastering new skills in a relatively safe environment. Later levels challenge players to apply these skills in more complex and dangerous contexts. Level Progression Highlights: Initial Discovery : Master basic movements and interact with a vibrant world filled with toys, teaching the joy of exploration. On Your Feet: Overcome the first real test of agility by winning a race, a testament to your growing abilities. Aerial Acrobatics : Navigate through an obstacle course of bounce pads, perfecting control in mid-air for thrilling platforming action. Mind Over Matter: Tackle puzzles that require cunning over brute force, challenging your intellect. Precision and Patience: Test your coordination with fast-moving obstacles, a trial of timing and reflexes. 'Wittle Mistakes' is not just a game; it's an odyssey of growth, challenge, and the pursuit of triumph over seemingly insurmountable odds. It's a colorful, surreal journey set against the backdrop of a child's innocence and the dark whimsy of the world that awaits. Join us in this unique adventure where every mistake is a lesson, and every challenge is an opportunity for discovery. ABOUT US At Rockfire Games, we believe that gaming should be a rollercoaster of emotions, with humor leading the charge.
row.short_description: Play the first game of many! Wittle Mistakes is a mechanics-based third-person 3D adventure where players navigate the trials of infancy within the Mother Corporation. Unveil the dark secrets that Mother has been hiding. The playpen awaits! Built by an insane two-man team.
row.notes: The baby that you play as will have gory deaths with blood. it is in a over the top fashion and there is no dismemberment. Just lots of blood. There are some women blowup dolls throughout the maps, and there are some references to mother is a sexually active, but not at all with children or anything of that nature. There is also some voicelines that are spoken that would be relates to drinking. The themes are quite dark, as you are taking an innocent baby and making them go through a very deadly maze/obstacle course. Nothing is over the top or considered sexualizing a minor.

row.name: the nine tailed celestial fox Playtest
Falos
row.detailed_description: Play Falos, learn to read the first 100+ words for over 100+ languages. Four Different Gameplay Modes Gorilla Jumper: Navigate through levels by jumping onto the correct emojis that match the displayed words. Precision and quick thinking are key as you leap from one emoji to the next. Dragon Snake: Embrace the classic snake game with a twist. Guide your character towards the right emojis while avoiding your growing tail, ensuring each move aligns with your language learning goals. Bird Adventure: Take to the skies in a side-scrolling escapade. Flap the wings of your bird to soar among the clouds, diving through the correct emojis that match the words below. Endless Gorilla Runner: Test your reflexes in an endless runner format, where you must jump across multiple levels to snag the right emojis. Avoid the wrong ones to keep your streak alive and score high. Educational Video Game Diverse Vocabulary: From animals and colors to essential travel items, expand your linguistic repertoire in a fun and memorable way. Multiple Languages: With over 100 languages featured, Falos offers an unparalleled opportunity to explore new languages or strengthen existing skills. Engaging Challenges: Each game mode presents unique challenges that cater to different playstyles, ensuring a fresh and exciting learning experience every time. Progress Advance through levels by matching the correct emojis with their corresponding words. Beware of the incorrect choices, as they cost you a life. Success hinges on accuracy and speed, with each level upping the ante and enriching your vocabulary. Design Philosophy Falos is designed to make language learning accessible and entertaining. By integrating learning into familiar gaming formats, players of all ages can enjoy the thrill of gaming while absorbing new words in another language. Whether you're a seasoned polyglot or a curious beginner, Falos offers a unique blend of education and entertainment. Join the Adventure Prepare yourself to have fun in the colorful and captivating world of Falos, where every jump, flap, and dash brings you one step closer to linguistic mastery. With its innovative approach to language learning, Falos is not just a game—it's a gateway to global communication and understanding.
row.short_description: Falos: Learn to read 100+ words in 100+ languages while playing a game. A game where you match words to emojis across four different play styles.

row.name: Reroute
row.detailed_description: Reroute is a puzzle game in which your task is to power up broken satellites by redirecting lasers with the help of boxes and portals. The game features 38 challenging levels with unique movement mechanics.
row.short_description: Redirect lasers with the help of boxes and portals in this challenging puzzle game with unique mechanics.

row.name: Anamnesia - part 1: am i my body?
row.detailed_description: Can you find the truth? Nine people wake up trapped in an abandoned research facility. Split into three teams, separated into different halls, the members of the two Answer Teams need to compete in a game of life and death. The goal: to figure out the 'truth' behind the secret member of the Question Team: Emilia. Do you really want to? Each part of Anamnesia will cover the same timeframe from the perspective of a different protagonist. Part 1 centers around Adrian, a member of Answer Team A. Will he manage to uncover the secrets hidden deep within himself in order to learn the truth and get out alive? Or, much more importantly: does he even want to? Find your own truth. Throughout the story you can scroll up at any time to check Adrian's log: a recording of all conversations he has previously witnessed, stored on a chip in his brain. Maybe doing so can reveal hidden details he missed... Key Features: Roughly 70,000 words (4-6 hours) of mostly linear storytelling A complete character arc as part of a larger narrative Unique in-universe interpretation of the genre-typical backlog feature An original soundtrack and beautiful artwork
row.short_description: Sci-Fi Mystery Visual Novel. Nine people are trapped in an underground research facility, forced to play a game of life and death. Check your log to find the truth that connects those apparent strangers - if you even want to, that is.
row.notes: strong language, references to sexual trauma, themes of suicidal ideation, mentions of alcohol consumption and physical assault

row.name: Keep It Steady!
row.detailed_description: Main Idea of the game In this game you will rely on physics as you take control of a paddle or platforms left and right sides. With this ability you will be able to lift up or down either side of the paddle allowing you to be able to control the mass of a ball sitting on top of the paddle. Your goal is to be able to manipulate the paddles left and right sides correctly to make the ball sitting on top of the paddle roll into a randomly selected glowing hole to get points while also trying to avoid the other unlit holes around it. Game Modes There are so far 5 game modes currently in the game they are Classic, Endless, Climb, Phantom, and Speedball. Currently Climb and Phantom are the only ones with sub game modes. Each sub game mode having a twist on the main game mode they are from. Classic In the Classic game mode you are to move the sides of the paddle up and down to roll the ball in the glowing hole to score points. But be careful if you are to roll the ball accidently into a black unlit hole it will cost you a life. if you lose too many lives the game will be over. Climb In the Climb Game mode you will be trying to guide the ball away from every hole as long as you can. If you touch any hole it will make you lose a life and if you lose too many lives it will be game over. However every hole is moving in either a up, down, left, or right direction making it a challenging experience to dodge every hole thrown your way. The holes also speed up over time making it harder to dodge them as you try to continue to get the best time. Your only goal in this mode is to survive as long as you can and get the best time. Climb Point Climb Point is a sub game mode in climb that has slightly different objectives. It is basically the same as all the other climb sub game modes except for there is a glowing hole you need to get. the hole is randomly chosen and will be moving downward with the other holes. the holes in this mode will only come from the top and be going downward. If you miss a glowing hole it will chose another hole. All you have to do in this mode is stay alive as long as possible while also getting the glowing holes to increase your score. Phantom In the Phantom Game mode you will do exactly the same as in the classic mode but there is a twist. Depending on the sub game mode selected you will have one item in the game (ball, paddle, holes) flicker and disappear for a short time. The objects that disappear will be gone for a short amount of time but will then reappear again shortly. Speedball In the Speedball game mode it will also be exactly like the classic mode however, to get points you will need to make the ball go as fast as it can into the correct hole to get more points. The faster the ball moves into the correct hole the more points you will get for that hole. If you use barely any speed you get no points. the points you can get from this game mode are 0, 1, 2, 3, and 5. To get 5 you need to make the ball go incredibly fast into the correct hole. Endless In the Endless game mode it will also be just like the classic mode except you get to play infinitely! You will be able to get your scores higher than what can be done in Classic or Speedball. There will also be a timer to show you how long you have played the endless mode as well. The more points you have and the shorter amount of time you got them in can show the world how good you are at the Endless mode. High Score Board This game features a online or local high score board for all game modes. On the online board try your hand at being the best in the world at one of the game modes or even all of them! On the local board you can play against others who use your device and you can have a friendly competition with people around you you know.
row.short_description: Take control of a paddles left and right sides and move them up or down to guide a ball! Guide the ball through several game modes by either dodging on-coming holes trying to make your ball collide with them or by aiming for glowing holes that give you points for entering them.

row.name: 幻兽骑士
row.detailed_description: In the kingdom of the Phantom Knights, the mysterious and magnificent star spiritual energy of nature gave birth to humans and green dwarves. At the beginning of the story, the two tribes also had close ties and affection. They each selected the most outstanding and powerful knights within their tribe, and worked together to explore this vast but perilous wilderness of another world, ultimately establishing the Star Dome Knight Kingdom. However, one day, many treasure chests fell from the sky, which was not a gift from heaven, but Pandora's magic box. After prying open the treasure chest, people were surprised to find many valuable and powerful equipment treasures inside. The seeds of greed gradually spread and sprouted, and many people of the Knight Kingdom violated their original creed of 'vowing to maintain the unity of the kingdom and world peace to the death.'. In order to profit from the treasure chest, they plundered not only the chest but also their lives recklessly. A young knight found an ancient prophecy parchment note in an inconspicuous wooden box next to the ruins of his ancestors. He gently brushed away the dust, carefully read the text on it, and slowly read, 'Go find the sword that emits a rainbow like halo, you will end the infinite chain of this dispute.' Brave knight, the boy who found the rainbow light in the treasure chest, could it be you? [Game features] As newcomers to the Knights, the first gameplay that knights encounter is blind box unboxing. By opening the treasure chest, the knight can quickly obtain equipment that can enhance his combat power and arm himself. As more and more treasure chests are opened, the knights will constantly eliminate old equipment and sell it. The gold coins obtained during this process can be used to upgrade the treasure chests and increase the probability of obtaining top-notch equipment; Or enhance the cool cloak to make your little knight stronger. In addition to their adventures on the continent of the early Knight Kingdom, knights gradually became exposed to various other types of looting and combat system gameplay. Territory plundering not only allows for the collection of massive resources, but also triggers intense battles between knights. And through the Peak Arena, everyone can compete with excellent knights from all over the world, using their solid combat power to win the championship! Of course, it doesn't matter if you're tired of adventure. The Knights Continent also has a variety of leisure and entertainment gameplay that can relax the body and mind of the knights. Leisure 'fishing' gameplay can help you obtain rich fishing catch. Collecting fishing guides may make you the next king of fishing. The 'Dance Companion' gameplay allows you to easily make vows with multiple cute girls, further enhancing your attribute combat power, and your unbreakable bonds will become the foundation of victory.
row.short_description: Want to open a blind box? Want to DIY match equipment? Do you want to hatch phantom beast elves? Are you bored and even want to catch a big lobster? Become the Phantom Beast Knight, and you will personally compose the adventure and thrilling fantasy of the other world continent!

row.name: Armless Samurai
row.detailed_description: Go leg to leg with the fast-paced gauntlet of Armless Samurai. Armless Samurai is a fast paced first-person parkour game where you play as a samurai whose limbs have been lost in battle, and robbed from their arsenal. Worry not, however, they haven’t taken your legs yet! And this will be your enemy's greatest mistake… In an effort to seek vengeance for your limbs, take on a mountain of monstrous machines and obstacles to ascend the mighty fortress. As a now armless samurai, you must dash, kick & fight your way through six unique levels on your mission of revenge! Become a warrior of legend, Armless Samurai! Key Features: Fast paced parkour movement! Do anything to rush through. Slide through the castle, charge and dash through your enemies, even run on walls! Use your legs for everything! Parry projectiles, fight enemies, destroy obstacles and move around using just your legs. Battle against mechanical enemies and dangerous obstacles! Fight against a wide range of unique enemies as you move through each level. Avoid and defeat the castle’s dangerous obstacles using your samurai parkour skills. Score grading system! Race against the clock for the fastest times while competing for the highest scores. Combo your attacks to increase your score, aiming to get the highest possible and the legendary SSS rank, or just dash your way through the levels as fast as possible. Compete against others! Move around the castle as fast as possible whilst fighting enemies to gain the highest scores possible. Compete against your friends and other players on the Steam leaderboard.
row.short_description: Your arms may be taken from you, but not your honour. Your legs have become your sword and shield. Run on walls, dive kick & dash into your enemies, parry bullets with your shins. Become a warrior of legend, Armless Samurai!

row.name: KICK ME!
row.detailed_description: Welcome to KICK ME! - the ultimate multiplayer PvP game where the rooftops are your battlefield! Get ready for an adrenaline-pumping experience as you strive to kick your opponents off the edge while avoiding the same fate. Craft your strategy, master unique abilities and powerful boosts to dominate the competition. Features: Intense PvP Action: Engage in thrilling player-versus-player battles on dynamic rooftops. Strategize and outmaneuver your opponents to secure victory. Strategic Gameplay: It's not just about kicking; it's about survival. Plan your moves wisely, anticipate your rivals' actions, and stay one step ahead. Unique Abilities: Unleash a variety of special abilities to gain the upper hand. Whether it's a speed boost, a powerful knockback, or a surprise maneuver, choose the right ability at the right time to turn the tide in your favor. Boosts Galore: Keep an eye out for power-boosts scattered across the rooftops. Grab them to enhance your abilities, increase your strength, or gain a temporary advantage over your opponents. Dynamic Environments: Explore a variety of rooftop arenas, each with its own challenges and quirks. Adapt to your surroundings and use them to your advantage in the quest for supremacy. Multiplayer Mayhem: Team up with friends or go solo in intense multiplayer matches. Prove that you have the skills and strategy to be the last kicker standing. Get ready to experience the thrill of rooftop combat like never before in KICK ME! Are you up for the challenge? Kick, strategize, and dominate!
row.short_description: Kick opponents off rooftops in KICK ME! Multiplayer PvP madness awaits as you strategize, deploy unique abilities, and grab boosts to secure victory. Navigate dynamic arenas, and be the best kicker! Are you up for the challenge?
row.notes: Game contains blood

row.name: GRR BOO I
row.detailed_description: GRR BOO i is a 2D plateformer. It stands out with its childish graphics, but don't be fooled, the difficulty is too high for children. In this game, don't be afraid to push your limits ! Do you have what it takes to complete the 10 levels playable in 4 different difficulties ?! Will you be able to use your 4 powers correctly to defeat the many monsters lurking around ? GRR BOO i is a test in your life. Try it ! NOW !!!
row.short_description: GRR BOO i is a 2D plateformer. It stands out with its childish graphics, but don't be fooled, the difficulty is too high for children.

row.name: Wraith
row.detailed_description: Difficult combat, for those who crave the relief of overcoming difficult challenges:  Boss Battles, With their own challenges and lore: Movement: use the provided movement to maintain a consistent distance to your enemies and to make pushes and escapes: This game also features: A variety of collectable perks such as: seeing enemies through walls, slowing time, and autofiring Multiple gamemodes such as: the floor is lava, no healing, and weapon shuffle A variety of weapons, such as bows, shotguns, and SMGs A variety of enemies such as: machine gunners, riot shielders, and shotgunners Sandbox-like difficulty options such as: changing enemy behaviour, player damage, and removal of heal limitations
row.short_description: Wraith is a hardcore roguelike FPS designed to test your determination and skills. Learn to fight the variety of enemies and to master the movement.
row.notes: Constant fantasy violence. There is blood splatter when you hit an enemy. (kids under the age of 12 should not play, as it is harder for them to differentiate between real life and fantasy)

row.name: HYPER DEMON PVP
row.detailed_description: HYPER DEMON PVP is a free online 1v1 FPS. Master your movement, aim, timing and resources to defeat your opponents in intense duels. With precise lasers and powerful charge shots, damage your opponent to grow their weak point. Hit the weak point to defeat them instantly. Defeat them 3 times to win the match. Use your recharging shield to avoid damage and reflect projectiles. Compete on the global leaderboard. Create private lobbies to challenge your friends. Watch replays and spectate other players to improve. Study the tutorials and practice with a CPU opponent while waiting for the next match to start. 1v1-only allows for a unique server architecture. Each match will use the server with the best ping for both players. Originally a secret easter egg in HYPER DEMON, PVP is now expanded and available free for everyone. Enjoy responsibly.
row.short_description: HYPER DEMON PVP is a free online 1v1 FPS. Master simple but deep mechanics and defeat opponents in intense duels to climb the global leaderboard.

row.name: Vollema
row.detailed_description: In Vollema , you assume the role of a college student on your university's volleyball team. While en route to The Big Game, you and one of your teammates accidentally stumble upon a major conspiracy surrounding the school, local politics, and a cult-like paramilitary organization. Looks like the tournament is going to have to wait. As you unravel the story, you will... Recruit new party members capable of countering different attacks during combat, indicated by color and sound cues. Explore various unique and colorful locations, each one giving you and your party a slightly different look. Wrestle a goat. Encounter manmade horrors beyond your comprehension. Meet some... unique individuals and creatures inhabiting the surrounding area. And maybe even make it to The Big Game after all! Look out for yourself and your team, because someone, somewhere, is absolutely out to get you!
row.short_description: Vollema is a hand-drawn, color-changing RPG featuring a unique pattern memorization-based combat system where you and your classmates uncover a sinister plot involving your school, local politics, and a cult-like paramilitary organization.
row.notes: This game contains content that some may find distressing such as body horror, kidnapping, implied abuse, and brief references to animal abuse.

row.name: Grim
row.detailed_description: We present to you GRIM, a spooky narrative game where the player is dead and through the possession of various objects as a ghost, players can make world-shaping decisions that decide the fate of their twin trapped inside the same house with a vicious monster! You and Jia must fight off the monsters of the night, figure out what happened to your parents, and reveal the dark passages, hidden away from innocent eyes. Inspired by the different retellings of the original Taiwanese folklore “Aunt Tiger”, Grim provides players with a unique experience exploring an immersive 3D environment and a dynamic narrative where players will uncover different storylines based on their decisions. As a ghost, players can possess objects and toggle different physics-based movements with unique controls depending on various items.
row.short_description: Grim is a horror game inspired from Taiwanese folklore “Aunt Tiger”. The player will play in a room-oriented 3rd-person perspective as a “ghost” and will observe the world from fixed camera perspectives to solve puzzles and survive the monster’s pursuit.

row.name: Sporti's Universe
row.detailed_description: What is Sporti's Universe? Sporti's Universe is not just a game; it's a revolutionary approach to promoting physical activity among school-aged children. In an era where screens and video games often keep kids indoors and sedentary, Sporti's Universe empowers them to use their movements to control in-game actions and characters, all while having fun. Key Features: Encouraging Physical Activity: Sporti's Universe makes physical activity enjoyable by allowing children to control the game through their movements, promoting active gameplay. Diverse Sports Activities: The game offers a wide variety of sports activities, including climbing, snowboarding, kayaking, and more, providing a range of active experiences. Immersive Experience: Sporti's Universe creates an immersive virtual sports world with lifelike motions and camera-based AI animations, enhancing the overall gaming experience. Body-Controlled Gameplay: Players' movements serve as the controller, making it a genuinely physical and active gaming experience that keeps kids moving. Accessibility: The game is designed with low technical requirements, ensuring that a broad audience can access and enjoy it. It is compatible with inexpensive web cameras, making it accessible to many users.
row.short_description: Sporti's Universe is an innovative exergame designed to address the challenge of getting school-aged children to engage in physical activity in today's digital age. It leverages technology to encourage physical movement while providing an engaging and enjoyable gaming experience.

row.name: Construction Runner
row.detailed_description: This is the first game I made using Unreal Engine and also the first game I have ever released to the public. This is just a simple Jump ’n’ Run game where you are running through a construction site and have do dodge the obstacles coming towards you and based on the time you survived you get awarded points If you are wondering about the high system requirements down below those are just the settings that I could test since I dont have more hardware to my disposal.
row.short_description: A very simple Jump ’n’ Run game where you run through a construction site.

row.name: Whispering Death
row.detailed_description: Step into the chilling world of Whispering Death , a survival horror game with intricate puzzle elements that will keep you on the edge of your seat. In this game, you play as a man who wakes up in a nightmarish realm, stripped of his memories and haunted by the unknown. Your goal is to remember who you are and find a way out of this terrifying place. Navigate through a frightful environment teeming with monstrous creatures and sinister entities that thirst for your demise. The game masterfully blends storytelling, and puzzle-solving, ensuring a gripping experience that challenges both your wits and nerves. Whispering Death stands out with its procedurally generated items, offering players a unique experience each time they play. This feature ensures that no two playthroughs are the same, demanding new strategies and approaches every time you dive into the horror. Prepare yourself for a survival horror experience like no other, where every corner hides a new threat and every step could be your last.
row.short_description: Whispering Death: Prologue draws you into a twisted world built from the remnants of your past. Solve puzzles, search for answers, and stay alert - She’s always watching, and one wrong decision can end everything.
row.notes: The game will feature episodic scenes and references to death and violence.

row.name: Gracia
row.detailed_description: Gracia is a platform that redefines virtual reality, offering free-viewpoint ultra-photorealistic VR experiences. It's not just about seeing; it's about stepping inside a volumetric photo with freedom to walk around, where every detail is so vivid, you'll forget it's virtual. Key features: - Unmatched Photorealism: Gracia’s advanced rendering technology blurs the line between virtual and reality and creates a feeling as if you are inside high-resolution photograph. - 6DOF Volumetric Scenes: Move and interact within our scenes with complete freedom as if you were really there. - Extremely High Fidelity: Up to 550 fps at native resolution. - User-Generated Content: Publish your own PLY scenes on Gracia, enhancing the platform's collection - Ever Expanding Collection of Scenes: Regular updates keep the content fresh and exciting.
row.short_description: Gracia is the world's first platform for viewing and publishing free-viewpoint ultra-photorealistic VR experiences. It's not just about seeing; it's about stepping inside a photo with freedom to walk around, where every detail is so vivid, you'll forget it's virtual.

row.name: Forest Ranger Simulator - Apprenticeship
row.detailed_description: Forest Ranger Simulator - Apprenticeship is a free prologue to Forest Ranger Simulator. You have 45 minutes to explore the game, have a glimpse of the story and the game mechanics. If you like it. Here you can get the full game. Take care of forgotten nature's treasure. Build, craft, feed, clean, and manage your forest in Forest Ranger Simulator. Ensure its long-lasting beauty and become a flawless Forest Ranger! WHAT CAN YOU DO IN FOREST RANGER SIMULATOR ⚒️ Build & Repair - seatings, benches, feeders, bridges and more 🧰 Craft - create something useful out of not useful items 📚 Learn - read and learn about real life nature in your notebook 🐦 Feed - hungry animals such as ducks or birds need to be fed ⭐ Unlock Items & Badges - advance through game to unlock new items and get rewards 🏃‍♂️ Explore - walk, run, drive and watch beautiful nature by day and night 🗑️ Sort & Clean - help forest and clean it from garbage, lots of different trash need sorting 💰 Buy and Sell l - use online store to earn some $ 🪓 Gather - mushrooms, brushwood, timber, honey and more 🌲 Take Care of the Forest - estinguish fires, get rid of traps and more DO WHAT YOU LIKE - it's sandbox, play how you like it! QUESTS Forest Ranger always has his hands full. The number and variety of quests will not let anyone get bored. Some tasks you can complete without hurry, in others you will have to do a little jogging. Some will require the use of a car. We do not want to reveal too much. See for yourself. CRAFTING What is crafting in Forest Ranger Simulator? It's creating useful things from literally whatever you can find. Sometimes you'll definitely feel like MacGyver. GATHERING In order to create something you first have to tear it down. Specifically, we need to acquire materials for building and crafting. To build a table we will need wood. In addition, in the forest we can find many other valuable things like mushrooms. LEARNING Forest Ranger Simulator is a game, however, we wanted to include as much valuable information from real life as possible in the game. Thanks to the notebook you will learn a lot about the work of a Forest Ranger, you will also find many interesting facts about forests, such as information about mushrooms. Learn by playing. The name simulator obliges. WORKSHOP Workbench. There's nothing like having everything at hand. Saw, pliers, hammer, paintbrush.... and many more tools ready to go. Why not build a bird feeder? DAY & NIGHT The profession of Forest Ranger is not a job from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. Here you have to be on guard day and night. Remember that the night is dark, and the only light is the glow of the moon and your flashlight. Watching the sunset or the beauty of the moon.... priceless. CLEANING Forests, it's not just trees, leaves and animals, it's a ton of trash left by people. You will find more than 150 different trash here. Sometimes you will be surprised what you can find in the forest. Remember that everything has to be sorted. You have special trash garbage cans for this. Some skills as well as large garbage bags will be helpful in cleaning up. EMERGENCIES A Forest Ranger has to be alert at all times. You need to observe what's going on in your forest and quickly intervene with a threat. Maybe it's a smoldering fire, or maybe poachers have set up snares again.

row.name: Shadow Touched
row.detailed_description: EARLY ACCESS This game is currently in its early access phase, indicating that certain elements may undergo changes or removal. The game will get updates, although not on a regular schedule. Description Embark on a platforming journey with Shadow Touched, a 2D platformer created from my long programming apprenticeship journey. This project, developed in almost two months, has evolved beyond its academic roots into a passion project that I am committed to expanding over time. Key Features: Unique Dimensional Gameplay: Take control of Twilight, the main character, and master the art of dimension-hopping. In the normal form, Twilight has a single jump, a dash, and a basic attack pattern. Switch to the shadow dimension for increased movement speed, higher jump height, an additional jump, and three powerful attack patterns with enhanced damage. Choose your form wisely to navigate the intricate levels and overcome challenges. Strategic Platforming: Traverse diverse and meticulously designed levels that will test your platforming skills. Formidable Foes: Encounter the formidable Knight, your primary adversary in the shadowy realms. Stay on your guard as these enemies will strike if you get too close. Use your dimensional powers to defeat them quickly! Checkpoint System: Shadow Touched features a checkpoint system. If Twilight meets her end, she respawns at the last checkpoint touched and you can continue your adventure without losing progress. Do not let your lives reach zero though! Power-ups: Shadow Touched features power-ups that enhance the player's gameplay. Double jump : Allows Twilight to jump an additional time. Light Shard : Grants a 1-up. Darkness Dispersal : Removes a percentage of darkness. The higher the current darkness, the more it removes. Jump Impulse : Shoots Twilight vertically. Speed Boost : Grants increased movement speed for a short duration. Dashify : Allows Twilight to dash an additional time (has no effect in shadow form). Note: Shadow Touched is an ongoing project, and I am committed to expanding and enhancing the game based on player feedback and evolving ideas. Join me on this journey as we shape the destiny of Twilight and explore the boundless possibilities of the shadow dimension. Controls Move with WASD or Arrow keys. Jump with Space. Interrupt jumps with S or down arrow key. Holding the button will make the character drop down faster. Attack with C or Left mouse button. Shift between dimensions with F.
row.short_description: Shadow Touched is a 2D platformer where the player has to use their platforming skills and travel between dimensions to complete levels.

row.name: Folgore
row.detailed_description: what Is Folgore Folgore is a top view fighting game, inspired by comics, taking place in south Italy at the end of the 60’s. To save his fiancée and his honor, the hero must cross the city of Olimpia, inspired by Naples, and eliminate all types of enemies on his way to the final boss. To do that, he makes a pact with the Folgore, a divine artifact endowed with electrical powers from Jupiter, but renowned to be dangerous for its owner . With the Folgore, the player can attack by combining melee attacks and electrical powers. He can also interact with his environment to stun his enemies and continue the level. During some scenarized moments, an ultimate power called the overload activates to remind the instability of the Folgore and make the player experience even more pleasurable. The goal in Folgore is to let off steam while playing an original game full of dark humor. The player needs to feel the strength of his powers, but also the shift of the “hero” to the dark side. To treat this subject correctly, we took a lot of inspiration from dark comics like Batman, we decided to combine 2D and 3D to accentuate this. To understand the genesis of Folgore, look at a comic book. But instead of reading it, you are going to play it. In Folgore, we wanted a strong identity : the temporality of the game is unique, blending the Italian 50’s and Roman mythology, which allowed us a lot of liberty, especially for the creation of enemies. The dark comics aesthetic and humor of the game remind the player of the anti-hero personality of the playable character, but also the grim after-war period in Italy. For the gameplay, we came back to the basics : not a lot of inputs and a gameplay easy to learn that needs to be mastered to be effective. The originality resides in the electrical powers that Giove got from the Folgore : It allows him to interact with his environment and perform faster and more powerful attacks and movements, while getting the player to manage his power gauge to survive the enemies' waves. Finally, even if it's better to play the game with a controller, we chose to adapt the game for arcades to remember the feeling of an old school beat them all. Team: Hugo Angel : Sound Designer (Audio Workshop) Sasha Bassanetti : Sound Designer (Audio Workshop) Léo Beauchamp : Lead Scenario / 2D Artist (ETPA) Khenan Benanou : Lead Programmer / AI Programmer / Lead Level Design (ETPA) Eve Cabanié : Lead Producer / Lead Artistic Direction / 3D Character Artist (ETPA) Sami Delvallée : Lead 3D Artist / Environment Artist / Lead Sound Design (ETPA) Mathis Dinger : Lead VFX / Programmer (ETPA) Thomas Exshaw : 3D Props Artist (ETPA) Maxime Maridet : Lead Animator / Rigger (ETPA) Edouard Mordant : Gameplay Programmer / Lead Game Designer (ETPA) Anaïs Tigneres Agout : Lead 2D Artist / UI-UX Designer / 3D Props Artist (ETPA)
row.short_description: 1959 - Olimpia, South Italy. Play as Giove Scadenza and save your fiancée from the Inferna mafia with your newfound powers. Can you survive the Folgore ?

row.detailed_description: Explore the newly discovered island of Anakalys where new species of creatures, called Emergent Organisms, now roam freely! The island awaits! An open-world island Welcome to Anakalys , an island seemingly born from the mists! You play as the Rookie Resarcher, a newbie looking to make their name as a researcher in the modern age of exploration. Dr. Cooper, a legend-turned-hermit researcher, discovered this mysterious island, and he wants YOU to research its inhabitants! In this single-player open-world exploration game, you'll journey the island yourself! Anakalys is home to a vibrant jungle environment, the perfect home for an exceptionally cute selection of animals to roam about. Additionally, Anakalysis is home to a unique phenomena of floating chunks of land, which may lead you to new places... Meet the residents On the island, you'll be tasked with photographing the EO's with your trusty camera! Take photos of the organisms doing their day-to-day routines such as eating, bathing, and socializing! Completing specific objectives will reward you with some money, which can be used to purchase player equipment! Additionally, the EO's will leave a number of valuable pick-up items around the island to help speed up your equipment funding. With equipment, you'll find that exploring the island will be a breeze! Get equipped There are multiple upgrades available to help you maneuver around the island. With enough objectives completed, no place will be unreachable for the stalwart Rookie Researcher! For example, double-jump boots will definitely get you over some of those pesky floating platforms! Remember: it's not science if you don't write it down Additionally, completing objectives will help fill out your research database, powered by the Advanced Data Terminal (aka the A.D.T)! Each step gets you closer to fully uncovering the mysterious life on the island, with three unique EO's to become acquainted with. What are ya waitin' for? Get to explorin'!
row.short_description: Explore a fantastical island where fantastical new creatures await! Run, jump, and glide your way to discover new animals to photograph and become the next great Emergent Organism Researcher in this single-player island exploration game! What surprises await you on the island?

row.name: The Circle Tales: Elvenwoods
row.detailed_description: Elvenwoods is a story-driven action-adventure game, and the first instalment of the Dark Aeon saga. It is an experimental project made to learn game development, and is now available for everyone on Steam. It will therefore remain completely free. In the beginning, there was a Source. This Source was the origin of every universe, and the only thing that prevented time and space to collapse. In the year 5000 of the Creation Era, the high priest of the Dead God Tarisdum destroyed the Source, starting a ten-thousand-year prophecy. Its first events take place in Vàlochlin, a young world built by the Warlord Dusnol to hide the skull of the Dead God. You are Imriel of Darkwood, Green Spirit of the Circle, an elf who dreams of exploring the world. After arriving in the Elvenwoods, you begin a quest to slay a resurrected Tarisdum, and to uncover the mystery of the Three Enemies. The beginning of a saga A 10-hour long, fully voiced story. Elvenwoods is a story-driven game, based on a main questline and seven factions. Epic battles A dynamic sword, bow, and magic combat system. 18 unique boss battles await the players, as well as a trials mode for those who seek a true challenge. A vast open world The world of Elvenwoods expands on three different maps and more than a hundred locations to explore. Players can travel by foot, on a mount, on a boat, or even by flying.
row.short_description: The Circle Tales: Elvenwoods is a free-to-play action-adventure game where you embark on a journey to slay a god. The very first game by Studio Castor, set in a medieval high fantasy open world.

row.name: BUMPER BALLS
row.detailed_description: BUMPER BALLS: The Ultimate Raffle Game” Looking for an exciting and customizable way to conduct raffles? Bumper Balls is the best game for the job. Dive into a world of fun, where you can choose from a variety of characters, maps, and game modes. 🌟 Features: Classic Mode (Available Now): - Draw for up to 30 players simultaneously. - Keep it simple and timeless with the classic mode. Upcoming Modes (Not Available Now): Party Mode: - Draw winners for an epic crowd of up to 1000 players! - Turn your giveaways into massive celebrations. Multiplayer Mode: - Watch the draw unfold with your friends in real time. - Share the excitement and cheer together. Creative Mode: - Unleash your imagination! - Design your own unique characters for the ultimate personalized experience. Join Bumper Balls and make your raffles unforgettable! 🎉🔥
row.short_description: The best game to carry out raffles in a much more interactive and fun way.

row.name: Autotag
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Autotag the online gaming experience that combines the thrill of classic tag with an arsenal of powerful weapons for an intense and action-packed competition! In this adrenaline-fueled destructible arena, players will engage in heart-pounding matches where the goal is not only to avoid being tagged but to defend yourself using a variety of unique weapons. Physics Based Weapons All weapons in Autotag are physics based to make gameplay a little bit more fun and less predictable. That also means players can be thrown into a roll after being hit with a cannon ball, or thrown into a tree by an tank turret round. If projectiles aren't your thing then the flamethrower might be a good weapon to pickup. Boosts to Tag & Escape Boosting into another player is an instant kill and the best way to earn XP! So make sure you master the art of traveling fast without flying off into the sea. Remember cars can't swim! Moveable Objects & Breakables All objects are loose and physics based to act as an obstacle to get in players way when on the move to tag you. Helping you to escape with a chair might just win you the game. Key Features Online Multiplayer Battles Physics Based Weapons Multiple Game Modes (Battle, Autotag)...more to come Quick Match Restarts Server Hosting Features Planned Battle Royal Mode Weapon Racing Multiple Maps Weapon Ranks More Weapons More Car Models Much Much More... Thank you for taking the time to read the games description, feel free to head back up and hit that Wishlist or join the discord for more information.
row.short_description: Battle your friends in this cozy cartoon multiplayer car shooter! Get unique physics based weapons to destroy your friends and customise your car to suit your style! Get tagging and bagging them kills today!

row.name: Project Entropy
row.detailed_description: Welcome, commander, to Project Entropy - the ultimate Sci-Fi and role-playing game with space battles. Immerse yourself in this MMO experience where you'll command alien civilizations, conquer uncharted planets, and build Hero fleets. Command Alien Civilizations: Take control of alien civilizations and lead them to victory. Each civilization comes with its unique abilities, technologies, and units, providing diverse gameplay experiences. Conquer Uncharted Planets: Embark on an adventure across the cosmos and conquer uncharted planets. Explore unknown territories, engage in epic battles, and expand your empire to dominate the galaxy. Build Hero Fleets: Assemble powerful fleets of hero ships, each with its special abilities and attributes. Customize your fleets to suit your playstyle and lead them to victory against formidable foes. Customize Mechs and Weapons: Modify and upgrade your mechs and high-tech weapons to enhance their capabilities on the battlefield. Experiment with different combinations to create the ultimate war machines. Engage in Intense PvP and PvE Battles: Challenge other players in intense PvP battles or team up with friends to take on challenging PvE encounters. Test your skills, strategy, and teamwork to emerge victorious in battle. Explore Vast Maps: Discover vast and diverse maps filled with unique challenges, resources, and secrets. Uncover the mysteries of the universe as you journey through space and conquer new territories. Join a Global Community: Connect with players from around the world, form alliances, and compete in epic interstellar conflicts. Forge friendships, share strategies, and rise to become a legend in the galaxy. Season-Based Gameplay: Experience dynamic gameplay with seasonal updates that introduce new planets, challenges, and rewards. Stay engaged with fresh content and compete for dominance in the ever-changing universe. Epic Storyline: Immerse yourself in an epic storyline filled with intrigue, betrayal, and discovery. Unravel the mysteries of the universe and shape the fate of civilizations as you embark on a thrilling adventure. Stunning Visuals and Sound: Enjoy stunning graphics and immersive sound effects that bring the universe of Project Entropy to life. Immerse yourself in the beauty and chaos of space battles like never before. Embark on an epic journey across the stars and become the ultimate commander in Project Entropy. Download now and join the battle for galactic supremacy!
row.short_description: Welcome, commander, to Project Entropy- an ultimate Sci-Fi and role-playing game with battles in space. In this immersive MMO experience, you will command alien civilizations, conquer uncharted planets, and build Hero fleets.

row.name: Welcome to Ukraine
row.detailed_description: I've come to the realization that there's so much about my own country that I don't know. In light of this, I've developed a game to share my journey of discovering Ukraine. It's Jigsaws with lot of useful features. Through this interactive experience, I hope to offer insights into the rich culture, history, and beauty of our country. I hope it will be interesting not only for jigsaw puzzle lovers;) I want to keep this game free and I will update it from time to time with new pictures and features Multiple puzzle pieces selection 3 different Cutouts shapes Rotation and Sorting features Useful Zoom and Magnifier tool Customizable background color Wide cutout range I used CC0, self generated content or pictures I have permission from the author. I will try to deal with local photographers to provide more quality pictures and facts of my country. Also, you can check my other puzzle game (which uses the same engine) Master of Pieces - Jigsaw Puzzles! Enjoy game and share your thoughts! Peace!
row.short_description: I've come to the realization that there's so much about my own country that I don't know. In light of this, I've developed a game to share my journey of discovering Ukraine. Through this interactive experience, I hope to offer insights into the rich culture, history, and beauty of our country.

row.name: Bodyrain
row.detailed_description: - Fast paced and precise shooting mechanics - A wide variety of weapons and grenades to use against the hordes - Many different types of zombies, each with different attacks and strategies - 5 unique bosses to fight and beat the game - The ability to level up your character and improve its attributes - An infinite game mode on a special map - Stunning stylized graphics and effects - A dynamic soundtrack to slaughter zombies Dawn City, once a bustling urban center, found itself suddenly plunged into darkness on a stormy September night. A disastrous scientific experiment resulted in the leakage of an experimental substance, turning the inhabitants into insatiable zombies. To contain the threat, authorities imposed an impenetrable quarantine, isolating a portion the city from the rest of the world. Years passed, and Dawn City became a field of ruins. Gangs of survivors fought over scarce resources, while zombies ruled the dark, empty streets. Amidst this chaos, an unlikely hero emerged: a zombie hunter known as 'Raven.' Clad only in makeshift armor and armed to the teeth, established an outpost on the outskirts of the city called Refuge of Hope. There, the fearless could accept missions to eradicate the undead in exchange for rewards. Players, assuming the role of bounty hunters, ventured into the Urban Ruins in search of challenges. The locations were eerily familiar but now dominated by abandonment and despair. Once bustling streets were now dangerous, and once imposing buildings had become infested fortresses. The goal is to completely eradicate all zombies from the quarantine and rebuild the city, with 5 of them being very difficult bosses to defeat, requiring the player to save money to improve their weapons and attributes to stand a chance against them.
row.short_description: Slaughter hordes of zombies and challenging bosses in Bodyrain: a zombie FPS game! Accumulate money to acquire new weapons and gain experience to strengthen your character and clean up Dawn City!
row.notes: Bodyrain contains blood, dismemberment and violence with firearms, knifes and grenades

row.name: Karga
row.detailed_description: In the virtual game 'Karga,' the player assume the role of a hero defender who joins forces with a mighty dragon to confront the sinister witch Hag and her army of darkness. Armed with a pair of revolvers loaded with bullets imbued with the elements of fire and ice, the hero gallantly enters the battlefield. These potent revolvers are not the only weapons in the hero's arsenal; he also possesses special skills that assist him in combating countless hordes of skeletons, giant spiders, and ghostly creatures sent by the Witch to impede her. With each battle, the hero's skills improve, and his weapons and abilities grow in strength. The game features a brief storyline that unravels the motives behind the Witch's desire to seize the dragon's gold. Additionally, a survival mode offers players the opportunity to fend off endless waves of adversaries, determining the ultimate defender.
row.short_description: In the game 'Karga,' players become hero defenders aided by a dragon to battle the witch Hag and her dark army. Armed with elemental revolvers and special skills, they combat various foes. The hero's abilities and weapons strengthen with each battle.
row.notes: The elements of animated violence are present in the game, where NPCs, including skeletons, can dismember in explosions. NPCs perish from hits. When the Witch rises after transformation, it may involve nudity display.

row.name: Cardboard Chronicles
row.detailed_description: A puzzle adventure game all about thinking inside the box. In a world made entirely of cardboard and doodles, you are the one who created it all. A child with nothing else to play with but some boxes and crayons gets spirited away into their imaginary world and becomes a doodle themselves! Smash and fling your way through puzzles as you help the strange characters you meet on the way to freeing yourself in Cardboard Chronicles! Take control of Doodle to interact with eccentric NPCs, solves simple, yet engaging puzzles, use your slam abilities to smack enemies and objects, and defend Doodleburg from an encroaching evil that threatens to destroy your cardboard world.
row.short_description: Welcome to Doodleburg! You play Doodle, a child who has been transported into a cardboard world of their own creation. Not all is well in the Burg of Doodle. An ancient, extradimensional evil has awoken and it's up to you to save this idyllic town from its ravenous rampage.

row.name: Caden's Climb
row.detailed_description: Caden's Climb is a fast-paced platformer inspired by Pizza Tower & the WarioLand series (emphasis on 'inspired by Pizza Tower') where you play as Caden Climb, the indie developer on a quest to stop the CEO of Super Silly Softwares, Christopher Manman, from absolutely destroying your game company while making sure to rescue all 5 smalls from each level (and collecting the Dodecahedron!) In Caden's Climb, you can expect a variety of ways to play such as, Classic: Maneuver your way through a level, slam the button and run to your nearest exit! Try go as fast as you can and get the best rank possible! If the stability of the realm falls apart however. Blacko WILL stop you. Race: Race against your friend, and pastaria owner, Caden Smalls! Deathrun: Battle against time, in an ultimate race to the exit. Collect clocks to increase your timer, but beware. If the timer runs out, it won't look so hot on your ranking. Boss: Fight one of Christopher Manman's best minions! Kill them! (that last part is really up to you.) Wyatt's Levels: Dive through a giant conglomerate of the current world's levels but be warned. The pirate always prevails, and you certainly don't understand what you're dealing with.
row.short_description: A fast-paced 2D platformer inspired by a whole buncha stuff!

row.name: League of Masters: Auto Chess
row.detailed_description: League of Masters is the next generation of PvP! We've combined elements of Auto Chess and RPG to create a strategic game with a deep progression system. Every player has a chance to win, but the higher your tactical preparation, the greater your chances of success! Showcase your intellect and claim victory! Unlike traditional Auto Chess games, success also depends on the power of your commanders, but they won't succeed without your smart and tactical approach. Join the League of Masters community now and help your commanders secure victory! Prove your worth in PVP battles In PvP battles, you'll fight against players from around the world. Everything will come into play: cunning, tactics, strategic maneuvers, and even psychological attacks. And most importantly, you can conduct a battle and defeat the enemy in just 15 minutes. Specially designed graphics for the genre will finally help distinguish units from each other. We've put in the effort! Level up your commanders and dominate In League of Masters, there are a whopping 12 unique commanders! Each has its own abilities that increase damage and enhance tactics. Even if your opponents lack experience and skills, their commanders can be much stronger than yours, so you always need to be on guard and adjust your strategy as the battle unfolds. Choose fighters wisely Demon or genie? Mage or archer? The game features over 50 units of different classes and synergies for both PvP and PvE battles. Just look at how powerful they are! Assemble an unbeatable team and test different strategies to find the perfect one. Crafted by strategists for strategists Our team consists almost entirely of players with 20 years of experience, who prioritize skill and knowledge over grind and unfair play. League of Masters is pure strategy, endless possibilities, and fair competition.
row.short_description: League of Masters is a new take on the Auto Chess genre. Our game is a dynamic PvP experience with a deep progression system. Challenge friends and foes in an epic battle of wits that will determine who the true strategist is.
row.notes: Adult content refers to the ability to defeat an enemy, essentially eliminating them. In the game, this action is not accompanied by any additional effects. There are no scenes of violence in the game.

row.name: The Crack (壳中之物）
row.detailed_description: Are you still contacting your friends from school? Do you still remember the love from the youth? And even more, do you still have the dream that keeps your heart beating? You’ve been trained to have a heart covered by unbreakable shell. In this game, you are going through a journey to crack it, leading to the long forgotten. Who is murmuring in the dark? Who is screaming for help through the crack? Happiness and torture, past and current, drop by drop, are all there to be collected, by you. When it is finally at your fingertip, will you become a warrior, a deserter, or, a murderer? Humbly offered by SMS Studio, a journey of Crack. Key Features Rigorous Original Plot: A tightly woven narrative intertwining reasoning with flashbacks and dialogues, progressively deepening and leading players to understand the stories of each character from various perspectives while solving puzzles. Rich Story Choices: Diverse story directions and endings, where each choice can lead to unexpected consequences. Mystery Puzzle Elements: Combining traditional text-based gameplay with modern mystery elements, offering players an experience that is both familiar and novel. Exquisite Visual Style: Beautifully designed scenes and character art, immersing players as if they were in the midst of the story, having face-to-face conversations with the characters. Beautiful Original Music: A rich collection of original background music, enhancing the immersive experience of solving mysteries. Settings: Use settings to switch to Chinese and English
row.short_description: Crack is a text adventure game that combines a profound emotional experience with elements of mystery and puzzle-solving. In this game, players embark on a journey to revisit the past, explore themselves, and uncover hidden secrets.
row.notes: This detective game features content related to sexual assault as the main character endeavours to unravel the crime's narrative.

row.name: Screamboat Willie
row.detailed_description: After awaking upon the steam boat of the famous, Steamboat Willie, The player is tasked with escaping by any means necessary. A task easier said than done as Willie, who was locked up for nearly 100 years, roams about the boat relentlessly hunting the player. But don't worry, you're not completely alone. There is a stranger communicating from the other side of a radio, with his help, you should have everything you need to avoid Willie, solve puzzles, and ultimately escape. Key features: Willie will hunt you. Maybe Willie got good grades in highschool, or just listened closely to his “Hunting people 101” class, either way he’ll be constantly on your heels. Ensuring that you never feel quite safe while navigating the steamboat. Willie is also a great listener! Which is great when you need someone to talk to, but not so great when Willie is hunting you with what are probably nefarious motives. Be careful what items you interact with, you’ll never know if Willie is listening or from how far. Puzzles that will “tickle” your brain. Throughout Willie’s steamboat, there will be various problems which will need fixing if you’re to escape. Different “technically unique” puzzle designs will have you wondering how to go about one as opposed to the others. But don’t fret too much. We will have hints, but those are for babies… You wouldn’t happen to be a baby, would you? Puzzles will affect the map, sometimes helping you, and other times hindering you. Multiple endings. You just might escape and everything might turn out peachy… Or you might not and Willie might have a better life. Who knows? Well, I guess I technically know because I made it… But you can know if you play it, and that’s pretty cool. Some endings are because you were smart. Others because you didn’t quite fit that definition. Appreciation levels if you play our game: 11/10 Your rating and various rating related websites: GOAT/10
row.short_description: Do you LOVE Steamboat Willie? Great! He's in this game! Do you HATE Steamboat Willie? great! He's gross and scary and you are trying to dodge him and ultimately get away from him! So basically no matter what this game is for you!
row.notes: There is gore pretty standard for a horror game and Willie is kinda gross, but in the like, hasn't showered for a week, kind of way.

About the author: Samuel Leigh is a game developer, writer and adjunct professor based in New York. His work spans from Interactive fiction, to puzzle and action games. He thought that since this game did well on YouTube one time that he may as well experiment with putting it up on Steam. 🤪 His other game, Moving Jigsaw Puzzles is available on Steam and is also very fun.
