row.name: 幽都酒馆
row.detailed_description: 本游戏主旨绿色健康阳光积极向上充满正能量，无不良导向。 这是一个发生在名为幽都的地方发生的日常故事，在这里我们都是一个短暂停留的过客，在这短暂的时间里，感受一下这周围不一样的日常。 游戏流程很短，可能就20分钟的样子，分为四个小故事。每个一小故事都十分的简短。 游戏本身十分的简单，通过再一个地图里简单的移动和探索，来了解一些小故事，你可以和场景中一些物品反复的互动，除此之外只有一些简单的选择选项，并不会影响结局或者分支。 因为不太会画画，所以从cg到立绘还有行走图可能都比较粗糙和丑陋，地图也很小，不过里面的东西我还是尽量做的丰富一点。 因为不太会程序，所以游戏本身机制简单，基本上只用点点点就行了，不过还是有些地方可以互动的。 因为是弱智，所以剧情上可能让您感到难受或者不解，我表示非常抱歉，但是也没办法了，我尽力了，实在不爽就骂我吧。 希望大家还是抱着一个休闲和快乐的心态来看这个小故事，同时也希望您能从我的游戏中收获快乐。
row.short_description: 本游戏主旨绿色健康阳光积极向上充满正能量，无不良导向。

row.name: Chicken Tale
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Chicken Tale my first game a charming pixelated platformer I've been working on for a year and a half. It's designed for everyone, from beginners to pros, with three difficulty levels to choose from. Explore a cute world, overcome challenges, and enjoy a heartfelt story. And an Epic BOSS FIGHT !
row.short_description: Platformer game Chicken Tale with a touching story and pixelart graphics three difficulty levels so that both beginners and experienced players can enjoy

row.name: 文若九洲记：艳欲之乡
row.detailed_description: 前言 如果您还对那些隐藏在代码之下，专属于绅士们的秘密感兴趣。欢迎加入由策划24小时值班的玩家讨论组：QQ 555267667 分享各自对本作的想法与意见，交流探索有爱的日常。甚至欺负欺负笨笨的制作人都是可以哒！ 特别鸣谢 知名编曲家，零度吉他琴行唐山分店店长，本作音乐总监：吴思彤 wx：W735893885 配音演员，本作配音导演：闲花皓月 自由画师，本作CG与背景负责人：Y7 自由画师，本作特写与角色立绘负责人，艺术总监：Stan 配音演员，本作主角与全男性角色声音扮演者：仙儿轰炸机 wx：lronMan-8888 配音演员，本作全女性角色声音扮演者：应相逢 剧情设定在公元前61年，以架空的罗马共和国与古希腊文明为蓝本。 往日平静的凡赛特村，如今尚未从昨夜失火留下的伤痛中解脱，却又要迎接无数挥舞着锋刃的强盗。 玩家将扮演青年村长阿奇尔，与远渡重洋，立志遍观西陆的东土侠客张文若。共同破解这场围绕自己性命与身世的无妄之灾，寻找一切背后的始作俑者。 究竟是色欲熏心的祭司长贪图妹妹克希亚娇躯美貌，还是权势滔天的伊莫总督觊觎邻家姐姐那闺中秘宝。亦或偶然相识的冷艳女佣兵，心中隐瞒了某些不可告人的秘密。 座落在尼罗河东岸，终日陪伴帝王谷的“百门之城”底比斯，是公元前一世纪定居人口最多的城市。而在此中扮演着掌管全城风俗行业的交际花公会会长，代号月灵的神秘女人，忠心效力于一支正在幕后操纵整片西陆的古老组织。 远渡万里的旅者，青丝素衣的侠客。封存于方寸的女娲神魂，让他总是以男身女相的童趣面孔示人。不过东方武林的血雨腥风，或许也可从其腰间的空灵刀中，略窥一二。 主人公唯一的血亲，平日里因往事对哥哥虽然冷漠，但如果发现了阿奇尔正和某个陌生女人接触，情窦初开的她也绝不会袖手旁观。 脾气古怪，见钱眼开。如果你向伊莫城的路人打听一位名叫柏妮丝的女佣兵，那么十有八九将得到这句答复。可亲眼见识过她战斗的雇主们，则更愿称其为黑帝斯手下最受宠爱的使者。 赫曼共和国若是没有了伊莫城的酒庄，无异于皎洁新月失去了繁星的衬托。而在这繁星之中最耀眼的，则当属埃弗亚经营的战马酒馆。不过比起这位老板娘从酒坛里倒出的，一杯杯令无数王族品酒师都难以挑剔的佳酿。或许她那三十二岁依然白皙娇嫩的绰绰丰姿，才更是酒馆里人声鼎沸的诀窍。 游戏以叙事为主，我们力求营造一段围绕着众神喜怒，美女佳酿，阴谋机遇的古希腊英雄传说。 手绘风格的背景与CG，也许能让您的冒险不再单调。 玲白工作室潜心研发的卡牌博弈模式将穿插于主线，规则通俗易懂，战斗难度适中，每名女角色更有独属于自己的破衣战损。 和智能AI平均三分钟一场的畅快对局中，各英雄间多达360句的台词彩蛋也期待您的发现。 本工作室仅由一人出资，一人制作，故因工期紧张或合作中止等突发情况。当前版本画风未能统一，且部分UI和音乐也使用了可商用的公共资源，但以上问题均将在下版本更新时全部解决。 感谢各位绅士的支持与热爱，玲白工作室诚邀各位粉丝免费参加我们游戏未来更新前的内部测试并留下您宝贵的意见或建议。 名额无限，入群即可，群主将不定时发放福利回报大家（可以女装） 嫩滑软糯的福利群：QQ555267667 群主寂寞难耐，请入群后速速与群主击剑。 各位不使用QQ的玩家们，如果遇到了和游戏相关的问题，烦请前往社区的指南页面查找解决方法。
row.short_description: 这是一款剧情丰富，玩法大胆创新的卡牌游戏。您将以第一人称视角，扮演古希腊传奇英雄阿奇尔。与来自东方的游侠张文若，和随故事发展依次登场的九位美女熟妇们组成队伍，联手闯关的同时。提升她们的好感，邀请她们共度良宵。
row.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Sexual Content, General Mature Content All characters involved in sexual content are over the age of 18.

row.name: QI
row.detailed_description: QI Sakura has asked Ryu to meet him at the school. She seems to have something important to tell him. A starry night and meeting between two friends. What challenge awaits Ryu !? QI is a single one-boss-fight turn-based game made with RPG maker MV. Help Ryu defeat God for Sakura. One-boss-battle Defeat God Notes Around 80 min boss fight.
row.short_description: Single one-boss-fight turn-based rpg. Sakura has asked Ryu to meet him at the school. She seems to have something important to tell him.

row.name: Ocean World: Eden Crafters Prologue
row.detailed_description: Ocean World is a free Prologue introducing one of the planets that you can transform in the full game 'Eden Crafters', now available ! You located a planet where your scanners detected a lot of water, it should be easy to turn it into a habitable haven for humanity. Gather materials, craft essential tools, and lay the foundation for a thriving civilization. Except... maybe there is too much water on this planet? Ocean World presents a unique challenge: giant waves caused by a nearby moon. Automate resource gathering and transformation with conveyors and machines, from elaborate factories to environmental transformation systems. Temper the climate, create a breathable atmosphere... and survive the giant wave incoming. This free episode offers a glimpse into the vast potential of Eden Crafters, providing a taste of the adventures that await in the full co-op, open-world survival and crafting experience. Take the first steps toward transforming a hostile planet into a flourishing Eden, where crafting and automation are the keys to success. FEATURES Open World Co-Op Crafting Factory Building Terraformation Vehicles
row.short_description: Embark on a journey of survival, crafting, and automation in this free prologue introducing one of the planets you can transform in Eden Crafters – an upcoming open-world game that challenges you, alone or with friends, to turn a hostile planet into a habitable haven for humanity.

row.name: Sovereign Elect
row.detailed_description: Sovereign Elect is a game centered around accumulating influence. Your ultimate goal is to become the sovereign of the land. To do this, you must gain influence, which is primarily done through mercenaries you hire. Mercenaries come in different rarities. They each have different stats and abilities which effect your methods of obtaining merit. Once merit is obtained, it can be converted into influence by your mercenaries. You will obtain contracts that you can use to hire new mercenaries. Your group will start off small, but given time, you can reach up to a total of 40 mercenaries. You cannot become king if you do not have a band of loyal followers. Activities are represented by small icons the player can interact with. If they are related to merit, your mercenaries will interact with them automatically. This also includes enemies, which will target you if no mercenaries are present to defend you. Activities that give merit come in 4 varieties: Strength, Dexterity, Charisma, and Wisdom. These correlate with attributes your mercenaries have, which are represented by the color on their glove. Certain abilities your mercenaries have may also behave differently depending on the attribute/color they associate with. With this in mind, the type of mercenaries you decide to have matters.
row.short_description: Grow and lead a party of followers to support your quest for the throne. Explore this fantasy land with voiced dialogue and real time choices that can effect other players. This game takes heavy inspiration from Bee Swarm Simulator with an emphasis on combat.

row.name: Region: Gear D
row.detailed_description: Step into the immersive world of 'Region：Gear D', a groundbreaking virtual reality PVE FPS that revolutionizes the way you engage with virtual combat.'Region：Gear D' offers an unparalleled level of customization and weapon interactivity, promising to deliver a thrilling and realistic experience to FPS enthusiasts and VR adventurers alike. In 'Region：Gear D', creativity is your deadliest weapon. The game's innovative gun assembly mechanic allows you to build and modify your firearms from a vast array of components—making each weapon a unique creation tailored to your playstyle. Whether you prefer the pinpoint precision of a custom sniper rifle or the rapid-fire chaos of a personalized submachine gun, the power to craft your ideal arsenal is at your fingertips. Beyond the workbench, 'Region：Gear D' features a variety of challenging environments where your creations will be put to the test. Battle against relentless waves of AI-driven opponents that require strategic thinking and quick reflexes to defeat. Each victory not only sharpens your skills but also unlocks new components and upgrades to enhance your weaponry. Enjoy the visceral satisfaction that only VR can provide as you physically reload your custom guns, dodge enemy fire, and aim with true-to-life accuracy. The game's intuitive controls and realistic physics ensure every firefight is as intense and rewarding as it is fun. Join a community of fellow gunsmiths and soldiers in 'Region：Gear D'. Share your most ingenious designs, compete for the top spots on the leaderboards, and push the boundaries of virtual gunplay. With frequent updates and a dedicated development team, the game continues to evolve, adding new features, game modes, and content based on player feedback. Get ready to lock and load like never before. 'Region：Gear D' is not just a game; it's the future of virtual reality combat. Assemble your dream gun, dive into the fight, and experience the rush of VR warfare. In the current version of the game, you can combine initial gun parts to create your preferred firearms. Additionally, by completing levels, you can acquire new gun parts that make you stronger and enable you to break through more challenging levels.
row.short_description: Embark on an immersive VR FPS adventure! Customize your guns and outsmart AI foes in exhilarating PVE combat. Get ready for a unique strategic shooting experience, coming soon to Steam. Your ultimate VR battleground awaits – don't miss out!

row.name: Hunter Beat
row.detailed_description: Description: Hunter Beat is an exhilarating virtual reality game designed specifically for people who want to escape from everyday worries, shift to positive emotions, and enhance their concentration. Participants immerse themselves in the game, where they shoot at dynamic 'targets' and score points. The success of the gameplay depends on several factors: accuracy, agility, reaction speed, sense of rhythm, and the ability to see more broadly, not just in front of oneself. Hunter Beat features a variety of engaging levels with different levels of difficulty. The game offers a wide selection of music tracks, which also influence the pace of gameplay. Hitting the target in rhythm/beat allows the player to earn additional points. Key features of the game include: Dynamic tasks that require quick reaction and precise movements. It enhances attention concentration. Shooting with both hands contributes to reloading. Levels of varying difficulty that present challenges for new achievements and stimulate the player's attentiveness. Universality - suitable for adults and children alike. Hunter Beat is the perfect way to escape from the gray routine, engage in something exciting, and at the same time, develop attentiveness and improve emotional state in a gaming format. In Hunter Beat, players encounter arcade-style action elements, the main one being shooting cartoon ducks. On a successful hit, the ducks explode, displaying exaggerated animation effects, including the appearance of exaggerated bones and cartoon-style blood. These scenes are intended for comic effect and are designed to be non-realistic. They are not intended to suppress or glorify military force or brutality. However, we understand that this stylistic approach may be taken in different ways, and we caution that some of the participants in the response scenes may be conspicuous or unexpected.
row.short_description: Description: Hunter Beat is an exhilarating virtual reality game designed specifically for people who want to escape from everyday worries, shift to positive emotions, and enhance their concentration.
row.notes: In Hunter beat, players will encounter arcade action elements, the main one being shooting cartoon ducks. On a successful hit, the ducks explode, displaying exaggerated animation effects, including the appearance of exaggerated bones and cartoon-style blood. These scenes are intended for comic effect and are designed to be non-realistic. They are not intended to reproduce or glorify actual violence or cruelty. However, we recognize that this stylistic approach may be perceived differently and caution that some players may find these scenes sensitive or unexpected.

row.name: Enthralled
row.detailed_description: Possessed by a demon a long time ago, you have limited control over your actions and your faith. Enthralled is a short game best described as a walking simulator with some combat and puzzle elements, focused on the atmosphere and world exploration.
row.short_description: 'Enthralled' is a short game about a man possessed by a demon. It takes place in a desolate world where you balance between looking for a way out, stopping the demon from killing innocent people, and not being completely devoured yourself. Explore the world and find a way to deal with your curse.
row.notes: Fantasy combat, stylized blood

row.name: Spiderbro 2
row.detailed_description: Spiderbro 2 is a retro inspired adventure puzzle game for Windows and Linux. You play as Shadowbro, a spider that has to save the multiverse from the antics of a real life computer worm! EXPLORE, COLLECT ITEMS, SOLVE PUZZLES! Make your way deeper into the company building by exploring the environment and collecting items for your pockets! Use your pocket items on world objects, give them to NPCs or merge them with one another to solve puzzles! THE IN-GAME PCs ARE BACK WITH AN UPGRADE! Use the in-game PCs and check for further clues! Text logs with clues and backstory can be found on PCs found throughout the game! Take a trip to PC-SPACE, a company exclusive VR service that takes using a PC to new depths! A WORM IS LOOSE! THE MULTIVERSE IS COLLIDING! A computer worm gone wild has broken into the real world! More cracks and holes to new universes have appeared! In Spiderbro 2 you should expect the unexpected as you overcome the worm whilst travelling between different universes! DISCOVER COMPANY SECRETS! Go deeper into the company building and find out what triggered the events of Spiderbro! Each new department will unravel more secrets! NO NEED TO PLAY THE PREQUEL! Players need not play the first Spiderbro! Spiderbro 2 expands upon the first game in a way that does not require the player to complete it! Spiderbro 2 also contains a copy of the first game, within the game! YOU WILL DIE! Be warned that this world is not safe! Make frequent use of savepoints to prevent losing progress! EVEN MORE! Cloud saves 34 Achievements New game plus mode Two possible conclusions Built in Cheat Sheet with all puzzle solutions CONTROLS Arrow Keys / WASD - Movement SPACE / ENTER - Interact P / E - Open Pockets ESC - Back / Pause
row.short_description: Help Shadowbro overcome a computer worm come to life and save the multiverse from colliding! Collect items, talk to employees, solve puzzles and explore the secrets of a company that caused everything to happen!

row.name: Rush Heroes
row.detailed_description: The cat kingdom is in danger. The 32 cats were kidnapped and the king fell into despair. The king entrusted the future of the kingdom to you, the commander of the Knights Templar, with one last hope. You join three other heroes, a wizard and an archer, and a priest, who will help you with the story and rescue the cats fighting against the orcs. You can use golds that automatically gather to assemble your various 4 typed soldiers. Or use game-changing heroes' skills to win. Collecting equipments to assist in these battles, strengthen the heroes and ultimately rescue all the cats and reclaim the future of the cat kingdom.
row.short_description: The cat kingdom is in danger. You can use golds that automatically gather to assemble your various 4 typed soldiers. Or use game-changing heroes' skills to win. Collecting equipments to assist in these battles, strengthen the heroes and ultimately reclaim the future of the cat kingdom.

row.name: Gardener Plant Creator
row.detailed_description: Use the free 🛠️ Gardener Plant Creator 🛠️ app to design plant species that can be simulated and grown in game 🍀 Gardener: Master of Trees and Flowers 🍀. Share your plant designs with friends and the community on Steam Workshop. Generate Plant Nucleotide Genome files at the touch of a button for easy uploading and downloading. Simply drag and drop the png files containing plants into the game to import new species.
row.short_description: Free editor app to design plants for 🍀Gardener: Master of Trees and Flowers🍀

row.name: Meow Playground
row.detailed_description: Meow Playground is an online multiplayer game that lets you play as a cute animal character. In the game, you have the opportunity to improve your character, communicate with other players, and participate in a variety of games and activities, such as fishing or playing tag and dodgeball. Additionally, you can customize and decorate your own house to your liking. With so many options and possibilities, Meow Playground offers endless fun for anyone who loves animals and online gaming!
row.short_description: Meow Playground is an online multiplayer game that lets you play as a cute animal character.

row.name: Starecrown (DEMO)
row.detailed_description: There's an ancient legend of idols and angels... Looking over who SHE deems worthy... Unaware to those they watch... Until now. In STARECROWN, you will learn why some things should stay the way they were through a visual-novel merged with a puzzle-based horror experience. But you won't be alone. Just out of sight stands someone very familiar with you, fueled by words from an ADVISOR hiding in the shadows. Who knows what might happen? There's only one way to find out, now is there?
row.short_description: In STARECROWN, a visual-novel merged with a puzzle-based horror experience, your ANGEL whose watched from the distance finally makes himself known. For the worse.

row.name: Circuit Thunder®
row.detailed_description: Experience the action-packed story of Circuit Thunder®. Circuit Thunder® is a 2D-platformer, action-adventure RPG where you follow the legendary Electrex Bolt® and master electrifying abilities of light, ultimately harnessing lightning as your weapon. Traverse through novel lands, battle mysterious enemies, and strategically learn new defensive and offensive abilities.  Begin your journey with the first book, Circuit Thunder®: Hypcampex®   BOOK I : HYPCAMPEX® Set within Planet Photonus, you will embark on a journey as the legendary Electrex Bolt® to acquire the artifact of the Hypcampex® and stop the Avengers of Light, the Lavengers, from destroying the planet. With vibrant environments, pestering enemies, and innovative maps, you will be able to put your skills to the test and brave the war against the Lavengers. Will Electrex Bolt® succeed?  SAVE PLANET PHOTONUS FROM ANARCHY Destroy the drone waves deployed by the Lavengers and best their tactics. The trials and puzzles that lie ahead will not be easy feats. It will take the most omnipotent of prowess. FIGHT THROUGH SPACE Battle through space on the BOLT Voyager V3 and show the Lavengers that Electrex Bolt® is the best pilot within the galaxy. MASTER THE LIGHT Does Electrex Bolt® have what it takes to master the light and revive those whom he has lost?
row.short_description: Enter the universe of Circuit Thunder®. Embark on a 2D-platforming adventure with Electrex Bolt® and master the abilities of lightning. Explore vibrant locations, battle novel enemies, unlock new abilities, and experience a powerful story of redemption.

row.name: In a Detective's Mind
row.detailed_description: In a Detective's Mind is a short game made by two people, where you will play as Andrew, a detective who is learning to deal with the problems of his past. You will have to solve two cases, where you will receive very few details about what happened. The objective is for you to be able to put together in your head what happened in the place, with as little detail as possible, so it will be important that you explore and make deductions, so that you can solve the cases and puzzles in the game. Build your destiny Being a detective is not an easy task. With each new case you decide to investigate, new people have their fates sealed in your hands. One word, one wrong accusation can mean the end of an innocent life. In a Detective's Mind proposes an experience where your decisions matter, changing not only the destiny of the people around you, but yours as well. Having 3 different endings , In a Detective's Mind takes you on a journey of no return.
row.short_description: In a Detective's Mind is an investigation game that seeks to put you in the role of a detective, who needs to solve cases and deal with obscure problems from his past.
row.notes: This Game contain content not appropriate for all ages. It contains General Mature Content and may include innuendo of minor involved in sexual activity

row.name: Aeris (BETA)
row.detailed_description: Aeris is a flight simulator where you can explore the vast world in your favorite airplanes. Travel to your favorite locations and fly with friends, all for free. Buckle your seatbelt and get ready to dive into the world of Aeris. Terrain Aeris has global Cesium Ion Google Earth scenery. You can explore mountains, cities, and landmarks in the game. Planes While playing Aeris, you can fly in 3 different varieties of plane. A fighter jet, a cargo plane, and a passenger jet are all available to you when flying. Multiplayer Full multiplayer is supported so you can fly your friends and others above the scenery.
row.short_description: Complete challenges or fly freely all around the world!

row.name: 亚穆蒂斯
row.detailed_description: *轻策略,开放地图,大世界探索,多剧本,多阵营,多角色,经营与养成. *自由寻访并招募将领,发展建设自己的领地,人口,行业,征兵,训练军团,抵御入侵并进攻敌国 领土,统一整个大陆. 统一大陆只是开始,在野外探索怪物地图,挑战强大的怪物领主,获得材料用来制作和强化武器 装备. *收集不同的技能徽章,自由搭配将领技能,组件军团队伍,搭配不同阵容. *每个怪物领主都有自己的属性,能力,技能.面对不同的领主,使用不同的阵营与技能可以事半 功倍. *制作不同属性能力的套装,武器.装备给不同的角色有不同的效果.搭配不同套装组合不同能力 . *每个角色都有自己的被动技能,有自己独特的作用,针对角色的能力给他们搭配合适的主动技 能. *自由发展建设领地,经营领地状况,招募士兵,发展商业,抵御外敌. *探索世界地图,寻找强大生物,挑战Boss获得材料,制作武器套装, *上百将领可供培养,数十件套装,数十个技能徽章,众多职业,自由养成发展路线. *三大剧本,几十个领地可供选择,每个领地难度各不相同. *攻城略地,壮大实力,面对强大的敌人,如何才能取胜. *多变的战况,每次开局都会有不同的体验. 这是一个自由的大陆,这是一个属于强者的年代,如果让自己在这个时代生存下去,又如何战胜一个又一个强大的敌人.用心经营自己的领地,寻找与培养自己的麾下将领,终有一天你会为这片大陆带来和平与统一.
row.short_description: 回合制战略角色扮演游戏, 开放世界地图自由对抗, 多样变化养成路线,多角色职业养成,自由属性,自由技能,自由打造装备,每次开局都有不同的体验.

row.name: The Aquarium does not dance
row.detailed_description: A horror adventure game where a girl, who cares deeply for her best friend, searches for her friend in an aquarium turned into a world of terror. While escaping from strange beings called Creepy, you will unravel the mysteries hidden in the aquarium. The horror elements are mild, allowing you to enjoy challenging puzzles. In addition to the protagonist, unique and charming girls will appear. The story features multiple endings that change based on your choices. The playtime is approximately 3 hours. This game is created with RPG Maker MZ. Controls: Z key: Confirm, fast forward X key: Open menu, cancel Arrow keys: Move character Shift key: Dash The game supports Japanese, Korean, and Chinese (Simplified and Traditional).
row.short_description: This is a horror adventure game where a girl, devoted to her best friend, searches for her companion in an aquarium that has transformed into a world of horror. While evading the deformed entities known as 'Creepies,' the player must unravel the mysteries concealed within the aquarium.

row.name: Run from the Hunt
row.detailed_description: Run from the Hunters in this Clicker Horror Game. Click to move or stop clicking to stop moving.
row.short_description: An Horror Clicker Game, where you have to click to run from the hunt.
row.notes: You are being hunted in the game.

row.name: Evostrike
row.detailed_description: Story Drifting along the edge of humanity's galaxy, your ship comes across an unknown threat. An entire sector infested with hostile creatures. It is your objective to engage these beings, eradicate as many of them as possible, and gather data for your home sector. Evolve Your ship contains a small group of mercenaries which can evolve and improve their equipment and skills. Choose from 4 different evolution paths each with unique strengths and skills. Evolve your squad of 5 Evo-Mercs, choosing from the 12 different evolutions available. Mastery While your Evo-Mercs are fighting in their current evolution, they will gain mastery over their role. Each evolution has 3 mastery steps, granting them increasing buffs. These buffs persist even after changing evolutions, and their effects stack. Combine the 39 Masteries together with the 12 evolutions to create powerful combos. Stack the mastery of damage to allow the Sniper-Evo to punch through armor. Stack magazine efficiency to the point where the single shot Mortar-Evo becomes a twin barreled beast. Many more combos are there to find. Events Along your journey through the infested sector your ship and crew will come across different events. Be it a desire for more unstable mutations, or just simply broken parts in the med-bay. Choose how you react and live with the consequences. Choose your Route You'll be able to choose your own missions as you approach the heart of the infestation. Multiple paths will open up; some are harder but grant better rewards. The further you push on, the more advanced the alien threat will become. Engage the enemy Fight in missions against big alien armies. Analyze the map, make your plan and execute on it. Defend! Build defensive structure around your ship to protect it from the aliens. Survive the night! Nighttime is brutal, this is where the aliens hunts, they are faster stronger and more active. Survive the night and prepare for the daybreak. Use the advantage of the burning daylight to push ahead. Use airstrikes and aggressive maneuvers to take out the alien nests one by one. Attrition. Some fights are too hard to be won at first. but the aliens aren't endless... The longer we persist the less of them there are. Even if it looks hopeless at first, hold fast and endure. The aliens will tire, and our ship's supply generator will increase in power as it warms up. Elites As we reach the heart we will encounter the elites of the infestation. Bigger stronger and with the only goal to take out our ship. Destroy their vital parts one by one and stop them from reaching our ship. Meta-Tech Sooner or later we will fail. We are the Drifting-Edge, we're meant to be the scouts and first responders, we're not here to do this on our own. Once we die, our date gets sent back home, and with the data we collect we'll be able to research new constructs for our fellow Drifting-Edges. They'll charge in after we have perished, stronger and with more info.
row.short_description: A Roguelike tactics game where you fight hordes of aliens. Your Units evolve and learn new skills as the fight goes on. Manage your squad of 5 specialised mercenaries, and fight a never ending war against the infestation.

row.name: Deck of Delirium
row.detailed_description: Deck of Delirium is a PvE deckbuilding card game where you build your own misfit crew full of animals, pirates, animal pirates, pompous sailors, and even cultists to make your way through the perilous journey across the sea battling rogue pirates, sea monsters, and other uncanny enemies. You will use your own sanity as a resource to summon crew and give orders in order to beat what stands in your way of treasure, glory, and even some emotional breakthroughs. Will you try your best to keep your sanity or embrace the chaos that comes with going insane?
row.short_description: Deck of Delirium is a PvE deckbuilding card game where you build your own misfit crew full of animals, pirates, animal pirates, pompous sailors, and even cultists to make your way through the perilous journey across the sea battling rogue pirates, sea monsters, and other uncanny enemies.

row.name: 退婚后，宗主马甲藏不住
row.detailed_description: 一款真人出演的龙王赘婿爽剧，体验一段跨越时间与空间的浪漫热血番。 真人出演 独特的真人角色扮演，提供沉浸式的游戏体验。每个角色都由精心挑选的演员出演，通过视频和让您感受每一个情感细节。 深度冒险 :丰富的故事情节，让您在阅读的同时作出关键决策，影响故事发展和结局。 角色互动 与多样化的角色建立联系，包括夏晚星、岛国圣女西村樱子、灵族天女卡捷琳娜等，每个角色都有其独特的故事背景和性格，等待您去探索。 收集与成长 收集神器五行灵珠，觉醒宗主之力。您的选择和行动不仅决定了角色间的关系，还影响您的力量成长和故事走向。 战胜反派 揭露并战胜玄华子等人的阴谋，保护宗门和所爱之人。每一个决策都至关重要，决定着未来的胜败。 游戏玩法 开始您的旅程从免费体验第一章剧情开始，之后可选择付费解锁二至六章更加丰富的内容。 通过探索、对话选择和解决挑战来推动故事发展。 与各色美女角色发展关系，每个选择都会影响您与这些角色的互动和故事的方向。 使用策略和智慧收集关键物品，增强您的力量，为最终的对决做准备。 加入《退婚后，宗主马甲藏不住》，解锁您的宗门宗主之旅，体验一场前所未有的恋爱冒险。
row.short_description: 三天河东三天河西，莫欺少年穷！

row.name: 할 짓 없는 군주님
row.detailed_description: 'Imperator with nothing to do' is a classic strategy RPG that is very simple, but requires choice and focus. Quick and simple but detailed battle It features simple damage calculation and fast-paced combat. However, it has a combat style that makes you think about it, where every choice and turn is important. Unique Universe It takes place against the backdrop of a unique world called ‘Color World’. It features charming and unique characters and settings. 100% original graphics Everywhere you look is filled with the hands of the creator. Experience completely original retro graphics. 100% original sound The creator's heart is everywhere within earshot. Experience completely original BGM and SE. Story A world of color, a world of living colors. The weak-willed ‘Paler’ and the strong-willed ‘Color’ live here. Today's protagonist, the vermilion-colored 'Vermillia', is falsely accused of being the devil by someone's rumor, and becomes the target of the Paler and Color. What will happen to Vermillia in the future?
row.short_description: 'Imperator with nothing to do' is a classic strategy RPG that is very simple, but requires choice and focus. Experience 100% original graphics, sounds, and detailed battles for free!

row.name: Ocean Desolation
row.detailed_description: Ocean Desolation is a Free Simple Linear horror game. After falling out of your boat during a thunderstorm you are left stranded in the South Pacific Ocean. Swim your way to different locations and find a way to call for help. But be careful, something lurks at the bottom. GAMEPLAY You will have to swim your way to different locations. But make sure to keep an eye out. There could be anything below you. FEATURES The game will feature a simple swimming system. The game will feature creatures. The game will feature unique sound design. PLAY TIME 20-40 minutes ROADMAP I'm looking for honest feedback. This will help me improve future games :]
row.short_description: Ocean Desolation is a Free Simple Linear horror game. After falling out of your boat during a thunderstorm you are left stranded in the South Pacific Ocean. Swim your way to different locations and find a way to call for help. But be careful, something lurks at the bottom.
row.notes: May not be appropriate for all ages. Contains loud noises and jump scares. Gore and Violence that could be disturbing for certain players

row.name: Project Spatial
row.detailed_description: Project Spatial is a new way to capture & share volumetric VR videos from your favorite games. You can step inside gaming volumetric videos made by your favorite creators and experience content in new, immersive ways. Project Spatial makes volumetric video creation accessible to all, so seatbelts ON as we soar into uncharted dimensions of shared storytelling only possible through pioneering technologies like VR. The future of gaming video starts now! Key features: Watching short gaming videos from any angle, you're in full control of what you want to see Volumetric videos in an overlay so you can view them while playing other games Record your VR gameplay volumetrically giving 6DOF of engagement Anyone can record and share their gaming experiences We're always looking to add more game support so let us know what games you want to see added. Join our Discord to provide feedback
row.short_description: Project Spatial is the destination for creating and watching interactive, truly spatial gaming videos. Try out the Pre-Alpha App and see the evolution of video.

row.name: Vigor
row.detailed_description: Join the game that has been played by over 20 million players and explore the harsh and unforgiving Outlands, the shattered remains of what was once Norway. Utilize any means necessary to survive. Set in a post-apocalyptic atmosphere in the early 90s, the landscape of the Outlands is as deadly as it is beautiful, so be careful out there. Experience the thrills that Encounters have to offer, a high-stakes mode where survival is key. Extract the most valuable resources in order to build and upgrade your Shelter, or lose everything if you die! Choose over 60 different weapons and consumables to customize your loadout based on the play style of your choice - sneaky looter or deadly shooter. Change the pace of the Encounter and gain an advantage over your enemies by controlling tactical points on the map. Compete for Loot Events, special places that hold more valuable loot, and try to retrieve the Airdrop, the most precious haul in the Outlands. We dare you! Escape from specific exits at any time and avoid the deadly radiation cloud that sweeps over the map, killing everyone trapped inside it. Play alone in Shootout, a fast-paced deathmatch, or join a squad with your friends in Elimination, a 5v5 tactical, round-based teamfight. In Encounter, you can team up with a friend as a Duo, or compete as a Lone Wolf where the risk vs. reward factor is greater as you square off against other squads on your own! Identify as one of many groups of Outlanders that inhabit this broken world through various cosmetic sets. Choose between military, non-military and everything in between to instill fear in the hearts of your opponents. Your Shelter is your safe haven in the apocalypse and your central hub for information. By collecting resources from Encounters, you can build and upgrade your Shelter, which will, in turn, provide you with more options (craft better weapons and consumables, generate Crowns and other materials) that will be essential to your survival. Practice your marksmanship in the Shooting Range, craft your necessary equipment in the Armory, and customize your character from the wardrobe while you keep building your Shelter to maximize its potential.
row.short_description: Outlive the apocalypse! Dive into intense Encounters and extract the most valuable spoils the Outlands have to offer! Loot, shoot, and build to become the absolute Outlander and explore the landscape of a post-war Norway in Vigor, a free-to-play looter shooter.
row.notes: - Blood - Violence - Profanity

row.name: The Secret Weapon
row.detailed_description: Feature List Unleash Your Inner Madness Dive into a world where creativity knows no bounds and embrace the insanity of The Secret Weapon . Laugh-Out-Loud Fun Prepare for endless laughter with friends as you compete to create the most ludicrous combinations in this hilarious card game. Randomized Mayhem Every game is a new adventure with randomly chosen phrases and unpredictable reactions, ensuring non-stop entertainment. Easy to Learn, Impossible to Master Simple gameplay mechanics make it accessible to all, but the limitless possibilities guarantee a fresh challenge every time. Over 70 Cards, 90+ Phrases Enjoy endless laughs with a wide variety of cards and phrases, ensuring each game of The Secret Weapon is a unique and hilarious experience. About the Game Dive into the madcap chaos of The Secret Weapon , a wild multiplayer online card game where insanity reigns supreme! Get ready to burst into fits of laughter as you challenge your friends in battles of absurd creativity! Start the game with 4 cards and plunge into unrestrained fun! Each turn, a master is randomly chosen and faces a daunting decision: selecting a phrase from a list of equally bizarre options! Other players must then tap into their twisted imaginations to choose the craziest card from their hand and react to the phrase chosen by the master . A point is awarded to the player who presents the most insane reaction! With a myriad of absurd cards and off-the-wall phrases, every game is a journey into pure absurdity! Prepare to lose your mind as you strive to accumulate points and become the ultimate king of madness in The Secret Weapon ! NOTE: The game must be played by at least 3 players in order to start a game.
row.short_description: Get ready for endless laughs with The Secret Weapon - a wacky online card game that guarantees non-stop hilarity! Challenge friends, create insane combinations, and become the champion of absurdity!

row.name: Cracking the Stone
row.detailed_description: Cracking the Stone is an interactive comic about following the life of a boy who is learning what it's like to struggle with grief. As tragedy overwhelms the boy, take control of his early life and help him learn what it's like to follow his own path, all the while blocking out the negative emotions that fly toward him as a consequence of his journey through life. What is it like to juggle the complexities of childhood & adolescence with the struggle to keep one's emotions at bay and stave off existential dread and depression? Cracking the Stone aims to answer that question via an emotional journey through an interactive medium! Note: This free demo is an incomplete version of the story ends on a cliffhanger! It contains only portions of the first 2 of 5 planned chapters in the story.
row.short_description: Enter the life of a boy experiencing tragedy for the first time, the burden of his parents’ hopes & dreams, and the struggle to let his emotions in. Deflect the negative emotions coming from outside forces while trying to juggle the ins and outs of childhood, puberty, and relationships.
row.notes: This game contains references to miscarriage and depression

row.name: Kindred
row.detailed_description: In this touching story exploring the fragile bonds of brotherhood, you control a mysterious ghostly force. Use your powers of possession to manipulate objects and guide a curious young boy toward a discovery that will forever change his life. The choices you make will affect this boy's grieving mind, driving him to despair or providing closure. What sort of spirit will you be?
row.short_description: A physics-based 2D puzzle-platformer.
row.notes: This game contains depictions of child death.

row.name: 因果律 Inside The Memory
row.detailed_description: The trigger was an invitation letter I received from my uncle. He was supposed to be an invited guest at the pension ``Mobius'', a lodging facility for young people, but when he saw something he had never seen before, a ``mystery'' began to unfold. 'Why don't I remember...?' A ``mystery'' that happens to someone who was supposed to be an invited guest. Please try to solve it by yourself. A story where mysteries lead to more mysteries and a single trigger turns everything upside down The mystery is revealed little by little, and just when you think you know the ending, one action you take changes everything. Enjoy the chilling development and ending. Also, depending on the choices you make, it may become a BL version, so you can enjoy a wide range of stories. Using Live2D! Almost full voice during conversation! (Voices are in Japanese only) Almost full voice during conversation. (Headphones (earphones) recommended) Move and speak with rich expressions using Live2D. Mystery-solving gimmick balance with moderate difficulty level There are mystery-solving and mystery scenes, so please have paper and pen (or notepad) ready before playing. Play time 1 hour and 30 minutes per lap Number of ends 6 Caution/Disclaimer ・Currently only available in Japanese. ・This game is fiction. It has no relation to any actual person, organization, incident, etc. ・There is no intention to encourage crime or murder. - The author (Garnet Bloom / @shian_3rd / Causality Production Committee) will not be held responsible for any defects or troubles that may occur while playing this game.
row.short_description: [Using Live2D, almost full voice] (Voice is only in Japanese)A mystery that begins with a single invitation received from your uncle.A ``mystery'' that happens to someone who was supposed to be an invited guest. Please try to solve it by yourself.
row.notes: This game contains some nudity, kissing scenes, blood, incidents, accidents, and slight BL elements.

row.name: Heroes Of  Loot: Gauntlet Of Power Playtest
Viking Rise
row.detailed_description: Are you a fan of strategy games? As the Viking leader, how will you lead your Tribe to explore, plunder, and conquer the world of Midgard? Will you participate in the war games? Famous Heroes from Norse mythology and Viking history are ready to win wars with you. Strategize and use your wits to utilize the strengths of your Heroes! What enemies will you encounter in these war games? What friends will you make? Try your hand at [Viking Rise]! Valhalla is calling! [Viking Rise] is one of the best online multiplayer real-time war strategy games with epic world-building. You play as the leader of the Vikings, guiding your Tribe throughout Valhalla in the uncharted world of Midgard. Explore, plunder, develop, hunt, and fight your way across the land of Valhalla, filled with hidden dangers and opportunities. Lead your Viking Tribe to the top as you accrue massive wealth, fame, and power. Form an alliance with other players, protect one another from invasions, and defeat all enemies to conquer Midgard! Features ☆Audiovisual Masterpiece☆ Explore magnificent oceans and towering mountains, and experience realistic changes in the seasons. Delve deep into your Heroes' stories, set against the beauty of the vast Nordic landscape. Immerse yourself in the world of Midgard with a stunning original soundtrack composed by the renowned Mikolaj Stroinski. ☆Global Multi-Player Battles☆ Challenge players from around the world or fight alongside allies and prove you have what it takes to be a Viking leader. Choose strategy, diplomacy, or warfare as you stake your claim on Midgard and build your empire in Valhalla. ☆Design Your Territory☆ Expand your territory to support your growing Tribe. Conquer the lands of Valhalla, grow your population, and recruit talent to develop your land. Whether you decide to develop a commercial trading center, a land of rich resources, or a powerful military fortress, it's all within your control! Personalize your territory with a wide variety of Viking-style structures! ☆Naval Combat☆ Lead the Vikings across unknown waters to conquer new lands in Valhalla. Strategy is key! Use the sea to your advantage to carry out surprise attacks on the enemy and plunder their resources! Set sail for strategic territories, or use your ship to retreat from unfavorable situations and ambush your enemies from the sea. Come up with unique strategies by combining your navigational and naval combat skills in war! ☆Real-Time Combat☆ Fight your enemies in real-time on a massive world map. Find strength in numbers as you form alliances to crush the vast enemy forces. Whether on land or sea, survey your battlefields and give commands in real-time. Adjust your strategy to devastate your foes and become the strongest in Midgard. ☆Fight Alongside Viking Heroes☆ Summon legendary Viking Heroes to join you in war! Recruit Ragnar, Bjorn, Ival the Boneless, Snake-Eyed Sigurd, Harald Bluetooth, Rollo, Valkyrie, and other famous figures from Norse mythology. Build Valhalla, summon Heroes to fight for you, and become a true Viking ruler. ☆Tame the Ancient Dragon☆ Send your Heroes to hunt down mythical beasts, craft legendary equipment, explore mysterious ruins and caves, and discover hidden treasure. Tame the mighty dragon and obtain a powerful boost on the battlefield. Make a name for yourself and become one of Midgard's greatest legends!
row.short_description: Race against other players to explore Valhalla and conquer Midgard!

row.name: Deathless Death
row.detailed_description: JOIN OUR DISCORD Feel free to join our official Discord to share your comments and ideas with us <3 About the Game Deathless Death is a narrative puzzle game featuring Psychological Thriller elements. In this story, you take on the role of a priest, entering a world filled with thoughts and illusions. Listen to the confessions of four sinners, uncover the secrets of their past, and unravel their fates intertwined by one woman. Story As the chimes strike the hour, you light the candles on the altar one by one. Upon lighting the fifth candle, drops of wax fall onto the pristine white altar. The flames flicker softly, awaiting the sinners to confess. The confessional door opens, then closes. Through the cross-shaped screen, you cannot see their faces clearly. Their words are laced with lies, self-embellishment, fear, and bravado, but you must peel away each layer. Only when the fog of words is cleared will the truth behind the reflections emerge. Soothe the restless souls, listen to the turmoil in their hearts, and extinguish the flames of their desires. This is your mission, and you are destined to reach the end. Gameplay 【Point&Click Puzzle】 By listening to confessions and capturing the imagery within their words, you can glimpse into the mental landscape of the confessors. 【Immersive Performance】 Emotions cling to objects, memories lie buried in the past, all waiting for your gaze. Immerse yourself in their chaotic thoughts—their lives and secrets are hidden within. Discern and uncover the mementos buried in their minds, and only then will they confess their sins. 【Moral Dilemma】 Will you redeem or condemn? Use your heart as the scale to weigh their sins and judge their fates. Their past cannot be rewritten, but they have entrusted you with their future. The confessors' fates may seem insignificant to you, but each decision you make shapes a new version of yourself. Game Features Unique art style and immersive interactive performances Innovative pop-up narrative with light puzzle-solving Morally challenging choices and a panoramic exploration of the human psyche About the Publisher GCORES PUBLISHING is an independent game publishing venture formed by GCORES, committed to bringing you more outstanding indie games from the BOOOM CHALLENGE. Feel free to follow our publisher webpage for future updates. About BOOOM BOOOM is an independent game brand by GCORES, The 'BOOOM CHALLENGE' is held twice a year, featuring three weeks of development time and a specific theme. After the development phase, an online trial play game festival is held for all players, and these games are showcased at GCORES' large offline video game festival.
row.short_description: In the quiet of conscience and shadows of sin, four souls find themselves entwined in crimes involving a woman. In this narrative puzzle game, you don the sacred robe of a priest, hear the confessions of sinners, uncover secrets, seek the truth behind their crimes and deliver the final judgment.
row.notes: The game contains a small amount of suggestive text or scenes involving violence and sex.

row.name: Preface: Undiscovered World
row.detailed_description: ROADMAP About the Game Preface: Undiscovered World - A Tech Demo from PLAYERUNKNOWN Productions Explore a World in the Making Preface is an immersive tech demo showcasing Melba, PLAYERUNKNOWN Productions' groundbreaking technology generating an Earth-scale world. In this project still in development, experience our Machine Learning agents creating a dynamic planet in real-time, all processed directly on your GPU - with no reliance on cloud services.   A Development Journey Join us on a journey into the future of world-building. Preface gives you the opportunity to explore a vast Earth-scale world spanning 510 million km² (200 million square miles) and be among the first to witness this new technology, as it takes shape. As we continue to build and refine Melba , your experiences and feedback will play a crucial role.   Your Feedback, Our Path Forward We believe in community-driven development. That's why we invite you to join us on Discord , where you can engage directly with our dev team, share ideas, provide feedback, and stay informed on the latest updates.   Preface is a tech demo - not a finished product. We’re in an ongoing development phase, so check back regularly to see new features and enhancements as we continue to push the boundaries of ML-driven world generation.
row.short_description: Preface is an immersive tech demo showcasing Melba, PLAYERUNKNOWN Productions' groundbreaking technology generating an Earth-scale world. In this project still in development, experience our machine learning agents creating a planet in real-time, directly on your GPU.

row.name: IRREVERSIBLE
row.detailed_description: Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of a unique psychological horror with shooter elements, unfolding in the expanse of an enthralling open world. A sinister village awaits you, shrouded in mysteries, populated by monsters, and filled with paranormal phenomena. In this grim place, you will meet its inhabitants, delve into their stories, and take part in saving them from the frightening fates that have befallen them. Features The game has a completely seamless open world, which is available immediately after a short introduction. To move around the world, you will have 3 types of transport at your disposal. Immersive gameplay. There is no order in the game. You yourself have the right to choose where to go and what to do. Quest system and storyline. By completing quests, solving puzzles and assigned tasks, you will get an interesting ending. Well-developed dialogues. The game has 40 pages of AI-generated text dialogue. All this is also voiced by AI in English. Good arsenal. To fight your enemies equally, you have 6 types of unique weapons at your disposal. However, you don’t have to use it; you can complete the game without firing a single shot. Interesting locations. Abandoned villas, mental hospitals, churches, cemeteries and settlements await you. Horror atmosphere. The game has an atmospheric soundtrack and also contains the main elements of the horror genre. You are not alone. Characters with quests, interesting dialogues and most importantly - support are scattered throughout the open world.
row.short_description: Immerse yourself in a world where darkness comes to life, and monsters inhabit every corner. Your journey is a fight for survival in a forgotten village shrouded in a paranormal nightmare.

row.name: Hare Trigger
row.detailed_description: In a city shrouded in  darkness and consumed by helicopters , bunnies must band together to eliminate the critters swarming the skies... Rack up points, climb the leaderboard, and prove who’s the ultimate bunny hero in this fast-paced battle for survival and bragging rights! Hare Trigger is a side-scrolling action arcade shooter inspired by early 2000s Flash game classics like Heli Attack 2. Each time you hop in, you will play as one of the bunnies taking part in the fight against the helicopter swarm. Use precise movement, patience, and powerful weapons to eliminate as many helicopters as you can before the helicopters eliminate you .
row.short_description: Play as a bunny with a gun in this fast-paced side-scrolling shooter. Your job? To destroy as many helicopters as you can.

row.name: BioDive
row.detailed_description: After picking up a strange distress signal on their ship’s comms, B3-4K, a pilot for an intergalactic shipping company, lands on the remote exoplanet of Suna. While investigating the planet’s surface, B3-4K discovers a laboratory under the surface of the planet itself. Using your puzzle-solving skills, you’ll play as B3-4K to navigate the winding hallways and many rooms of the laboratory and locate the source of the distress signal, learning about the laboratory’s history as you do. Who –or what– has been calling out into the cold vastness of space? And what could they want? Features: • Explore the underground laboratory of the remote exoplanet Suna • Push blocks, flip levers, and turn mirrors to solve puzzles in a top-down 2-D pixel art environment • Experience the story and look for clues • Investigate the hidden mysteries to uncover the truth • Enjoy the original art and music If you wish to play this on Mac please check out our website
row.short_description: Led to a remote exoplanet by a distress signal, B3-4K discovers a laboratory under the surface of the planet. Push blocks, flip levers, and turn mirrors to solve puzzles and explore the mysteries of the laboratory.

row.name: Pogo-Gogo
row.detailed_description: A game about pogoing up skyscrapers. An important message is waiting for you at the top of the tallest building, but there may be even more climbing to do after that. Make hilarious fails, unbelievable saves, or just explore the tiny open world and its inhabitants. There are 100 purple crystals scattered around the town and some are hiding in the most unsuspecting places. Available to play on both controller or keyboard/mouse.
row.short_description: A game about pogoing up skyscrapers.

row.name: SYNC
row.detailed_description: Launch the SYNC protocol, where you are the ultimate weapon! Leap from foe to foe, commandeering different robotic synth’s abilities in a high-octane, first-person frenzy. Each enemy, a new synth for you to possess; every ability, your arsenal. Master the art of possession, and flip the pace of battle in a blink. As a Divergent AI, you are the embodiment of the SYNC protocol, designed to infiltrate, outmaneuver, and outsmart within the confines of a mysterious lab. Your mission: to uncover the truth behind your creation and the purpose of the SYNC protocol itself. First Person Shooter Gameplay with SYNC: You have the power to SYNC! Charge this ability bar by eliminating enemies with your weapons and abilities of the host you currently have control over. If you begin to run low on ammo or abilities, use your charged SYNC bar by locking onto an enemy and SYNCing to them, granting you power over their weapons and abilities as well as restoring health! Master Different Loadouts: Every robot you see in the facility is something you can take over and use to your advantage. There are currently three different enemy types for you to take as your own. The STALKER has the ability to fly as well as a railgun and missiles. The GUNNER has a boost and an automatic weapon as well as a chain knife to shred through multiple enemies at once. Then the RUSHDOWN who is a brute with a shotgun, grappling hook, and a damaging shield. Know which ability is best for the situation you are in to clear the room of enemies. Uncover the truth behind SYNTELL: The narrative unfolds as you delve deeper into the labyrinthine facility, each level peeling back layers of the story. Discover logs, recordings, and encrypted messages that reveal the origins of the SYNC protocol, the intentions of the lab's enigmatic creators, and the true nature of the Synth body you possess. These revelations challenge your understanding of freedom, identity, and the essence of consciousness itself. Beat your High Scores: SYNC isn't just a test of skill as well as a race against time. Each level is meticulously designed to track your completion time, pushing you to refine your strategies and execution to ascend the leaderboards. Compete with other users on Steam, share your most impressive runs, and earn your place among the SYNC elite. With every replay, uncover new secrets, optimize your path, and piece together the ultimate purpose of your existence as the SYNC Protocol.
row.short_description: Launch the SYNC protocol, where you are the ultimate weapon. Your job is to commandeer different robotic synth’s abilities in a high-octane, first-person frenzy. Master the art of SYNCing, and control the pace of battle.

row.name: Void Islands 2
row.detailed_description: Are you a prey or predator, a world where magic moves you through the islands of void. Collect the Finish ORB, then when magic is disabled; find the exit lamp to move you to the next island. A 3d platformer of a small inhabitant of the void island, who is able to transcend to other floating void islands. Dodge enemies and complete the levels as a passifist animal, but other void creatures are not the same and may attack or defend Many Void slands to explore, C++ Beach Engine 2.0 (2025). Developed by hojiin studios. LAN SETTINGS It should work out the box, remember to disable connections that are not connected to the internet if you want the best experience.
row.short_description: Are you a prey or predator, a world where magic moves you through the islands of void.

row.name: Mini Drift Car
row.detailed_description: This is a mini racing game, driving fun is no less than the big racing game, the operation is simple but endless changes, you just try it will be surprised. This is a game to control the car drifting through the corner, simulate the real drifting.Higher levels of cars can be got by merge,that have better handling.A variety of different cool cars waiting for you to collect, 3000 different game tracks waiting for you to challenge one by one. The game starts, the car will automatically advance.press the mouse and turn the car right,release the mouse and turn the car left.So easy. The game has a large number of levels, the difficulty gradually increases. The excitement and thrill of racing can be experienced in the game. The game is simple and very decompress, so come and enjoy the immersive gaming experience.
row.short_description: Here, you will become a drifting superstar, challenging various tracks and enjoying the thrilling moments of turning. Very simple operation, but endless driving pleasure. You can also collect various cars and experience the unique handling of each one.

row.name: Chocolate Factory Simulator: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Chocolate Factory Simulator: Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full version of the game. Even automatons love chocolate in the world of Chocolate Factory Simulator: Prologue! Welcome to Chocolate Factory Simulator: Prologue, where cogwheels and steam work overtime to create the most delicious chocolate! Use your clockwork workshop full of gourmet machinery to create every kind of chocolate your customers could dream up! The world’s steampunk technology is perfect for sweet-making, and all available to you in your manufacture. Satisfy even the most particular customers. The world of Chocolate Factory Simulator: Prologue is full of different customers from different lands and altitudes, all gathering at your factory for one thing: their favorite chocolate. Take their orders and learn their preferences to win over loyal customers. Discover the colorful world outside of your workshop through their personalities. The art of chocolate. Create elaborate pralines using all the steam-and-cog-powered technology at your disposal in your workshop. Discover a variety of recipes and get creative with their presentation - change your chocolate’s shape, color, and even add some accessories to make it really stand out! Wrap it up in colorful packaging and voilà! You have created a box of beautiful chocolates! Recruit the your very own automaton! Juggling every order and whim of your customers would be a tough task on your own. That’s why you have Nougat! Nougat is your very own personal chocolate-making automaton. Give him tasks, modify him upgrade his capabilities and you will have the best chocolatier’s assistant that you could ever ask for!
row.short_description: The Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full version of the game. Enter the world of steam and sugar and become a master chocolatier in Chocolate Factory Simulator: Prologue. Craft gourmet chocolate for your customers in your steampunk workshop with the help of Nougat.

row.name: Parts Unknown International
row.detailed_description: Parts Unknown International is an online fighting game aiming to recapture the spirit of old fighting games with a unique style. It gives the player different fighting styles to master. If you loved games like Def Jam Vendetta, Street Fighter, Ready 2 Rumble Boxing, or The Warriors, then you are sure to love this game. Inspired by classic street fighting games like Def Jam Fight For NY, Parts Unknown combines stylish in depth fighting styles, beautiful music, and an online experience to keep you engaged. Parts Unknown is a third person fighting game innovating ReadyPlayerMe technology to create a metaverse experience. Play as an orphan who has to fight for a reputation in order to save the orphanage you will meet different characters and crews along your journey! The game in its current state features 3 open worlds, a gym to workout, different fighting styles, and autosave. Online Multiplayer is now available.
row.short_description: Parts Unknown International is an online multiplayer fighting game aiming to recapture the spirit of old fighting platformers with a unique twist.

row.name: Squigley
row.detailed_description: Traverse a massive 2D world and overcome nail-biting platforming challenges using unique movement mechanics and objects in this difficult indie experience. GET MOVING Traverse the world with a fluid and fun movement system unlike any you've ever seen before. In Squigley, you hold percise control over your movement, allowing for clutch saves and close calls. SPEND WISELY Be resourceful, as you must carefully use your coins to maintain your progress through checkpoints in the massive overworld. If you have some to spare, there are plenty of customization and upgrade options! CMD YOUR DESTINY Not a fan of the difficulty? The command terminal allows for easy skips, fun cheats, and other tools to enhance accessibility, so everyone can enjoy Squigley ! BUDDY UP Grab two controllers and pair up with a buddy to enjoy mutiplayer mode! Two players can control their character and can gravitate to each other while airborne to assist each other past a challenge.
row.short_description: Traverse and experience a massive, cohesive 2D world as Squigley. Use your wits, resources and unique movement mechanics in order to explore this dark digital world.
row.notes: Occaisional use of profanity. Don't let your kids play this unless you want them saying "F#ck" or "Sh#t".

row.name: Spring Dogs : Ultimate Multiplayer Battle Royale
row.detailed_description: Compatible with the Steamdeck Step into the frenzied universe of ' Spring Dogs ' and strive to emerge victorious in this locally focused multiplayer experience. Traps like pitfalls, spikes, rams, balls, barbed wires, and many more await you. Whether on land or in water, master avoiding these obstacles to be the quickest to cross the finish line. Personalize your character by choosing from a variety of skins and hats available. Play solo and challenge up to 17 AI-controlled opponents . Invite your friends for unforgettable matches with up to 8 players in split-screen mode ... ...or engage in team battles with up to 16 players where cooperation with your teammates is key to victory! Don't have enough controllers? No problem! With the ability to share controllers and keyboard inputs , invite as many friends as possible to join the race and find out who will be the last one standing in this intense competition. Dive into Time Attack mode to attempt beating your own and your friends' records, aiming to establish yourself as the fastest racer. Hone your skills, perfect your trajectories, and aim for the best possible time. Are you ready to take on the challenge and become the track champion? Don't wait any longer; let the race begin!
row.short_description: Step into the frenetic universe of Spring Dogs and strive to emerge victorious in this locally focused multiplayer battle royale. Customize your character and challenge up to 17 AI-controlled competitors, 8 human players in split-screen, or 16 in team mode.

row.name: WHERE SAFETY ENDS *R*
row.detailed_description: *INTRO* I would like to introduce you to SAFETY, a place for the unfortunate! You must be quite the special guest since our doors only open to those who truly commit to the cause. I can only hope you know what I mean... You are most welcome (even encouraged) to talk with the rest of our precious participants, but be mindful, they DO not like whining. Enjoy your stay ~~~ *DESCRIPTION* This is a short game that explores the concept of SAFETY. You will awaken in a room with three strangers and no knowledge of what has happened to you. In isolation, you are to communicate with them to find out what this place is and why you are here. This story has five different endings, the outcome of which will be determined by the choices you make. Do you think you are brave enough to leave? And, what awaits past the door? Perhaps, you and I are not so different, it may be that we have met in SAFETY before. And for those of you still there, I hope this short story will aid you on your journey. Please consult the Readme file in the games folder for the controller button layout.
row.short_description: What does it take to be SAFE? Maybe it's all about a person who will come to your rescue no matter what. Or maybe it has to do with a place that you know inside and out. OR, perhaps, (just maybe) a room full of strangers with no entrance might just do the trick.
row.notes: Discussion of mental health struggles and fears through symbolism.

Joe 'n Jo
row.detailed_description: Joe ‘n Jo is a whimsically challenging physics-based platformer about two giraffes, Joe and Jo, who are tethered together for eternity! Whether you embark on this journey solo or team up with a friend, you'll navigate through diverse and challenging environments that will test your coordination, patience, and problem-solving skills. Experience the silliness of controlling two giraffes whose bodies are tied together and move entirely by physics. Control each giraffe by moving their head to climb up obstacles and tumble across fields. Each step and jump requires coordination and thought in order to make progress! Play through the entire game with a friend! Simple to learn but challenging to master, the controls encourage players to work in harmony. Effective communication and synchronized actions are key to overcoming the game's many obstacles and puzzles. Practice makes perfect! As you progress, levels increase in complexity. Master the intricacies of giraffe locomotion, adapt to changing environments, and triumph over ever-more demanding obstacles. Can you reach the end?
row.short_description: Joe ‘n Jo is a challenging physics-based platformer about two giraffes who are strapped together for eternity. Play solo or with a friend and make your way through unique environments that will test your coordination and patience!

row.name: last seen online
row.detailed_description: You were always a snoop, weren’t you? That’s why you bought an old computer you saw lying among piles of junk at a garage sale. You didn’t even bother to format the computer before you turned it on. You were curious. After all, a personal computer is an extension of another person’s soul, all their secrets, projects, interactions. “last seen online” is a psychological horror escape room, based on early flash games. Look through someone's computer files. Solve puzzles and discover the secrets that lie within the computer.
row.short_description: Look through someone else’s computer. Inspired by early “escape room” flash games.

row.name: Hues
row.detailed_description: Sprites like color blocks so move them there. The faster the better. Color blocks can be destroyed with the mouse. Use this combination to solve the very fun very interesting levels. Features 3 characters with unique limitations you control using the arrow keys to move based on physics. The ball rolls freely. The hex rolls but not so easily. The box cannot roll. The mouse allows you to destroy the blocks that must be removed to solve the puzzles. The color blocks disintegrate into a nice satisfying dust by either clicking on them or a nice smooth slice motion. The color blocks and even the characters can be attached by joints that can rotate by motors. Levels can have springs and buoyancy from the water. There is a bonus count down to allow speed runners to compete. Levels are highly replayable.

row.name: Shockwaves
row.detailed_description: Shockwaves is a puzzle game inspired by the popular 2048. In Shockwaves, placing numbers triggers powerful shockwaves that push other numbers across the board. When similar numbers collide, they merge, setting off a chain reaction of shockwaves and creating exciting combo effects that boost your score. FEATURES: ENDLESS MODE: Compete against friends and players worldwide on the leaderboard in an endless mode. PUZZLES: Challenge yourself with 50 puzzles that progressively get harder. CHALLENGES: Put your skills to the test with 16 open-ended challenges that encourage creative thinking and strategic gameplay. LEADERBOARDS: Showcase your skills on integrated leaderboards.
row.short_description: Shockwaves is a captivating merging puzzle game where strategic placement creates powerful shockwaves, pushing and merging numbers. Challenge yourself with endless scoring or solve intricate puzzles.

row.name: The Exile Princes
row.detailed_description: The Exile Princes is a story focused, procedural RPG designed for short playthroughs in which you as a knight gather companions and fighters to bring your house to victory throughout the unique fantasy setting of the Exile Realms. Starting out in service to the current lords of the land, you can gain power and influence and ultimately through strength or guile ensure your faction's place at the helm of every city in the realms. The game's design is old-school, with a text readout core to the interface and simple tile-based maps, decision screens, and battle stat interfaces available. The interface graphics are lovingly produced based on actual medieval artwork, and show a lively medieval world for you to discover. Features Explore: procedurally generated worlds and cities offer a varied experience with every playthrough. Forest altars, dungeons, fortified manors, ruined chapels, bandit camps, stone circles and more may be encountered on your travels. Wonder: at a fantasy imaginarium from across the medieval world with a world of blemmyes, grotesques, cockatrices and wood sprites as well as creatures specifically named and adapted from medieval artwork for this game. Lead: a simple turn-based combat system with an exhaustion mechanic gives quick but tactically interesting combat choices. Rule: become leader of a city through election or conquest and hold court to deliver justice and develop your lands. A living world: as the player travels, the city-states of the realms will squabble, hold events, make raids and declare wars, changing the world around you in a dynamic way. Choose your house: four different factions allow you to vary your playstyle between the heroic Phoenixes, the exploration driven Scholars, the militaristic Generals, and the wealthy Wyrms. Each faction comes with unique military units and bonuses. Choose your difficulty: five difficulty settings let you vary your play between the relaxed exploratory style of the easy 'John Mandeville' mode, through the classic 'Moriaen' RPG experience, to the ultra-tough 'Silence' mode for those who want a tougher roguelike-style experience. Events: join tournaments and feasts to boost your prestige and gain skills. Companionship: with a range of generated characters: six companion classes and varied character traits give a wide range of potential characters with stories, quests, interests, and opinions on the world. Nameable pets provide further possibilities for building a found family of companions and allies. Romance: party members may enter romances with you and with one another, unlocking unique interactions to further the romance throughout the game. Soundtrack: a unique set of 12 tavern songs gives a folkloric depth to the Exile Realms setting.
row.short_description: A story focused, old school, procedural RPG: raise your banner and bring your house to victory in the unique medieval fantasy setting of the Exile Realms. Start out in questing service, gain companions, followers, power and influence, and ultimately through strength or guile learn to rule the lands.
row.notes: The Exile Princes includes a considerable amount of combat, generally in the fantasy-heroic vein but with some more detailed written descriptions of character deaths (played largely for emotional rather than visceral reaction). There are also character romances with some written scenes that involve mild physical intimacy.

row.name: Brass Necessity - Demo
row.detailed_description: Note: This game is no longer under active development. This version of the game now acts as a standalone demo.   On a planet far from here, and in a completely different time... You're part of a crew of explorers, and you've stumbled upon the ancient ruins of a human civilization. How it got there doesn't really matter. Because, really, it wasn't your choice to be here. And even worse, it's magical, cursed, and pure evil. Hoards of undead swarm you, and they aim to make you one of their own. The only thing between you and death is your laser. And even that doesn't seem to work as well as you'd like. But even if you're from a different planet or a different time, you still don't want to die, so you best get to figuring it out. If you time it right and use the right ammo, you might just make it out alive. Mechanics In Brass Necessity, the control layout is simple. There are only seven inputs, and four of those are WASD for moving. You've also got the ability to sprint, which is handy for dodging the greedy hands of the dead. But the star of the show is your somewhat trusty and temperamental laser. It has two whole inputs dedicated to it. So it's not hard to work. One key reloads the ammo. The other fires it. Simple! The crystals you use as ammo change the properties of your laser. The only snag is that these crystals seem to be growing from the undead. Use the wrong crystal, and they'll be much harder to kill. Meaning you're more likely to die. Use the right one however, and you're less likely to die. Got the wrong ammo? Tough! You'll have to reload or search for the right one. All your crystals suck? Just reload them all to reset your laser. See, simple! Intuitive! Just don't fire your laser too long... the manufacturers never quite got continuous firing right. About the Studio Popped Corn Bytes is an independent game studio. The studio hosts the Game Creators' Club, where members of the group contribute to development projects, like Brass Necessity. Members get the opportunity to gain experience and make their own creative mark on published games.
row.short_description: In this top-down, sci-fi shoot 'em up, you'll have to solve combat-based puzzles in order to escape the cursed undead. You've only got your laser as a weapon and crystals to change its element. You'll need to figure out matchups that work best against enemies to escape. Good luck, you'll need it!

row.name: Stars Survivor

Engage in intense and breathtaking space battles against players from around the world, and prove your dominance in a variety of exciting game modes.  Be the last survivor to claim victory!  Take on other pilots in a fierce competition where strategy and skill are crucial to triumph. GLOBAL RANKING SYSTEM In Battle Royale mode, put your skills to the test in competitive ranked matches. Climb the divisions and leagues to rank among the best pilots in the universe! Your rank will be proudly displayed in the global leaderboard.  CUSTOMIZATION Earn XP by winning battles and unlock a variety of unique items in the Space Pass, our exclusive battle pass. Customize your spaceships with lasers, thrusters, and much more! 🔧🚀 IN-GAME CURRENCY Earn Planetary by playing and completing challenges. Use them to purchase cosmetic items, upgrades, and special equipment from the daily store.  STRATEGY Explore different planets on the map and destroy them to collect bonuses like missiles, speed boosts, static mines, repair packs, and more. row.name: Christmas Countdown
row.detailed_description: Christmas Countdown is an enchanting game that sets you in the heart of the North Pole, where the magic of Christmas is in the air. With just five days until Christmas Eve, Santa needs all hands on deck to ensure every present is wrapped and ready for delivery. You play as one of Santa's most diligent elves, tasked with wrapping toys that come zipping down a conveyor belt, aiming to pack them into Santa's sleigh before they crash off the end. Navigate through five intense levels, each representing the final countdown to Christmas Eve, growing more challenging and frenetic as you progress. Your skills, speed, and Christmas spirit will be put to the test as you try to keep up with the ever-increasing pace of gift-wrapping mayhem. Once you've mastered the story, dive into Endless Mode, where the true challenge begins. Compete against elves from around the globe for a spot on our leaderboards by wrapping more presents than anyone else and proving your worth as Santa's top elf. Key Features Festive Gameplay: Immerse yourself in the holiday spirit with vibrant graphics and cheerful Christmas music that brings the North Pole to life. Progressive Difficulty: Each level brings a new challenge, pushing you to refine your strategy and improve your speed to keep up with the game's pace. Endless Mode: Test your limits and strive for the top of the leaderboards in a never-ending gift-wrapping extravaganza. Leaderboards: Showcase your high scores and see how you stack up against players from around the world. Family-Friendly Fun: Designed for players of all ages, Christmas Countdown offers an engaging way to get into the holiday spirit. Whether you're in for a bit of holiday fun or looking for a joyful game to play with the family, Christmas Countdown promises hours of excitement and holiday cheer. Join us at the North Pole and help make this Christmas the most magical one yet!
row.short_description: Join Santa's elves in a festive race against time to wrap presents and fill Santa's sleigh before Christmas Eve in this fun and cheerful game for the whole family.

row.name: Batteri Fjell 1945
row.detailed_description: Batteri Fjell 1945 is a history-driven game set in an accurately reconstructed Fjell Fortress outside Bergen as it appeared when World War II ended in 1945. Here, you will experience a world in chaos and uncertainty. Through your own choices, you will encounter different characters – such as a resistance fighter with needs for revenge and justice, a local resident who has found great love, a German prisoner of war, an Allied soldier trying to navigate the fragile situation, and more. Through the journalist role in the game, you will explore the fortress during this tense time. This unique game aims to engage both students and others in history and help them truly understand the extraordinary circumstances that unfolded in the country, where traditional roles were turned upside down, and thoughts of revenge prevailed.
row.short_description: Rumors are circulating about unrest at Fjell Fortress outside Bergen, and it's your job as a journalist to get to the bottom of what's happening. Explore an accurate reconstruction of the fortress as it appeared when World War II ended in 1945.
