row.name: Nekokami: Internship - The Prologue Adventure
row.detailed_description: UPDATE: Nekokami - The Human Restoration Project is now in Early Access! 🎉 We have made significant improvement to gameplay and graphics - check it at out our developer page or scroll down to 'More from Rocket-in-Bottle'! 🚀 (Screenshot from Early Access version.) ✨ Nekokami: Internship is a FREE prologue to the full game Nekokami. This prologue contains 20+ Expeditions and roughly 4 hours of story-rich gameplay. In this sneak peek of the full game, you will: 🌏 Create beautiful worlds of natural habitats and human settlements with strategic, or spontaneous, placement of tiles in a unique hand-drawn-like art style. 🌌 Follow the beginning of a whimsical yet heart-warming story of Human-Cat friendship, set millennia later in the future. 💼 Earn your place in Nekokami Co., your employer, by creating worlds that beat expectations. Or just relax. Your bosses are Cats after all. 🔮 Befriend a selection of Kami, spirits of the nature and the universe, and see them bring miracles to your work. They are Cats too. What could go wrong? 🌟 Nekokami Co. is commissioned to manage planets all over the universe. That's a LOT of planets! Environment, biomes and rules differ from Star System to Star System. You will get to visit at least SIX Star Systems during your internship. 🐈 I did mention the Kami*, right? Technically the spirits are the real fellows creating the worlds. As a Planetary Architect, you are basically borrowing their Creative Energy for your own use. You will need to seek their acceptance and approval. Through their friendship, you will potentially learn the secrets of nature and the arcane laws of universe. *Kami is actually a Japanese word that roughly translates to 'spirits and gods'. About the Developer This game was made by a tiny tiny independent game studio in Fukuoka. We hope you enjoy it!
row.short_description: Architect beautiful, peaceful worlds in a far-future where Cats rule the universe. Befriend sometimes-naughty spirits of nature. Manage Humans. Join us in this unique planet-building adventure and get a taste of the full journey!
row.reviews: “Nekokami looks like it'll be intriguing for fans of tile-placing games like Dorfromantik, though with a more objective focused set of challenges and puzzles rather than open-ended score chasing.” PC Gamer “(Translated) I felt that even the early tutorial-like stages had a sufficient amount of content, but there are still plenty of stages to play and enjoy!” Indie Freaks

row.name: Pearl Fishery: Quest for the Mega Pearl
row.detailed_description: Q. What kind of game is this? A. In this game, you can shoot pearls to gather treasure under the mysterious Pearl Island and fire harpoons to fight off dangerous sea creatures. Pearls can score bonuses, or they can trigger Party Time for even more rewards. You can earn new badges and titles! Shoot Pearls Under an island where pearls are plentiful and sea creatures roam, you control a pearl shooter that will lead you to riches...and danger. Bonus Blocks Pearls can activate bonus blocks—providing you with extra pearls and gold. You can even get big pearls! Party Time Want to party under the sea? Trigger five of the same bonus block. You will be rewarded with a pearl waterfall and a light show. Big Pearl Bonus Some pearls are very big. They can be collected and exchanged for a lot of gold. How much gold? Luck will decide. Earn Gold Push pearls off the platform to get gold. It's time to make a fortune. Get Treasure Need a place to store your gold? Put them in treasure chests and collect as many as you can. Badges & Titles With enough treasure chests, you can level up. You will get a shiny new badge. And a cool new title to go with it. Sunken Pirates Even as ghosts, pirates want to loot your treasure. They will take what you have, but you can send them back to the depths! Giant Crab Sea monsters live in treacherous waters. Fight back and defeat the Giant Crab! It'll lead you straight to The Mega Pearl. The Mega Pearl The biggest pearl of them all was rumored to be deep under Pearl Island. No adventurer, pirate, or merchant has found it...yet.
row.short_description: Shoot pearls, fire harpoons, and collect treasure under the mysterious 'Pearl Island' in this new single-player, ocean-themed coin pusher game!

row.name: Trojan
row.detailed_description: 'Trojan' is the first innovative game to employ synchronous turn-based strategy in chess-like battles. You will compete against another player, synchronously planning your strategic moves and then visually witnessing the impact of each planned step on the battlefield during the calculation phase. In 'Trojan,' every game is unique and exciting. The maps are randomly generated with various tiles, making each playthrough full of surprises due to the fog of war and the resulting asymmetry of information. In 'Trojan,' you don't need to focus on intricate operations; instead, concentrate on the strategies adopted and predicting the opponent's moves. The characteristic of synchronous turn-based play will give you a joy akin to real-time strategy games. Calm down and enjoy the endless charm of competing with others!
row.short_description: 'Trojan' is the first innovative fantasy war chess game to utilize a synchronous turn-based strategy. The victory depends on whose strategy surpasses the other, determined by who can look further into the unpredictable future.

row.name: The Jackbox Megapicker
row.detailed_description: The Jackbox Megapicker is your all-in-one solution for organizing, buying, and launching all of your Jackbox games. You no longer have to switch between Party Packs to start playing your favorite games. The Megapicker will give you an overview of the games that you own so you can launch them directly. View games you might be missing, and see news updates and ongoing sales all in one place. Filter your games by genre and create an account to store your preferences and see your game history.

row.name: Chefcito Asesino
row.detailed_description: Description: In this game, we embody an extremely angry rat that must defend itself from sewer monsters to survive. How to Play: To play, simply advance by opening chests to select the weapons you want to use. Defeat enemies and with the coins you earn, you'll be able to unlock new weapons. Content: We have a store where you can unlock new content to make defeating your enemies easier.
row.short_description: In this game, we embody an extremely angry rat that must defend itself from sewer monsters to survive. We have plenty of weapons available to achieve this.

row.name: The Beautiful Island
row.detailed_description: 'The Beautiful Island' is set in a parallel history in a not-so-far future. It is set on an island, resembling the Taiwan of our own world, after a war. You can chose to either play the game after the island lost the war and got annexed by its neighbor or after it successfully defended itself. Jan, an engineer, visits the island not long after the war ended. He tries to reconnect with people that he knew from his previous visit. He learns about their fates and how the war has changed their views on the political situation. Will you stay neutral or will you get involved and help? Can you change fate? Will you form your own opinion? – Then share it with other players at the end of the game! Game play This visual novel includes several endings – some better, some worse. Make decisions, talk to people, find a path that leads to an ending of your choice, but please understand: war has no good endings! The World of 'Beautiful Island' This is not the real world. It's the world of our fictional story. The real world is more complex than any story – but maybe stories can help us to understand the world a bit better?
row.short_description: A short visual novel about war, peace and hope. Explore a city after a devastating war. Talk to people, try to understand, try to help. The heroes of war are dead, but you can be a hero of peace!
row.notes: Description of war and its consequences. The game avoids to directly depict any form of violence, injury or death.

row.short_description: Hyper is the ultimate app for vtubers & avatar creators. Use our VTubing tools to make content, stream, connect, and do more. Are you ready to start your VTuber journey?

row.name: The Red Button
row.detailed_description: - Man vs The Red Button You are in front of a red button you must no press. Will you dare to defy the unknown, or will you walk away, forever wondering what could have been? Only the strongest will be rewarded and enter the Empty Place. This game includes: - A button - A choice - A secret place - 10 ranks to climb. - 80.6mb of data - You don't need a mouse, a keyboard or even a screen to play it. - Voice acting by Shakyra Dunn.
row.short_description: Resist the urge to press the button and do not uncover the secrets that may lie within its crimson facade. The choice is yours: to press or not to press.

row.name: VGA Planets Nu
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the Echo Cluster, a dense cluster of star systems, rich in resources and native life. Over three hundred years ago the 11 races arrived marking the start of a complex and brutal history which is still unfolding today. They brought with them a dangerous and powerful technology, which has allowed elite members of society to skip through time by accelerating close to the speed of light, slowing relative time and then decelerating to alter the course of history again and again. These people are commonly referred to as Echos. As an ambitious leader, you seek access to this technology to make your mark on history. To get it you’ll need to learn the lessons of the past and climb the ladder of society. Unlocking the secrets of history and forging glory in the present. Be aware though, the road is more perilous than ever, as a new ruthless species has arrived, and is disrupting life in the Echo Cluster. They are known as the Horwasp Plague. Claim your home sector now to start your journey! VGA Planets Nu is a graphical multi-player play by turn war game that simulates combat in space between galactic empires. The game emphasizes mining, colonization and the construction of starships. Players compete against each other economically and militarily on a galactic scale. The game system allows players to construct starships by selecting various components and placing them on a given hull type. There are usually 11 players in a game, each playing a different race with special ships and abilities, but there are other formats as well. At the start of a game, each player is given a planet, a starbase, and a ship. The players have to manage their planet's population and resources wisely. They can create more ships and expand their domain through colonization or conquest of neighboring planets. Of course, all players are attempting to do the same thing, so the fleets will, inevitably, engage in combat from time to time. VGA Planets Nu can be compared to a multi-player chess game in which all players move all their pieces simultaneously, one turn at a time.
row.short_description: A graphical multi-player play by turn war game that simulates combat in space between galactic empires.

row.detailed_description: Rather than confining Earth to a singular form, let's unleash its diversity by shaping it in various forms. In this interactive experience, you can pause Earth's constant flux and craft your rendition. The paused Earth becomes 'YOUR EARTH,' which you can explore from multiple viewpoints. Moreover, accompanied by ambient music, you can contemplate while witnessing Earth morph into various shapes. This game promises to alter your perception of our planet. Distribution Guidelines: Include the name of the game in the title of the video or live stream. Also, include the URL of the store page in the summary or description section of the video or live stream.
row.short_description: This game is an earth creation simulation game that allows you to create and view the earth in various shapes.

row.name: Deck Dash
row.detailed_description: Deck Dash is an asynchronous PvP auto-battler card game. Craft your deck with different types of items, enter fights against other survivors on the island, build your engine on the board, discover countless combos, and defeat your enemies. Epic tactical duels await you on the island. Steam version of Deck Dash is a PC port of the original mobile game. It is free from the mobile F2P monetization scheme. In this version, you can buy gems only for customization elements, not to progress faster. Note: All your IAP purchases will go to the development of our upcoming titles. Thanks in advance! Main Duels – Engage in tactical asynchronous PvP battles with your custom deck. Character Customization – Personalize your in-game character. Ranking League – Climb the competitive ladder and prove your skills. Missions & Events – Take on challenges and earn exclusive rewards. Game Modes - Experience different ways to play. With the right combination of items and strategic alignment, anything can happen in Deck Dash. Some engines can create amazing damage and devastate your opponents! Go through many playstyles and find what works best for you. Build devastating synergies that multiply your power. Watch the numbers explode as your engine kicks into overdrive. Adapt and counter your opponent’s strategies in real-time. Deck Dash is designed to have a deep engine-building mechanic that suits an auto-battler card game. With over 150+ unique items, you can mix and match to create the ultimate build. There are no faction restrictions—only pure creativity and strategy. Discover countless synergies and optimize your engine. Adapt your deck to counter enemy strategies. Experiment with wild mechanics and find your playstyle. Deck Dash offers a variety of modes designed for infinite replayability, catering to both competitive and casual players. Whether you enjoy testing your skills against others, refining your strategies in PvE, or experimenting with unique deck builds, there’s always a new challenge waiting for you. These game modes also serve as testing grounds for shaping the future of Deck Dash. Let us know which modes pique your interest so we can refine the core game with your feedback in mind. Featured Decks – Try out curated decks with unique synergies. All-in Brawl – High-risk, high-reward battles with everything on the line. Harsh Survival – Endurance-based matches that test your adaptability. Proving Grounds – A true test of skill for seasoned strategists.
row.short_description: Deck Dash is a PvP auto-card battler. Craft your deck, build your engine, discover countless combos, and defeat all your enemies. Sort your items and create your engines to win epic tactical fights. Explore and upgrade items and become the ultimate survivor of The Island.

row.name: Celtic Heroes
row.detailed_description: Step into the legendary world of Dal Riata, where heroes rise, clans wage war, and mythical creatures roam the lands. Celtic Heroes is a free-to-play 3D MMORPG inspired by Celtic mythology, offering deep quest-driven gameplay, dynamic boss battles, and a thriving player-driven economy. Choose your class, forge your destiny, and relive the nostalgia of a decade-old adventure-filled world. Key Features A Free-to-Play MMORPG Without Restrictions Earn gear, potions, and currency through gameplay. No paywalls, no locked content —just a fair and rewarding experience. Epic Boss Battles & High-Stakes Combat Face off against Celtic warlords, dragons, and mythical beasts . Take on world bosses, and PvP battles , either solo or with your clan. Victory brings valuable rewards and legendary loot. Seasonal Events & Exclusive Rewards Participate in limited-time events to earn unique armor, rare charms, and powerful weapons . Engage in community challenges and leave your mark on the world of Dal Riata . Clan System – Build Your Legacy Join a clan and gain access to a shared clan bank, where boss loot can be stored and distributed.  A True Open Economy – Trade Without Limits All gear and items are tradeable —nothing is bound to your character. Buy, sell, and exchange items via the Auction House and direct trading , shaping the in-game economy as you see fit. Pets & Mounts with Unique Abilities Summon combat pets to assist you in battle or ride powerful mounts to traverse the world faster. Professions – Fishing, Cooking & Crafting Take a break from combat and master the arts of fishing, cooking, and crafting . Catch rare fish, prepare meals with powerful buffs, and sell your goods for profit. A Living, Expansive World Explore forests and ancient ruins , complete story-driven quests , and customize your hero with a variety of armor sets, weapons, and abilities .   A CLASSIC MMORPG EXPERIENCE – EXPLORE, TRADE, BATTLE, AND BUILD YOUR LEGACY Join thousands of players and forge your path in this evolving fantasy world. Add to your wishlist and start your adventure today.
row.short_description: Are you looking for that classic MMORPG vibe? Whether you're a minmaxer strategizing every detail for maximum efficiency, a savvy fashion collector in search of the most stunning outfits, or even someone who enjoys the journey of casual leveling, Celtic Heroes opens its gates to you!

row.name: Ruiga Pirates: First Survivors
row.detailed_description: WISHLIST FULL GAME About the Game Ruiga Pirates: First Survivors is a survivors-like game. Hellish seas, pirates everywhere and you can't escape sea creatures. All you can do is fight to the death and take what you can and leave nothing behind. Collect gold on every run to buy upgrades, new ships and find skilled captains. Get ready for seven seas challenges! In the prologue of our game, players are thrust into a world of high seas piracy, where the haunting specter of ghosts looms large. Amidst constant battles for survival, they must navigate treacherous waters, facing both natural and supernatural threats. With adrenaline-pumping action and thrilling encounters, the prologue sets the stage for an epic adventure filled with excitement and peril. Choose your ship and captain. Customize your enhancements. Your choices will make you live more and make you shoot more. Prevent enemy ships from approaching you. Avoid fires and watch out for traps. Complete challenges and explore hidden treasures. With the missions you will take, you will sometimes bomb an island and sometimes go after the most wanted pirates. Get ready for legends of krakens, mermaids and more!
row.short_description: Defeat legions of pirates and marine beasts to emerge victorious! Ruiga Pirates: First Survivors is an adventure with survival elements. Customize your ship, brace yourself for a bullets from myriad foes! Navigate the perilous waters of a ghost-infested realm and Play for Free now!

row.name: 规则怪谈：盛崖小区 Playtest
Galaxy Rush
row.detailed_description: Galaxy Rush is a sci-fi racing game that delivers the thrill of high-speed racing. Hop into a world where the most exhilarating Grand-Prix of the space age has begun, and the audience is waiting for a show. Gear up and start your engines, for the Galaxy Rush is about to blast off! Spacecraft: Step into the cockpits of 9 different spacecraft as you zip through different planets to claim victory for your own. Each craft reflects the driving preference of the racer, making no two spacecraft the same. Enjoy discovering different playstyles and mastering your favorites! Environments: Explore the galaxy as you boost your way through locations such as the sweeping corners of Neptune, the arid deserts of Mars, the neon metropolis of Earth, and the frozen peaks of Pluto! Fun for All: Gather a group of two to four friends to duke it out, or race solo against AI competition. Different gameplay modes allow you to create your ideal set of races. Immersive Gameplay: Featuring intricate and aesthetically rich visuals coupled with a diverse gaming experience, Galaxy Rush invites all kinds of players to have an experience that is out of this world. Updates: Our team is consistently working on adding new content to the game in the form of new gameplay areas, so stay tuned for more!
row.short_description: Feel the thrill of galactic racing! The most exhilarating grand prix of the spacefaring age is upon us, and the audience is waiting for you. Gear up and start your engines, for the Galaxy Rush is about to blast off!

row.name: Fastival
row.detailed_description: Fastival is an arcade racing game where players speed through different attractions within a vibrant and cartoony carnival throughout each race. Knock down targets as you race to trigger unique effects on the track that you can use to your advantage. Collect wacky items that can be used to mess with other racers to enhance your driving capabilities. Race Through Three Unique Tracks Each track is a different section of the Fastival with its own fun theme. Enter the Fastival in “Whirling Welcome,” navigating tight turns and spiraling around a merry go round. Navigate a field of giant wack-a-moles popping up and down and zoom across a roller coaster. Fly through a ring of fire and get launched by a cannon up into the big top circus tent. Master Each Bumper Car Fastival features four different types of bumper cars that players can choose from each with unique driving strengths and weaknesses. The Shark car boasts a higher top speed but is more challenging to control while the Vintage car is slower to accelerate but heavier, allowing you to utilize drifting to your advantage more often. Knock Down Targets to Affect the Race In Fastival , you can gain an advantage as you race through unique interactions with the environment. Knock down targets in each race by driving through them to trigger a temporary effect on the race track. Some targets will reveal a shorter path while others activate hazards that other racers have to steer clear of. Use Items to Take Out the Competition As you race, collect carnival tickets that turn into one of five fun items. Activate a firecracker to launch yourself forward and gain temporary invincibility, or throw a volley of water balloons at other racers to spin out their vehicles. Customize Your Racer Mix and match between four cute costumes and color palettes. Developer Notes Fastival was created by the students of Cohort 33 at SMU Guildhall, a graduate video game design program in Dallas, Texas. In their second Team Game Project course ('TGP2'), the entire cohort of 47 students from all disciplines—Art Creation, Programming, Design, and Production—with help from three game music students in SMU's Meadows School of the Arts came together each day to make this game. For many students, this is their first experience working on a large team, and the course is designed to teach the students how to communicate at scale and iterate on the game design to find the fun. To accomplish this in roughly 12 weeks of production and produce such a vibrant, fun game is a challenge, and we are really proud to share their hard work with you. Thank you for playing. We hope you enjoy Fastival . If you do, please consider leaving a kind note in the community hub and share the game with your friends.
row.short_description: Race through an enchanting carnival and be on the lookout for wacky obstacles and cool shortcuts as you compete against up to three other friends in this cute and cartoony arcade racing game!

row.name: FreeInfantry
row.detailed_description: Step into the ultimate squad warfare experience in this real-time, fast paced tactical top-down shooter. Use momentum to your advantage and to your enemies detriment as your bullets and explosive shrapnel ricochet using FreeInfantry's Newtonian physics model. Plan your attack from the shadows and ambush your enemy thanks to Infantry's real-time Fog of War visibility model. FreeInfantry features several zone types, providing players with exciting and varying experiences in this sci-fi military universe that starts with the war between the Titan Militia and Collective Military. Fight alongside your team or as a solo trooper in Io's Landing against a neverending tide of enemy bots in escalating challenge modes. Join a squad and test your skills and strategy in the competitive deathmatch league that's 50 plus seasons running. Survive against the swarm of aliens in Bug Hunt. FreeInfantry is most active daily between 9 PM and 2 AM EST , but may be enjoyed at other times as well through the featured bots zones.   FreeInfantry is 100% free with zero paid unlockables. Prepare for battle and experience it today.
row.short_description: Isometric. Massively Multiplayer. Capture The Flag. Skirmish. Bug Hunt. And more. Welcome to FreeInfantry - the world's first massive multiplayer online isometric shooter.
row.notes: This is a combat game which contains sounds of gunshots, explosives, as well as depicts graphically violent death animations and blood splatters.

row.name: un/FRAGMENT.
row.detailed_description: You are a fragment in the universe. You wake up with no body, no sense of touch, nothing. But... you can walk? You have no legs! You walk the endless plain, then is stopped by a mysterious girl. Who is this girl? Is she... god? What am I doing here? The mysterious girl shall guide you. - You - You are you. Where are you? With the help of this mysterious girl, maybe she has the answers for you. - Mysterious Girl named Aesysis - Who is she? Is she god? Am I dead? The answer relies in her words of wisdom. 3000~ words 1 beautiful CG 10 minutes of story 1 Choice, 1 Ending Gore Filter Breathtaking OST This game is only suitable for mature audiences. This game features topics that may disturb. Viewers discretion advised.
row.short_description: A short 10 minute visual novel about being a fragment in the universe and trying to find a way out of the ****.
row.notes: This is a work of fiction, and it contains Visual Gore, mentions of Suicide, Drugs & Domestic Abuse, Please don't play if you don't like it.

row.name: Rabbit Hole
row.detailed_description: “Remember you will live.” Rabbit Hole is a fast paced, tough-as-nails 2D Platformer-RogueLike-Shooter inspired by popular roguelikes, made with a love for the genre. You are Disc, someone who was suddenly brought to the Rabbit Hole. Collect guns, fight foes and meet strange new characters on your descent to the bottom, all in an attempt to find your heart again. “This place is like its own ecosystem. A big living breathing mess.” Every run is different. Enjoy hours of replayable content through randomly generated floor layouts and 50+ weapons to collect and use. “Hey, hey, hey! How's my favorite anxiety-fueled nutjob!” Unlock new characters with diverse playstyles. Each of the 6 unlockable characters keep gameplay fresh and give a unique perspective on the gameplay loop. “There was a blank line, almost as if I had erased it” Discover the truth that lies beneath the surface. Collect books and fill out your library to understand its unseen history. In the end, you may even come to understand yourself?
row.short_description: Rabbit Hole is a fast paced, tough-as-nails 2D RogueLike-Shooter, made with love for the genre. You are Disc, someone who was suddenly brought to the Rabbit Hole. Collect guns, fight foes and meet strange new characters on your descent to the bottom, all in an attempt to find your heart again.

row.name: Millie Megavolte 8: Millie and the Mole King
row.detailed_description: Millie's back and she's still mad! In this latest installment of the long-running Millie Megavolte series, you play as Millie Megavolte, Lance LeTourre, Kilzek Green, Anne Abelle and a ton of new characters too as they fight for what's right ('right' being a relative term here). Story Mode The classic! Instead of one big adventure, the story is told through lots of short ones. Every story involves different characters and gives a piece of the bigger picture of what's going on. At first, Millie and Lance set out to stop the Mole King but things get a little more complicated from there. Journey Mode Done with Story Mode? Great! Play Journey Mode FOREVER! Journey Mode is a rogue-lite-lite where the areas are randomized and the levels themselves are shuffled. Pick your team of four characters or go in solo and rampage across the world! Cool Bullet Points The humor is back! Those who don't like shock or blue humor may want to cover their eyes. There are girls in skimpy outfits running around too 14+ unique playable characters. Millie and her friends are back with a whole cast of even more friends Play dress-up with multiple outfits and weapon choices for every character Four difficulty levels from Noob to Master (plus two secret ones). Don't get pwned! Also, the baseline difficulty is way easier than the head-crushing-hard previous MTC games were No more tiny Flash-o-Vision! Millie 8 uses a custom engine (built with SFML) and runs in full 1080 and doesn't chug to reach 60 FPS Play with a controller, seriously. I even implemented the Steam Input API so you can use whatever wacky controller you want
row.short_description: Flash may be dead but Millie's back in this action-packed revival! The Mole King is gearing up for war and made the mistake of annoying Millie. Go berserk and massacre your way through mountains of monsters to shut him up for good.
row.notes: Fantasy violence, revealing outfits and nudity, crude humor, strong language.

row.name: CastingPlz
row.detailed_description: CastingPlz is a 2-player cooperative roguelike game where players take on the roles of two characters with distinct responsibilities: one for attacking and the other for movement. [Background] In the past, a Grand Wizard sealed away the monsters that roamed the world and restored peace by imprisoning them in a massive labyrinth. During this time of peace, a rumor began to circulate worldwide: 'In the deepest part of the labyrinth, the Grand Wizard grants any wish.' The source of this rumor is uncertain, but people from all walks of life are heading to the Grand Wizard's labyrinth, each with their own dreams. [Labyrinth] The labyrinth is inhabited by sealed monsters that have formed their own ecosystems over a long period, establishing rules to live by. As you conquer the ever-changing labyrinth one step at a time, delve deeper, uncover its secrets, and progress to lower, more profound levels. [Monsters] The monsters trapped by the Grand Wizard are determined to eliminate newcomers who intrude into their ecosystems. Defeat the advancing monsters to conquer the labyrinth, but don't get too comfortable. As you venture deeper into the labyrinth, more powerful monsters await you. [Soldier & Wizard] You must choose to play as either a Soldier or a wizard, with the game roles divided to the extreme. You will need to cooperate with each other to embark on your adventure. Soldier: High mobility Low combat power Wizard: Powerful magic Limited mobility To achieve your dreams, you must save your partner and approach your own aspirations. [Magic and Items] As you progress through the labyrinth, defeat monsters using various spells and acquire diverse items to grow and potentially expedite the conquest of the labyrinth. ... Maybe?
